enGB: Abyssal Conduit - Channeling

enGB: This creature is attempting to create a massive planar tear between this plane and the Abyss. They are confused and slowed for the duration as the immense powers ravage their body. When this tear opens, this creature will take 6d12 Unholy damage, be paralyzed by the burst of abyssal energy, and an incredibly powerful Demon will be birthed into the world (temporarily).
zhCN: 此生物正试图在当前位面与深渊之间撕开一道巨大的位面裂隙。巨大力量肆虐其躯体，使其在持续期间处于困惑与缓慢状态。裂隙开启时，此生物将受到6d12点邪秽伤害，被涌出的深渊能量麻痹，同时一头威力惊人的恶魔将（暂时）降生于世。

enGB: This creature is a channeler of the Abyss, and has access to a variety of deadly spells.
zhCN: 此生物能引导深渊之力，掌握多种致命法术。

enGB: Abyssal Gate
zhCN: 深渊之门

enGB:
You rip open a portal between the Material Plane and the Abyss, forcibly pulling a CR 17 (average) Demon through the nether to do your bidding.
 The summoned creature will attempt to resist the subtle charm component of this spell and gets a Will save (vs spell DC as charm spell) to resist, at a -8 disadvantage. If successful, the summoned creature will return to the Abyss after 3 rounds.
Creatures summoned in this way will attack your enemies to the best of their abilities, though they cannot be directly controlled.
zhCN:
你在物质位面与深渊之间撕开一道传送门，强行拉来一头平均CR 17的恶魔穿过幽冥听命于你。
被召生物会试图抵抗此法术中隐而不显的魅惑部分，并可按魅惑法术以法术DC进行意志豁免抵抗，处于-8劣势。若抵抗成功，被召生物将在3轮后返回深渊。
以此法召来的生物会尽力攻击你的敌人，但无法被直接操控。

enGB: Lord's Abyssal Gateway
zhCN: 领主的深渊门径

enGB:
You tear a massive hole in reality directly to the Abyss, forcibly pulling a CR 20 (average) Demon through the nether to do your bidding.
 The summoned creature will attempt to resist the subtle charm component of this spell and gets a Will save (vs spell DC as charm spell) to resist, at a -10 disadvantage. If successful, the summoned creature will return to the Abyss after 3 rounds, and will attempt to kill you before doing so.
Creatures summoned in this way will attack your enemies to the best of their abilities, though they cannot be directly controlled.
zhCN:
你在现实上撕开一道直通深渊的巨洞，强行拉来一头平均CR 20的恶魔穿过幽冥听命于你。
被召生物会试图抵抗此法术中隐而不显的魅惑部分，并可按魅惑法术以法术DC进行意志豁免抵抗，处于-10劣势。若抵抗成功，被召生物将在3轮后返回深渊，且临走前会试图杀死你。
以此法召来的生物会尽力攻击你的敌人，但无法被直接操控。

enGB: Among the depraved mortal followers of Evil and Madness, there exist those who fully commit themselves beyond the simple pursuit of power, and instead, seek to usher in the total destruction and annihilation of everything. Half depraved, half insane, these individuals devote both body and soul to the ritual summoning of Abyssal Demons to the Material plane... though some remain sane and justify their actions before some even greater evil. Abyssal Ritualists become hideously deformed over time and the most powerful among them are frequently mistaken as Demons themselves, sometimes even taking on aspects of Demons.
zhCN: 在邪恶与疯狂的堕落凡人信徒中，有些人并不满足于单纯追逐力量，而是致力于促成万物的彻底毁灭与湮灭。他们半是堕落、半是癫狂，把身心尽数献给将深渊恶魔仪式召唤至物质位面的勾当……也有少数人仍保持清醒，以某种更宏大的邪恶之名替自己的行径辩护。深渊仪式师会随时间推移变得形貌可怖，其中最强者常被误认为恶魔本身，有时甚至会显出恶魔之相。

enGB: Abyssal Ritualist
zhCN: 深渊仪式师

enGB: Abyssal Conduit
zhCN: 深渊导能

enGB:
Legend tells of abyssal ritualists that have become damned beyond measure, able to warp both their soul and body allowing a greater Demon from the abyss to enter our reality. This ability allows the abyssal ritualist to attempt to bring forth an extremely powerful Demon to assist them.
First, you will be slowed and confused for two rounds, as your body prepares to be used by the Abyss as a conduit of power.
Then, roll a d20 - if you roll a natural 20, an extremely powerful elder Demon, or Demon Lord will be summoned to your location for 5 rounds. Otherwise, a CR 18-22 greater Demon will be summoned for one minute instead to assist you.
The otherworldly stress of allowing such powers to ravage and use your body will paralyze you for 2 rounds and you will take 3d12 Unholy damage.
zhCN:
传说中有些深渊仪式师已堕落至无可救药，能够扭曲自身的灵魂与躯体，让来自深渊的高等恶魔踏入我们的现实。此能力使深渊仪式师得以尝试召来一头极强大的恶魔助战。
首先，你会受到缓慢与困惑影响2轮，因为深渊正准备把你的躯体当作力量导管。
随后投掷d20：若掷出天然20，一头极强大的上古恶魔或恶魔领主会被召到你所在位置，持续5轮；否则改为召唤一头CR 18–22的高等恶魔，持续1分钟助战。
任由此等力量肆虐并借用你的躯体所带来的异界压力，会使你麻痹2轮，并受到3d12点邪秽伤害。

任由此等力量肆虐并借用你的躯体所带来的异界压力，会使你麻痹4轮，并受到6d12点邪秽伤害。

enGB: Ability Boost — Constitution (+2)
zhCN: 属性增强：体质（+2）

enGB:
As an abyssal ritualist levels in this prestige class, they become infused with Abyssal energy and become much harder to kill, as well as infusing their mind.
At 2nd, 4th, and 6th levels, an abyssal ritualist gains a +2 increase to the character's Constitution score and a +1 increase to their Charisma and Wisdom. These bonuses stack with themselves and all other bonuses.
zhCN:
随着深渊仪式师在此进阶职业中提升等级，深渊能量会浸润其身躯与心智，使其更难被杀死。
在2级、4级和6级时，深渊仪式师的体质值+2，魅力与感知各+1。这些加值可彼此叠加，也可与所有其它加值叠加。

zhCN: 召唤妄乱魔

enGB:
This ability summons a Vrock for 1 minute. Summoned monsters appear where you designate and act according to their initiative check results. They attack your opponents to the best of their ability.
In addition, you feel more capable of summoning demons from the Abyss - if you are a Mythical Demon, you may use your highest summon ability twice per day instead of once.
zhCN:
此能力召唤一只{g|Vrocks}妄乱魔{/g}，持续1分钟。召唤来的怪物会在你指定的位置出现，并根据其{g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}先攻{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}结果行动。它们会尽全力{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}你的敌人。
此外，你自深渊召唤恶魔的本领更为精进——若你是神话恶魔，你最高阶的召唤能力可每日使用两次而非一次。

enGB:

At 3rd level, they gain 10 resistance to both Fire and Unholy damage. At 7th level, these bonuses increase to 20, and the abyssal ritualist gains a +1 saving throw against Demons.

3级时，获得10点火焰与邪秽伤害抗性。7级时，这些加值提升至20，并在对抗恶魔的豁免检定上获得+1加值。

enGB: Divine Spellcasting
zhCN: 神术施法

enGB:
At 2nd level, and at every level thereafter, an Abyssal Ritualist gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. At 1st level, and every level thereafter, he gains spells known in this way. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known, and an increased effective level of spellcasting.
If a character had more than one divine spellcasting class before becoming an Abyssal Ritualist, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.
zhCN:
自2级起，以及此后每提升1级，深渊仪式师获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在加入该进阶职业之前所属的某一神术施法职业也提升了1级。自1级起、以及此后每级，他以此方式获得已知法术。但除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，他不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
若角色在成为深渊仪式师之前拥有多个神术施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定每日法术数量。

enGB: An arrow of acid springs from your hand and speeds to its target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to hit your target. The arrow deals 2d6 points of acid damage with no splash damage. For every three caster levels you possess, the acid, unless neutralized, lasts for another round (to a maximum of 6 additional rounds at 18th level), dealing another 2d6 points of damage in each round.
zhCN: 一支强酸箭矢从你手中射出，高速射向敌人。你必须成功进行远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}才可命中目标。箭矢造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}酸蚀伤害{/g}，无泼溅{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。除非被中和，否则酸蚀伤害将额外持续1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}/每三个{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}（最大在18级额外持续6轮），每轮额外造成2d6点伤害。

enGB:
Adamantine is extremely strong and favored by weapon and armor smiths alike for its ability to cut through solid barriers with ease and endure heavy blows.
Armor made from adamantine grants its wearer {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}damage reduction{/g} of 1/- if it's light armor, 3/- if it's medium armor, and 5/- if it's heavy armor. Adamantine is so costly that weapons and armor made from it are always of masterwork quality; the masterwork cost is included in the prices given. Thus, adamantine weapons and ammunition have a +1 enhancement {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}, and the armor {g|Encyclopedia:Check}check{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} of adamantine armor is lessened by 1 compared to ordinary armor of its type. Items without metal parts cannot be made from adamantine. An arrow could be made of adamantine, but a quarterstaff could not.
zhCN:
精金极为坚硬，它能够轻易地击穿坚固的屏障，也能够承受沉重的{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}，因此武器与盔甲工匠都对它爱不释手。
由精金打造的盔甲能使其穿戴者获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}，数值视盔甲类型而定。轻甲给予的伤害减免为1/—，中甲则为3/—，重甲5/—。精金相当昂贵，因此用它打造的武器跟盔甲必然为精制品；精制品的价格已包含在给出的价格中。因此，精金武器与弹药在命中上获得+1增强{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，且精金盔甲的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Check_Penalty}防具检定减值{/g}与一般的同类盔甲相比，减少1点。不含金属部分的物品无法由精金制造。箭矢可以用精金打造，但木杖就不行。

精金极为坚硬，它能够轻易地击穿坚固的屏障，也能够承受沉重的{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}，因此武器与盔甲工匠都对它爱不释手。
由精金打造的盔甲能使其穿戴者获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}，数值视盔甲类型而定。轻甲给予的伤害减免为1/—，中甲则为3/—，重甲5/—。精金相当昂贵，因此用它打造的武器跟盔甲必然为精制品；精制品的价格已包含在给出的价格中。因此，精金武器与弹药在命中上获得+1增强{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，且精金盔甲的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Check_Penalty}防具检定减值{/g}与一般的同类盔甲相比，减少1点。不含金属部分的物品无法由精金制造。箭矢可以用精金打造，但木杖就不行。

enGB:
Made using one of the hardest and most precious substances, the adamantine golem is a deadly work of art. It can crush the life from foes that dare to get in its way and is nearly impossible to permanently destroy. The vast amount of adamantine required to build even one of these destructive golems is so significant that most worlds do not have enough resources, forcing the creator to travel to the Plane of Earth or remote Outer Planes simply to gather the raw materials needed to build the golem’s body.
 Adamantine is an incredibly powerful material, and yet it has a curious weakness to holy energy, and breaks apart readily from attacks by angels and their kin.
zhCN:
精金魔像以最坚硬、最珍贵的物质之一打造，是致命的艺术品。它能把挡路之敌的生命碾碎，且几乎无法被彻底摧毁。即便只造一具这等毁灭机器，所需的精金数量也极其惊人，多数世界都凑不出足够的资源，创造者不得不远赴土元素位面或偏远的外层位面，只为收集铸造魔像躯体所需的原料。
精金是威力惊人的材料，却对神圣能量有一处奇特弱点：在天使及其同类的攻击下会轻易崩裂。

enGB: Adamantine golems, being some of the most difficult to construct golems in existence, are also immensely resistant to most forms of energy. Though, due to the source of Adamantine itself, they are quite vulnerable to holy damage as well as electricity.

You release a powerful stroke of energy that deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of holy {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}. The target needs to make a successful {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g}, or become prone.

enGB:
Angel's Halo now emanates an aura similar to the effect of holy aura {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}.
A brilliant divine radiance surrounds the subjects, protecting them from {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attacks{/g}, granting them {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}resistance to spells{/g} cast by evil creatures, and causing evil creatures to become blinded when they strike the subjects. This abjuration has four effects.
First, each warded creature gains a +4 deflection {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} and a +4 resistance bonus on {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saves{/g}. Unlike protection from evil, this benefit applies against all attacks, not just against attacks by evil creatures.
Second, each warded creature gains spell resistance 25 + Angel's mythic rank against evil spells and spells cast by evil creatures.
Third, the abjuration protects from all mind-affecting spells and effects.
Finally, if an evil creature succeeds on a {g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttack}melee attack{/g} against a creature warded by a holy aura, the offending attacker is blinded (Fortitude save negates, as blindness, but against holy aura's save {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g}).
zhCN:
天使光环现在可产生类似{g|SpellsHolyAura}神圣灵光{/g}的法术效果。
耀眼的圣洁光芒帮助受术者防御{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}，提供对{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}邪恶{/g}生物所施放法术的抵抗能力，并使邪恶生物在击中受术者时{g|ConditionBlind}目盲{/g}。此防护法术具有4种效果。
首先，每个受保护生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级（AC）{/g}获得+4偏斜{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免{/g}获得+4抗力加值。与{g|SpellsProtectionFromEvil}防护邪恶{/g}不同的是，这些加值对所有攻击都有效，而非仅针对邪恶生物的攻击。
其次，每个受保护生物在受到邪恶法术或邪恶生物所施放的法术影响时，获得25+天使神话阶层的{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}。
再次，此防护效果可阻挡所有影响心智的法术和效应。
最后，如果邪恶生物的{g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttack}近战攻击{/g}成功击中了受保护生物，攻击者将目盲（通过强韧豁免可免除该效果，效果如同{g|SpellsBlindness}目盲术{/g}，但豁免{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}等于10+天使的{g|Encyclopedia:Character_Level}角色等级{/g}的一半+神话阶层+最高的属性调整值。）

enGB: You take on an aspect of an angelic being, including some of its physical characteristics - however, if you are evil-aligned, you will we be staggered while in this angelic form as it clashes with the energies of your soul. You gain resistance to acid and cold 10, a +2 sacred bonus to WIS/CHA/DEX/STR,  and DR 5/evil. You also gain a +2 sacred bonus to AC and a +2 sacred bonus on saves against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures. In addition, your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered good-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
zhCN: 你呈现出天界存在的一面，包括一些躯体特征——但若你属于邪恶阵营，此天使之貌会与灵魂能量相冲突，令你在此期间陷入{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}。你获得酸蚀与寒冷抗性10、感知／魅力／敏捷／力量各+2神圣加值，以及{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}5/邪恶。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}获得+2神圣加值，对抗邪恶生物发动的攻击或创造的效果时{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}获得+2神圣加值。此外，你的天生武器与所持武器在克服伤害减免时视为善良阵营。

enGB:
This spell functions like angelic aspect, except you gain DR 15/evil, immunity to acid and cold, resistance to electricity and fire 10 and unholy 20,  a +3 sacred bonus to WIS/CHA/DEX/STR, a +4 racial bonus on saves against poison, and protective aura as supernatural ability for the duration of the spell. If an evil creature attempts to cast this spell, they will be staggered until the spell is removed.
The protective aura provides a +3 sacred bonus to AC and a +3 sacred bonus on saving throws against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures to anyone within 20 feet. Otherwise, it functions as a magic circle against evil and a lesser globe of invulnerability, both with a radius of 20 feet.
Angelic Aspect: You take on an aspect of an angelic being, including some of its physical characteristics. You gain resistance to acid and cold 10, and DR 5/evil. You also gain a +2 deflection bonus to AC and a +2 resistance bonus on saves against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures. In addition, your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered good-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
zhCN:
此法术效果类似{g|SpellsAngelicAspect}天使之貌{/g}，但你改为获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}15/邪恶、酸蚀与寒冷免疫、电击与火焰抗性10、邪秽抗性20、感知／魅力／敏捷／力量各+3神圣加值、对抗毒素豁免+4种族加值，并在法术持续期间获得天佑灵光作为超自然能力。若邪恶生物试图施展此法术，将陷入{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}，直到法术被移除。
天佑灵光为20英尺内所有生物提供{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}+3神圣加值，以及对抗邪恶生物发动的攻击或创造的效果时{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}+3神圣加值。其余方面，其效果等同于半径20英尺的反邪恶法阵与次级法术无效结界。
天使之貌：你获得天界存在的形貌，包括部分躯体特征。你获得酸蚀与寒冷抗性10、伤害减免5/邪恶，防御等级获得+2偏斜加值，对抗邪恶生物发动的攻击或创造的效果时豁免获得+2抗性加值。此外，你的天生武器与所持武器在克服伤害减免时视为善良阵营。

enGB:
The target animal's body grows more muscled and massive than normal and becomes heavier. This alteration grants the animal a +12 size {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} and a +8 size bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} (and thus an extra 4 {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} per HD), and imposes a –2 size {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g}. The creature's existing natural armor bonus to AC increases by 2 and, due to the sheer bulk of it's body, is able to withstand physical attacks better, and gains DR -/5.
This size change also affects the animal's modifier to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}. Multiple magical effects that increase size do not stack.
zhCN:
目标动物的躯体变得比平常更加肌肉虬结、庞然沉重。此变化令动物获得+12体型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}与+8体型加值的{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}（因此每个{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰{/g}额外获得4点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}），并使其{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}承受–2体型{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。该生物现有的天生防御加值提高2点，且因躯体极其庞大而更能承受物理攻击，并获得伤害减免-/5。
体型变化同样影响该动物的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}调整值。多个增大体型的魔法效果不叠加。

enGB: Whenever the wielder of this legendary scythe confirms a {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical hit{/g}, it deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}15d6{/g} force {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} to all enemies in a 15 feet cone area, including the target.
zhCN: 当这把+5{g|EnhancementKeen}锐锋{/g}巨镰的持用者确认{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}时，可以对15英尺锥形区域内所有敌人造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}15d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}力场伤害{/g}，包括目标。

enGB: A creature with this feature has perfected their body to such an extent that they represent the apex of mortal health. They gain 1.5 HP for each point of constitution past 20, in addition to a further 1 HP per level.
zhCN: 拥有此特性的生物已将躯体锤炼至凡俗体魄的巅峰。体质超过20点后，每多1点便获得1.5点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}，此外每人物等级再获得1点生命值。

enGB: Apex Toughness
zhCN: 巅峰坚韧

enGB:
Any chaotic evil, chaotic good, lawful evil, or lawful good creatures within the area of this spell suffer the following ill effects:
If the creature's HD is equal to your caster level, it is sickened.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 1, it is staggered and sickened.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 5, it is nauseated, staggered, and sickened.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 10, it is killed, nauseated, staggered, and sickened.
The effects are cumulative and concurrent. A successful Will save reduces or eliminates these effects. Creatures affected by multiple effects make only one save and apply the result to all of the effects. Creatures whose Hit Dice exceed your caster level are unaffected by arbitrament.
Finally, Outsiders are knocked prone for 1 round as they are pushed slightly back towards equilibrium.
zhCN:
在该{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}的范围内，任何{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}混乱邪恶生物、混乱善良生物、守序邪恶生物、或者守序善良生物{/g}都会受到以下不良效果影响：
如果生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}等于你的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}，它陷入{g|ConditionSickened}恶心{/g}状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低1级，它陷入{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}和恶心状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低5级，它陷入{g|ConditionNauseated}反胃{/g}、恍惚和恶心状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低10级，它陷入反胃、恍惚和恶心状态，并且死亡。
这些效果互相累积并且同时生效。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}成功将减少或者抵消这些效果。受到多个效果影响的生物，只需进行一次豁免检定，并将检定结果应用于所有效果。如果生物的生命骰数高于你的施法者等级，它将不受仲裁之语影响。

enGB: This archmage's robe grants its wearer a +2 DC increase to all spell schools, a +6 enhancement {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g}, a +4 enhancement bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g}, a +4 armor bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} and the ability to cast prediction of failure {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} once per day as a 15th level wizard, DC 46.

You become a Large shambling mound. You gain a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +6 size bonus to your Constitution, a -2 penalty to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, resist fire 20, and resist electricity 20. Your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet. You also have two 2d6 slam attacks, the constricting vines ability, and the poison ability.
Constricting Vines: A shambling mound's vines coil around any creature it hits with a slam attack. The shambling mound attempts a grapple maneuver check against its target, and on a successful check its vines deal 2d6+5 damage and the foe is grappled.
Grappled characters cannot move, and take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and a -4 penalty to Dexterity. Grappled characters attempt to escape every round by making a successful combat maneuver, Strength, Athletics, or Mobility check. The DC of this check is the shambling mound's CMD.
Each round, creatures grappled by a shambling mound suffer 4d6+Strength modifier × 2 damage.
A shambling mound receives a +4 bonus on grapple maneuver checks.
Poison:
Slam; Save: Fortitude
Frequency: 1/round for 2 rounds
Effect: 1d2 Strength and 1d2 Dexterity damage
Cure: 1 save
The save DC is Constitution-based.

You become a Large shambling mound. You gain a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +6 size bonus to your Constitution, a -2 penalty to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, resist fire 20, and resist electricity 20. Your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet. You also have two 2d6 slam attacks, the constricting vines ability, and the poison ability.

Grappled characters cannot move, and take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and a -4 penalty to Dexterity. Grappled characters attempt to escape every round by making a successful combat maneuver, Strength, Athletics, or Mobility check. The DC of this check is the shambling mound's CMD.
Each round, creatures grappled by a shambling mound suffer 4d6+Strength modifier × 2 damage.
A shambling mound receives a +4 bonus on grapple maneuver checks.

If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 1, it is weakened and dazed.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 5, it is paralyzed, weakened, and dazed.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 10, it is killed, paralyzed, weakened, and dazed.
The effects are cumulative and concurrent. A successful Will save reduces or eliminates these effects. Creatures affected by multiple effects make only one save and apply the result to all of the effects. Creatures whose Hit Dice exceed your caster level are unaffected by blasphemy.
Finally, Good Outsiders are blasted by 4d6 unholy damage as their form partially corrupts.
zhCN:
任何处于渎神之语{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围内的非邪恶生物，必须承受以下有害效果：
如果该生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}等同于你的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}，则它陷入{g|ConditionDaze}眩晕{/g}。
如果该生物的生命骰数不大于你的施法者等级–1，则它陷入虚弱与眩晕。
如果该生物的生命骰数不大于你的施法者等级–5，则它陷入{g|ConditionParalyzed}麻痹{/g}、虚弱与眩晕。
如果该生物的生命骰不大于你的施法者等级–10，它将被杀死，并陷入麻痹、虚弱与眩晕状态。
以上效果可相互累计并同时生效。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}成功就能减少或抵销这些效果。受到多个效果影响的生物只能进行一次豁免检定，并将检定结果应用于所有效果上。如果生物的生命骰数高于你的施法者等级，则它不受渎神之语的影响。

enGB: With this prayer you provide long-lasting succor to a wounded creature. For as long as the effect lasts, the target receives a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and death effects. At any time while the spell is in effect, the target can choose to end the spell as a swift action for a burst of healing energy. The target loses the saving throw bonus, but is healed of 2d10 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).
zhCN: 通过该祷告你可以为一个受伤的生物提供长效援助。在{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}效果持续时间内，目标在对抗恐惧与即死效应的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上得到+2士气{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。在法术生效的任何时刻，目标可随时以{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}终止法术，得到一股爆发的{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}能量。目标将失去上述豁免检定加值，但恢复{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d10{/g}+每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}1点（最高+10）{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。

enGB: The target loses the saving throw bonus, but is healed of 2d10 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).
zhCN: 目标将失去{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，但{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}恢复{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d10{/g}点+每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}1点（最高+10）{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。

enGB: Undead Blessing Resistances and Immunities
zhCN: 亡者赐福抗性与免疫

enGB:
This creature has become undead and their body is completely immune to Poison, Disease, Sickened, Fatigue, Exhaustion, Nausea and bleed. They are also immune to ability damage, but still take a small amount of damage to their health when resisting such effects. Their mind has also been hardened, and they are completely immune to Fear, Emotion, Fright and Sleep. In addition, they are highly resistant to Mind Affecting spells (+8 save throw).
Finally, all Undead have an innate resistance (+8 save) to Death spells, as these spells must reconfigure themselves to perform a more complicated Final Death on such an entity.
zhCN:
此生物已化为不死生物，其躯体完全免疫毒素、疾病、恶心、疲乏、力竭、反胃与流血。它们也免疫属性伤害，但在抵抗此类效果时仍会受到少量生命值损伤。其心智亦被淬硬，完全免疫恐惧、情绪、惊恐与睡眠。此外，它们对影响心智的法术有高度抗性（豁免检定+8）。
最后，所有不死生物对死亡法术都有天生抗性（豁免+8），因为这类法术必须重新调整自身，才能对此类存在施行更为复杂的“终末之死”。

enGB: This +5 artifact estoc is blessed with the prayer of a legendary angel from heaven - it has an increased {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical{/g} multiplier and whenever it confirms a critical hit, it has a chance to blind the target with no save possible.
zhCN: 这柄+5神器细身剑受天上某位传奇天使的祷言祝福，拥有更高的{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}倍数；每次确认重击时，都有机会令目标{g|ConditionBlind}目盲{/g}，且无法豁免。

enGB:
First, you gain a +1 AC bonus due to the semi-controllable nature of your blinking in and out of the ethereal plane. Second, physical attacks against you have a 50% miss chance and the Blind Fight feat doesn't help opponents, since you're ethereal and not merely invisible. If the attack is capable of striking ethereal creatures, the miss chance is only 20% (for concealment). Any individually targeted spell has a 50% chance to fail against you while you're blinking unless your attacker can target invisible, ethereal creatures.
If the attacker can see invisible creatures, the miss chance is also only 20%. For an attacker who can both see and strike ethereal creatures, there is no miss chance.
Likewise, your own attacks have a 20% miss chance. While blinking, you take only half damage from area attacks (but full damage from those that extend onto the Ethereal Plane). Although you are only partially visible, you are not considered invisible and targets retain their Dexterity bonus to AC against your attacks. You do receive a +2 bonus on attack rolls made against enemies that cannot see invisible creatures.
zhCN:
对你发动的物理{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}有50%几率失手，由于你处于灵化状态而非仅仅{g|ConditionInvisible}隐形{/g}，即便对手有“盲斗”{g|Encyclopedia:Feat}专长{/g}也无济于事。若该攻击能够击中灵体生物，那么失手率仅为20%（因{g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}隐蔽{/g}效果而失手）。任何对你施放的单体{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}有50%几率失败，除非施法者能够以隐形生物和灵体生物为目标。
假如攻击者能够看见隐形生物，失手率同样仅有20%。对于同时能够看见和击中灵体生物的攻击者而言，不会有失手几率。
同样，你自己发动的攻击也有20%失手率。在闪现期间，范围攻击对你只会造成一半{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}（但能够延伸到灵界位面的范围攻击会造成全部伤害）。虽然只有部分可见，但你不被视为隐形状态，目标在对抗你的攻击时也能够保留{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级（AC）{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。你在对看不见隐形生物的敌人发动攻击时，攻击检定会获得+2加值。

enGB: At 20th level, your soul becomes one with the world of the fey. You gain immunity to poison and {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} 30/cold iron. Once per day, you can cast cloak of dreams as a {g|Encyclopedia:Special_Abilities}spell-like ability{/g} using your sorcerer level as your {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}.
zhCN: 达到20级后，你的灵魂融入了妖精的世界。你获得毒素免疫和{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}30/寒铁。你能够以{g|Encyclopedia:Special_Abilities}类法术能力{/g}每天施放1次{g|SpellsCloakOfDreams}梦境护幕{/g}，使用术士等级作为{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}。

enGB:
You become a Large shambling mound. You gain a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +6 size bonus to your Constitution, a -2 penalty to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, resist fire 20, and resist electricity 20. Your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet. You also have two 2d6 slam attacks, the constricting vines ability, and the poison ability.
Constricting Vines: A shambling mound's vines coil around any creature it hits with a slam attack. The shambling mound attempts a grapple maneuver check against its target, and on a successful check its vines deal 2d6+5 damage and the foe is grappled.
Grappled characters cannot move, and take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and a -4 penalty to Dexterity. Grappled characters attempt to escape every round by making a successful combat maneuver, Strength, Athletics, or Mobility check. The DC of this check is the shambling mound's CMD.
Each round, creatures grappled by a shambling mound suffer 4d6+Strength modifier × 2 damage.
A shambling mound receives a +4 bonus on grapple maneuver checks.
Poison:
Slam; Save: Fortitude
Frequency: 1/round for 2 rounds
Effect: 1d2 Strength and 1d2 Dexterity damage
Cure: 1 save
The save DC is Constitution-based.
zhCN:
你变成一只大型蔓生怪。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}获得+6体型{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}获得+6体型加值，{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}承受–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，获得+4天生防御加值、20点火焰{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}抗性{/g}与20点电击抗性。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}移动速度{/g}降低10英尺。你还拥有两次{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g}的挥击攻击，以及紧勒藤蔓与毒素能力。
紧勒藤蔓：蔓生怪以挥击命中生物后，藤蔓会将其缠住。蔓生怪对该目标进行一次{g|FeatureGrab}擒抱{/g}战技检定，检定成功则藤蔓造成2d6+5点伤害，并使敌人陷入擒抱。
被擒抱的角色无法移动，所有{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}承受–2减值，敏捷承受–4减值。被擒抱的角色每轮可尝试通过成功的战技、力量、运动或灵巧检定挣脱，检定{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}等于蔓生怪的{g|Encyclopedia:CMD}战技防御{/g}。
每轮，被蔓生怪擒抱的生物受到4d6+力量调整值×2点伤害。
蔓生怪在擒抱战技检定上获得+4加值。
毒素：
挥击；{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免{/g}：强韧
频率：每轮1次，持续2轮
效果：1d2力量伤害与1d2敏捷伤害
痊愈：1次豁免成功
豁免难度等级基于体质。

enGB:
You become a large smilodon. You have a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +2 size bonus to your Constitution and a +4 natural armor bonus. Your movement speed is increased by 10 feet. You also have four 1d8 claw attacks, one 2d6 bite attack, and the pounce ability.
Pounce: When a smilodon makes a charge, it can make a full attack.
zhCN:
你现在变身为剑齿虎形态。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量属性{/g}获得+6{g|Encyclopedia:Size}体型{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷属性{/g}承受–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，并获得+4天生{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御加值{/g}。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}移动速度{/g}提高10英尺。你还拥有4次可造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点伤害的爪抓攻击，1次可造成2d6点伤害的啮咬攻击，以及猛扑能力。
猛扑：剑齿虎冲锋后可进行一次整轮攻击。

enGB: You become a large wyvern. You have a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +2 dodge bonus, and a +5 natural armor bonus. Your movement speed is increased by 10 feet. You also have one 2d6 bite attack, two 1d6 talon attacks, and one 1d6 sting attack that applies  poison to your target.
zhCN: 你变成一只大型双足飞龙。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}获得+6体型加值、+2闪避加值与+5天生防御加值，{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}移动速度{/g}提高10英尺。你还获得一次2d6啮咬、两次1d6爪抓，以及一次1d6螫刺攻击，螫刺会令目标中毒。

enGB: This ancient oversized greatsword deals an additional {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}20d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}slashing damage{/g} to enemies below 30% of their maximum {g|Encyclopedia:HP}Hit Points{/g}.
zhCN: 这柄古旧巨型巨剑对{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}低于上限30%的敌人额外造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}20d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}挥砍伤害{/g}。

enGB: The breath of even Juvenile dragons is extremely powerful. Blue dragons in particular utilize the primordial energy of lightning to power their breath attack. Deal 18d6 electric damage in a massive 80 ft line.
zhCN: 即便是幼龙的吐息也极为强大。蓝龙尤其会引动闪电的原初能量为吐息供能。在80英尺长的巨型直线上造成18d6点电击伤害。

enGB: Twisted Mind
zhCN: 扭曲心智

enGB:
You make your spells deal additional area of effect damage, while making them stronger.
Benefit: Spell now deals 2 more points of damage per dice rolled to all its targets. Additionally, all enemies in 5 feet of the spell targets are dealt 2 damage per dice rolled of the original spell. The spell can no longer apply precision damage.
Level Increase: +2 (A bolstered spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's actual level.)
zhCN:
你让你的{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}造成额外的范围{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}，同时变得更加强大。
效果：法术现在每有一个伤害{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}骰{/g}，便对其所有目标额外造成2点伤害。此外，在{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Target}法术目标{/g}5英尺内的敌人也会受到该法术每个伤害骰2点伤害。该法术不再能附加精准伤害。
等级提升：+2（增效法术需要使用比该法术实际等级高1级的法术位。）

enGB:
Implacable automatons of elemental fire and extraplanar brass, these golems stand sentinel over the palaces, treasuries, and harems of their creators. Brass golems are 24 feet tall and weigh 18,000 pounds.
 They are the most common form of golem that sport defenses against extra-planar damage sources, and do not have any glaring weaknesses (though they are not as durable as iron golems and their kin).
zhCN:
这些由元素之火与异界黄铜构成的无情自动机，常年为创造者守卫宫殿、宝库与后宫。黄铜魔像高24英尺，重18000磅。
它们是最常见的一类对跨位面伤害具备防护的魔像，且没有明显弱点（不过耐久不及铁魔像及其同类）。

enGB: Brass Golem
zhCN: 黄铜魔像

enGB: Brass golems are very resistant against most natural energy sources, and they are not vulnerable to electricity, as opposed to most other metal-derived golems.
zhCN: 黄铜魔像对绝大多数自然能量都有很高抗性，而且与多数金属魔像不同，它并不惧怕电击。

enGB: Brass Golem Resistances
zhCN: 黄铜魔像抗性

enGB: Bulwark gains {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}damage reduction{/g} 4/-. At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter it increases by 2.
zhCN: 壁垒动物伙伴获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}4/—。4级时，以及之后每提升4个等级，伤害减免都会提高2点。

enGB: Allies in the area of this spell at the time of casting gain a +2 sacred bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear effects, plus 2 temporary hit point per caster level (maximum 40).
zhCN: 施法时处于{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围之内的所有盟友在{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与对抗恐惧效应的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上获得+2崇圣{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，此外，获得每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}2点{g|Encyclopedia:Temporary_HP}临时生命值{/g}（最高40点）。

enGB: Allies in the area of this spell at the time of casting gain a +2 sacred bonus on attack rolls and saves against fear effects, plus 2 temporary hit point per caster level (maximum 40).
zhCN: 施法时处于{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围之内的所有盟友在{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}与对抗恐惧效应的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}上获得+2崇圣{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，此外，获得每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}2点{g|Encyclopedia:Temporary_HP}临时生命值{/g}（最高40点）。

enGB: Each time an enemy lands a hit on the wielder of this god-forged rapier, it gains a stacking +5 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage rolls{/g} until the end of the battle.
zhCN: 每当这把+5无序秘银细剑的持用者被敌人命中，它即会在{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害检定{/g}上获得可叠加的+5{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，直到战斗结束。

enGB: Immediately upon completion of the spell, and once per round thereafter, you may call down a 6-foot-wide, 30-foot-long, vertical bolt of lightning that deals 8d6 points of electricity damage. The bolt of lightning flashes down in a vertical stroke at whatever target point you choose within the spell's range (measured from your position at the time). Any creature in the target square or in the path of the bolt is affected. You need not call a bolt of lightning immediately; other actions, even spellcasting, can be performed first. Each round after the first you may use a standard action (concentrating on the spell) to call a bolt. Each time you cast a bolt, the spell's duration is reduced by one minute.
zhCN: {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}施放完成时以及此后的每一{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}，你都可以召来一道6英尺宽、30英尺长的竖直闪电，对目标点造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}8d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}电击伤害{/g}。闪电垂直劈向法术距离内（以你当时的位置为准）你指定的任意目标点。处于目标点以及闪电路径上的一切生物都将受到影响。施法后你不必立即召唤雷电束，而是可以先执行其他{g|Encyclopedia:CA_Types}行动{/g}，甚至可以施法。在第一轮之后的每一轮，你都能以{g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}标准动作{/g}（{g|Encyclopedia:Concentration}专注{/g}于该法术）召来一道闪电。每次你召雷之后，法术持续时间都减少1分钟。

enGB: You may call down a 6-foot-wide, 30-foot-long, vertical bolt of lightning that deals 8d6 points of electricity damage. The bolt of lightning flashes down in a vertical stroke at whatever target point you choose within medium range.
zhCN: 你召来一道6英尺宽、30英尺长的竖直闪电，对目标点造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}8d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}电击伤害{/g}。闪电垂直劈向中距范围内你指定的任意目标点。

enGB: This creature may call down lightning bolts, dealing 8d6 electricity damage.
zhCN: 此生物可召来闪电，造成8d6点电击伤害。

enGB:
This spell functions like call lightning, except that each bolt deals 12d6 points of electricity damage at long range, and you may call a maximum of 15 bolts.
Call Lightning: Immediately upon completion of the spell, and once per round thereafter, you may call down a bolt of lightning that deals 3d6 points of electricity damage. The bolt of lightning flashes down in a vertical stroke at whatever target point you choose within the spell's range (measured from your position at the time). Any creature in the target square or in the path of the bolt is affected. You need not call a bolt of lightning immediately; other actions, even spellcasting, can be performed first. Each round after the first, you may use a standard action (concentrating on the spell) to call a bolt. Each time you cast a bolt, the spell's duration is reduced by one minute.

enGB: You may call down a vertical bolt of lightning that deals 12d6 points of electricity damage. The bolt of lightning flashes down in a vertical stroke at whatever target point you choose within long range.
zhCN: 你召来一道竖直闪电，对目标点造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}12d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}电击伤害{/g}。闪电垂直劈向远距范围内你指定的任意目标点。

enGB: The affected creature becomes frightened. If the subject succeeds at a Will save, it is shaken for 1 round. Creatures with 20 or more HD are immune to this effect.[LONGSTART] Cause fear dispels remove fear.[LONGEND]
zhCN: 受到法术影响的生物会陷入{g|ConditionFrightened}惊恐{/g}状态。如果目标{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}成功，则改为陷入{g|ConditionShaken}战栗{/g}状态1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}不低于20的生物免疫该效果。惊恐术能够解除{g|SpellsRemoveFear}移除恐惧{/g}。

enGB: Acid erupts from your space in all directions, causing 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) to creatures and unattended objects in the area. enGB: Celestial Gate
zhCN: 天界之门

enGB:
You carefully create a portal between the Material Plane and Celestia, forcibly pulling a CR 17 (average) Celestial through the nether to do your bidding.
 The summoned creature will attempt to resist the subtle charm component of this spell and gets a Will save (vs spell DC as charm spell) to resist, at a -8 disadvantage. If successful, the summoned creature will return to Celestia after 3 rounds.
Creatures summoned in this way will attack your enemies to the best of their abilities, though they cannot be directly controlled.
zhCN:
你小心翼翼地在物质位面与天界圣山之间开启一道传送门，强行拉来一头平均CR 17的天界生物穿过幽冥听命于你。
被召生物会试图抵抗此法术中隐而不显的魅惑部分，并可按魅惑法术以法术DC进行意志豁免抵抗，处于-8劣势。若抵抗成功，被召生物将在3轮后返回天界圣山。
以此法召来的生物会尽力攻击你的敌人，但无法被直接操控。

被召生物会试图抵抗此法术中隐而不显的魅惑部分，并可按魅惑法术以法术DC进行意志豁免抵抗，处于-4劣势。若抵抗成功，被召生物将在3轮后返回深渊。

enGB: Heavenly Gateway
zhCN: 天界门径

enGB:
With supernatural precision, you create a portal between the Material Plane and Celestia, beckoning a CR 19 (average) Celestial through the nether to do your bidding.
 The summoned creature will attempt to resist the subtle charm component of this spell (they may have more important missions to attend to) and gets a Will save (vs spell DC as charm spell) to resist, at a -10 disadvantage. If successful, the summoned creature will return to Celestia after 3 rounds.
Creatures summoned in this way will attack your enemies to the best of their abilities, though they cannot be directly controlled.
zhCN:
以超自然的精准，你在物质位面与天界圣山之间开启一道传送门，穿过幽冥召来一头平均CR 19的天界生物听命于你。
被召生物会试图抵抗此法术中隐而不显的魅惑部分（它们或许还有更要紧的使命），并可按魅惑法术以法术DC进行意志豁免抵抗，但处于-10劣势。若抵抗成功，被召生物将在3轮后返回天界圣山。
以此法召来的生物会尽力攻击你的敌人，但无法被直接操控。

enGB: Execute Celestial Planar Binding
zhCN: 执行天界位面束缚

enGB:
You execute the ritual, with the following effects:
Immediate Casting: A CR 5-9 Celestial from Heaven is summoned for 1 hour.
1 Previous Cast: CR 9-12
2 Previous Casts: CR 11-14
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): CR 13-18
When you finish this ritual, after 3 rounds, the Celestial summoned will attempt a Will save against your spell DC at -5 disadvantage. If the Celestial succeeds and throws off their bindings, they will likely punish you with holy fire and planeshift back to wence they came (they have better things to do with their time).

此前施法2次：CR 11–14
此前施法3次（上限）：CR 13–18
仪式完成后3轮，被召来的天界生物会以-5劣势对你的法术DC进行意志豁免。若成功挣脱束缚，它很可能会以圣火惩戒你，再位面转移返回来处（它们还有更要紧的事）。

enGB: Celestial Plea
zhCN: 天界祈愿

enGB:
Only non-evil casters may use this spell. 
Using a swift action, you send a very powerful inter-planar message directly to your god, asking for help in the form of a champion or cohort of creatures. The relationship between you and your god is such that a plea like this can only be made once every 16 hours (a form of respect and to protect the virtue of self-reliance), but at the same time, it's effects can potentially be very powerful.
Either a champion creature between CR 5-12, or a cohort (1D4) of creatures between CR 4-10 will heed your call. The power of creatures called is based on a Wisdom check (DC 20) made after casting this spell. There is also a very small chance for a more powerful CR 14+ creature to assist you, though this only can happen in times of dire need.
zhCN:
只有非邪恶阵营的施法者才能使用此法术。
以一个迅捷动作，你直接向你的神祇发出一道很强的跨位面讯息，请求以勇士或一群同伴的形式获得帮助。你与神祇的关系决定了这样的祈求每16小时只能进行一次（既是敬意，也是为了保全自恃之德），但其效果可能极为强大。
响应召唤的将是一头CR 5–12的勇士生物，或一群（1D4）CR 4–10的生物。被召生物的力量取决于施法后进行的感知检定（DC 20）。此外还有极小的概率得到一头更强的CR 14+生物相助，不过这只会在濒临绝境时发生。

enGB: Celestial Wolf
zhCN: 天界狼

enGB:
This spell creates an electrical discharge that begins as a single stroke commencing from your fingertips. [LONGSTART]Unlike lightning bolt, chain lightning strikes one object or creature initially, then arcs to other targets.[LONGEND]
The bolt deals 1d6 points of electricity damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) to the primary target. After it strikes, lightning can arc to a number of secondary targets equal to your caster level (maximum 20). The secondary bolts each strike one target and deal as much damage as the primary bolt.
Each target can attempt a Reflex saving throw for half damage. Secondary targets must be within 30 feet of the primary target, and no target can be struck more than once.
zhCN:
此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}会让你的指尖释放出闪电形成一次冲击。与{g|SpellsLightningBolt}闪电束{/g}不同，链状闪电先攻击一个物品或生物，然后形成电弧攻击其他目标。
这道闪电会对主要目标造成每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}电击伤害{/g}（最高20d6点）。链状闪电击中目标后，还可以弹射出电弧，攻击数目等于施法者等级（最高20个）的次要目标。每道击中次要目标的闪电会造成与主要目标相同的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。
每个目标都可以尝试{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g}以使受到的伤害减半。次要目标应在主要目标30英尺的范围内，并且只会受到一次攻击。

enGB:
You unleash chaotic power to smite your enemies. The power takes the form of a multicolored explosion of leaping, ricocheting energy. Only lawful and neutral (not chaotic) creatures are harmed by the spell.
The spell deals 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8) to lawful creatures (or 1d6 points of damage per caster level, maximum 10d6, plus an additional 2d10 divine damage, to lawful outsiders) and slows them for 1d6 rounds (see the slow spell). A successful Will save reduces the damage by half and negates the slow effect.
The spell deals only half damage against creatures who are neither lawful nor chaotic, and they are not slowed. Such a creature can reduce the damage by half again (down to one-quarter) with a successful Will save.
zhCN:
你释放出混沌能量重创敌人。能量会呈现为不断跳跃反弹的，色彩斑斓的形态。只有{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}守序和中立{/g}阵营（也就是非混乱阵营）的生物会受此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。
此法术可对守序阵营生物造成每两个{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点伤害（最高5d8点；对守序异界生物可造成每施法者等级1d6点伤害，最高10d6点）并令其缓慢1d6{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}（见{g|SpellsSlow}缓慢术{/g}）。通过成功的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免检定{/g}可使伤害减半并且免受缓慢效果。
此法术对并非守序也非混乱阵营的生物只造成一半伤害，也不会令其陷入{g|ConditionSlowed}缓慢{/g}状态。这些生物还可以通过成功的意志豁免检定，将伤害再次减半（降至原本的四分之一）。

enGB:
Whenever this +6 artifact anarchic warhammer confirms a {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical hit{/g}, it applies the effect of {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}Touch{/g} of chaos ability to the target. Being the warhammer of the long forgotten demigod of chaos Marzipan, no save is possible. 
Touch of chaos: You imbue the target with chaos. For the next {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}, anytime they {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}rolls{/g} a d20, they must roll twice and take the less favorable result.
zhCN:
每当这柄+6{g|EnhancementAnarchic}无序{/g}神器战锤确认一次{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}，便会对目标施加{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}混乱之触{/g}能力的效果。此锤乃久被遗忘的混沌半神玛齐潘之物，因而无法豁免。
混乱之触：你将混沌注入目标。在接下来1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}内，其每次{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}掷{/g}d20都必须掷两次并取较差结果。

enGB:
You can baffle and befuddle foes with a {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch{/g} or a smile, and your beauty and grace are divine - you gain a +2 bonus to your AC as attackers find it difficult to concentrate on hurting such a beautiful being.
Dazing Touch: You can cause a living creature to become dazed for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g} as a melee touch {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g}. Creatures with more {g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}Hit Dice{/g} than your level in the class that gave you access to this domain are unaffected. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.
Charming Smile: At 8th level, you can cast charm person as a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, with a {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} of 10 + 1/2 your level in the class that gave you access to this domain + your Wisdom modifier. The effect of charm person lasts for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}.
zhCN:
你的接触或仅是一个微笑，都足以挫败或困惑敌人，你的美丽与优雅都显得格外圣洁。

enGB: Circle of death snuffs out the life force of living creatures. The {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} slays {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g} HD worth of living creatures per {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} (maximum 20d4). Those who are closest to the burst's point of origin are affected first. All creatures with 9 or less HD are slain outright, while creatures with more than 9 HD take 100 {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} instead. HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted.
zhCN: 死亡法阵会消灭活物的生命力。此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}可杀死总{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}不超过每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g}（最高20d4）的活物。越接近法术爆发源头的活物越先受影响。生命骰数为9或更低的生物被立即杀死，而生命骰超过9的生物改为受到100点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。不足以影响一个生物的多余生命骰数忽略不计。

enGB:
You create two Colossal-sized masses of rock, dirt, and stone and slam them together against a single creature between them. The clashing rocks appear up to 30 feet away from the target on opposite sides and rush toward it with a mighty grinding crash. You must make a ranged touch attack to hit the target with the rocks. The clashing rocks ignore concealment. A creature struck by the clashing rocks takes 20d10 points of bludgeoning damage and is knocked prone.
If the clashing rocks miss the target, the target still takes 10d10 points of bludgeoning damage from falling rocks and is knocked prone. A successful Reflex save reduces this damage to half and the target remains standing. Creatures other than the target that occupy the spaces where the clashing rocks appear or within their path must also make Reflex saves or take 10d10 points of bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone (save for half and remain standing).
zhCN:
你在一个目标生物两侧造出两堆由岩块、泥土和石头组成的超巨型石山，并用它们猛击该目标生物。巨石会在离目标30英尺远的地方出现，势如破竹地向目标生物疾冲而去。你必须进行远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}检定以用巨石击中目标。巨石无视{g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}隐蔽{/g}效果。被巨石击中的生物受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}20d10{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}钝击伤害{/g}，并且被击倒为{g|ConditionProne}俯卧{/g}状态。
若巨石未命中目标，目标仍会承受来自坠落岩石的10d10点钝击伤害，并且被击倒。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g}成功能使所受伤害减半，且目标能保持站立姿势。除目标之外的其余生物若占据了巨石出现的空间或在巨石攻击的路线上，也必须进行反射豁免，失败将受到10d10点钝击伤害，并被击倒（豁免成功能使所受伤害减半且保持站立姿势）。

enGB:
At 2nd level, and at every level thereafter, an Abyssal Ritualist gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. At 1st level, and every level thereafter, he gains spells known in this way. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known, and an increased effective level of spellcasting.
If a character had more than one divine spellcasting class before becoming an Abyssal Ritualist, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.
zhCN:
自2级起，以及此后每提升1级，深渊仪式师获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在加入该进阶职业之前所属的某一神术施法职业也提升了1级。自1级起、以及此后每级，他以此方式获得已知法术。但除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，他不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
若角色在成为深渊仪式师之前拥有多个神术施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定每日法术数量。

10生命骰及以下：防御等级–1
10–20生命骰：防御等级–2
20生命骰以上：防御等级–3

enGB: Inescapable Chaos
zhCN: 无从逃脱的混乱

enGB:
Chanting an unholy litany, you {g|Encyclopedia:Reach}reach{/g} out with a grasping motion toward your target and cause its heart to leap out of its chest and into your hand.
A target with 4000 or fewer {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} remaining that fails its {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throw{/g} must immediately make an additional Will save. If this Will save is failed, it's heart bursts out of it's chest and it instantly dies. If the will save succeeds, the target still takes 4d4 points of {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} drain (temporarily) as it's heart is tramautized, but still remains in it's body.
A target with 4000 or more hit points that fails its saving throw manages to keep its heart from leaping out of its chest, but it is still staggered for 1 minute and takes {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} drain and 1d4 points of Constitution bleed.
Regardless of its current hit points, if the target succeeds at its Fortitude save, it is still staggered for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g} as it feels its heart wrenching within its chest.
zhCN:
你吟诵亵渎的祷文，{g|Encyclopedia:Reach}伸出手{/g}向目标做出攫抓之势，令其心脏从胸腔跃入你的掌心。
剩余{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}不超过4000点且{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}失败的目标必须立刻追加一次意志豁免。若此次意志豁免失败，心脏将破胸而出，目标立即死亡；若意志豁免成功，心脏虽留在体内，却因遭受重创而仍使目标暂时受到4d4点{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:AbilityDamage}属性伤害{/g}。
生命值不低于4000点且豁免失败的目标能够保住心脏，但仍会{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}1分钟，并受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g}点体质属性伤害与1d4点体质流血伤害。
无论当前生命值多少，目标即使强韧豁免成功，也会因心脏在胸腔中剧痛抽搐而{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。

enGB: As a melee {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g}, you can cause a living creature to take {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d20{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}. This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your level in the class that gave you access to this domain (minimum 1).[LONGSTART] You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.[LONGEND]
zhCN: 以近战{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}，你可使一个活物每{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d20{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。此效果持续轮数等于赋予你该领域的职业等级的一半（最低1轮）。[LONGSTART]此能力每日可用次数等于3＋你的{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值。[LONGEND]

enGB:
You can cause the living to bleed at a {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch{/g}, and find comfort in the presence of the dead.
Bleeding Touch: As a melee touch {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g}, you can cause a living creature to take {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d20{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}. This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your level in the class that gave you access to this domain (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.
{g|Encyclopedia:Injury_Death}Death{/g}'s Embrace: At 8th level, you {g|Encyclopedia:Healing}heal{/g} damage instead of taking damage from channeled negative energy. If the channeled negative energy targets undead, you heal {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} just like undead in the area.
If you are undead, then you instead do not take {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}damage from positive energy{/g}.
Domain {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Spells{/g}: cause fear, boneshaker, bestow curse, enervation, slay living, circle of death, destruction, horrid wilting, wail of the banshee.
zhCN:
你可在接触活物时使其血流不止，并在面对不死生物时获得力量。
流血之触：作为近战{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}，你可令一个活物每轮受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d20{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。此效果持续{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮数{/g}等于1/2赋予你此领域的职业等级（最低为1）。每天可使用次数为{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值+3。
死亡之拥：8级时，你会受到引导负向能量的{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}而不是受到伤害。如果引导负向能量的对象是不死生物，你将与范围内的不死生物一样恢复{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}。
如果你自身就是不死生物，则你将不会受到正向{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}能量伤害{/g}。
领域{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}：{g|SpellsCauseFear}惊恐术{/g}，{g|SpellsBoneshaker}颤骨{/g}，{g|SpellsBestowCurse}降咒{/g}，{g|SpellsEnervation}弱能术{/g}，{g|SpellsSlayLiving}杀生术{/g}，{g|SpellsCircleOfDeath}死亡法阵{/g}，{g|SpellsDestruction}灰飞烟灭{/g}，{g|SpellsHorridWilting}凋死术{/g}，{g|SpellsWailOfTheBanshee}女妖之嚎{/g}。

enGB: Whenever this mythical cold iron bardiche confirms a {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical hit{/g}, it deals an additional 6 {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g}.
zhCN: 当这把+1寒铁新月战斧确认{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}时，它会额外对{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}造成6点{g|Encyclopedia:AbilityDamage}伤害{/g}。

enGB:
This spell functions like sleep, except that it affects 25 HD of targets and the fatigue effect lasts for 5 rounds.
Sleep: A sleep spell causes a magical slumber to come upon 10 HD of creatures, and those who are closest to the spell's point of origin are affected first. HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted. Sleeping creatures are helpless. Wounding awakens an affected creature, but normal noise does not. Sleep does not target unconscious creatures, constructs, or undead creatures. In addition, all targets in the area must make a will save or suffer the effects of fatigue for two rounds.
zhCN:
此法术效果类似{g|SpellsSleep}睡眠术{/g}，但可影响总生命骰25的目标，且{g|ConditionFatigued}疲乏{/g}效果持续5轮。
睡眠术：睡眠术令总生命骰10的生物陷入魔法沉睡，越靠近法术爆发源头的生物越先受影响。不足以影响一个生物的多余生命骰数浪费掉。沉睡的生物处于无助状态。受伤会唤醒受影响的生物，但普通噪音不会。睡眠术不影响昏迷生物、构装体与亡者。此外，区域内所有目标都必须进行意志豁免，否则承受2轮疲乏效果。

enGB: Demodand's Shortsword of Celestial Revenge
zhCN: 德莫丹的天界复仇短剑

enGB: Demodands are mishapen, powerful titanspawn that exist purely to destroy the dieific forces that sent their progenitors to the Abyss. They are able to fly and even the weakest of their kind are capable of slamming their enemies with the powers of chaos.
zhCN: 德莫丹是形貌畸陋、力量强横的泰坦后裔，其存在只为摧毁当年把他们先祖放逐入深渊的神性势力。他们能够飞行，即便同族中最弱者也能以混乱之力猛击敌人。

enGB: Demodand
zhCN: 德莫丹

enGB: The titans’ sculpted paragons of might charred and melted, oozing into twisted shapes. These shapes, however, clung tenaciously to the spark of life imparted to them. Thus the demodands were born—a hideous race of creatures imbued with the fickle cruelty of their masters. Misshapen and foul to behold, demodands are known by some scholars as titanspawn. Despite their physical repulsiveness, however, all demodands possess a drop of their creators’ titanic power. This trace of near-divine power makes them as formidable as they are vicious, and many demon lords have spent years, if not centuries, waging wars, foiling raids, and undoing the damage that demodands cause.
zhCN: 泰坦所雕琢的力量典范被灼烧熔化，流淌成扭曲的形体。然而这些形体死死攥住了被赋予的生命火花。德莫丹由此诞生——一个承袭了主人无常残酷的可憎种族。德莫丹形貌畸陋、望之欲呕，有些学者称其为泰坦后裔。尽管外表令人厌恶，所有德莫丹都承着创造者一丝泰坦之力。这份近乎神力的余泽使它们既凶残又可畏，许多恶魔领主为此耗费数年乃至数百年征战、挫败突袭、收拾德莫丹留下的残局。

zhCN: 德莫丹

zhCN: 此生物乃泰坦之后裔，高度抵抗位面能量类型。

enGB: Demonic Aspect
zhCN: 恶魔之相

enGB: You take on an aspect of a demonic being, including some of its physical characteristics - however, if you are good or neutral-aligned, you will be staggered while in this demonic form as it clashes with the energies of your soul. You gain resistance to acid and fire 10, a +4 profane bonus to STR and CON, and DR 5/good. You also gain a +2 profane bonus on saves against attacks made or effects created by good creatures. In addition, your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered evil-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
zhCN: 你呈现出恶魔存在的一面，包括一些躯体特征——但若你属于善良或中立阵营，此恶魔之貌会与灵魂能量相冲突，令你在此期间陷入{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}。你获得酸蚀与火焰抗性10、{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}各+4亵渎加值，以及{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}5/善良。对抗善良生物发动的攻击或创造的效果时，你的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}获得+2亵渎加值。此外，你的天生武器与所持武器在克服伤害减免时视为邪恶阵营。

enGB: Demonic Aspect, Greater
zhCN: 高等恶魔之相

enGB:
You take on the aspect of a powerful demonic being, including some of its physical characteristics - however, if you are good or neutral-aligned, you will be staggered while in this demonic form as it clashes with the energies of your soul. 
You gain immunity to acid, fire and electricity, 10 resistance to holy and unholy damage, a +6 profane bonus to STR and CON, 10 Fast Healing and DR 15/good. You also gain a +2 profane bonus on saves and AC against attacks made or effects created by ALL creatures. Finally your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered evil-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
zhCN:
你显化强大恶魔之相，连同其部分形体特征——不过若你为善良或中立阵营，此形态会与你灵魂的能量相冲，令你在恶魔形态下陷入踉跄。
你获得强酸、火焰与电击免疫，神圣与邪秽伤害各10点抗性，力量与体质+6亵渎加值，快速回复10，以及DR 15/善良。面对所有生物发起的攻击与造出的效果，你的豁免与AC还获得+2亵渎加值。最后，你的天生武器与所持武器在穿透伤害减免时均视为邪恶阵营。

zhCN: 深渊构装体

enGB: This is a strong construct designed in the abyss to supplement and support the near-infinite hordes of demons constantly fighting to destroy both themselves and the cosmos.
zhCN: 这是在深渊设计出的强横构装体，用以补充并支援那近乎无穷、不断为毁灭自身与宇宙而战的恶魔大军。

enGB: Whenever the wielder of this mythical unholy glaive kills a target with it, it summons a demon till the end of the fight. Only one demon can be summoned per fight. If the demon was already summoned, every subsequent kill {g|Encyclopedia:Healing}heals{/g} it for {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}+5 {g|Encyclopedia:HP}HP{/g} and gives it a stacking +1 {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}. Depending on the HD of the killed enemy, the summoned demon could be a Babau, a Marilith or a Balor. This weapon cannot be wielded by lawful good characters.
zhCN: 每当这把+3精金大砍刀的持用者杀死目标时，它会召唤出一个恶魔，持续到战斗结束。每场战斗只能召唤一个恶魔。如果恶魔已经被召唤出来，之后每次杀死敌人会为其{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}+5点{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}，并使其{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}获得可叠加的+1{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。根据杀死的敌人的{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}，召唤的恶魔可能是暴怖魔、六臂蛇魔或霸烙魔。此武器不能由{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}守序善良阵营{/g}的角色持用。

enGB: Forged by the great rune-priest Xiren, this glaive glows with innumerable runes, giving off light that seems to pierce through solid objects, creating a shimmering mist of orange and red swirls. Inscribed in the hilt is one word: "DOMINATE"
zhCN: 这柄大砍刀由伟大的符文祭司西伦锻造，刀身无数符文生辉，光芒似能穿透实物，织出橙红交织的流转雾霭。柄上只刻着一词：“支配”。

enGB: Ritual of the Abyss
zhCN: 深渊仪式

enGB:
This ritual must be cast by a evil spellcaster./n This is a powerful ritual spell that culminates in the summoning of a Demon from the Abyss. This ritual revolves around the caster making a sacrifice of blood and pain to satisfy the vicious cravings of the Abyss - due to this, only non-Good casters may attempt it. zhCN: 恶魔王子仪式·第2阶段

enGB: This creature is performing the Ritual of the Demon Prince and has accumulated a vast amount of energy.
zhCN: 此生物正在进行恶魔王子仪式，已积蓄巨量能量。

enGB: Ritual of the Demon Prince - Zenith
zhCN: 恶魔王子仪式·巅峰

enGB: This creature has almost finished casting the Ritual of the Demon Prince at it's zenith of power. Incredible amounts of energy surround their body as they attempt to bring forth something primordial to this plane of existence. The fabric of reality itself begins shrieking.
zhCN: 此生物即将以力量巅峰完成恶魔王子仪式。惊人的能量环绕其躯体，它正试图把某种原初之物带到这个位面。现实本身的织物开始尖啸。

enGB: Execute Ritual of the Demon Prince
zhCN: 执行恶魔王子仪式

enGB:
You execute the ritual, with the following effects:Immediate Casting: A CR 12-13 Demon from the Abyss is summoned. You take 4d12 unholy damage as you make a sacrifice of blood and pain to fuel the spell.
1 Previous Cast: CR 18-21 - Take 6d12 unholy damage. The power is barely containable, even by a spell of 9th level.
2 Previous Casts: CR 21-25 - Take 12d12 unholy damage as the ritual begins to eclipse the limits of mortal spell casting.
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): CR 25-28 with a small chance of a CR 28+ creature answering your infernal call - Take 24d12 unholy damage as your body is nearly turned inside-out by the plane-shaking powers at play.
zhCN:
你执行仪式，产生以下效果：
即刻施法：召唤一头来自深渊的CR 12–13恶魔。你以血与痛楚献祭供能，受到4d12点邪秽伤害。
此前施法1次：CR 18–21——受到6d12点邪秽伤害。即便是9环法术也几乎无从容纳这股力量。
此前施法2次：CR 21–25——受到12d12点邪秽伤害，仪式开始超越凡人施法的极限。
此前施法3次（上限）：CR 25–28，并有小概率回应你地狱召唤的是CR 28+的存在——受到24d12点邪秽伤害，撼动位面的力量几乎把你的身体由内向外翻了个面。一尊纯粹混乱之力的身影在你面前凝聚，你几乎要敬畏地俯身下拜。

enGB: 3 Rounds
zhCN: 3轮

enGB: Store More Power
zhCN: 蓄积更多能量

enGB: You begin (or continue) the Ritual of the Demon Prince and store more energy. Storing energy in this way by continuing the ritual will result in a much more powerful effect, and consequences, when you finally unleash the spell later on.
zhCN: 你开始（或继续）恶魔王子仪式并蓄积更多能量。以延续仪式的方式积蓄能量，日后最终释放法术时效果会强大得多，后果也会严重得多。

enGB: 3 Rounds
zhCN: 3轮

enGB: Store More Power
zhCN: 蓄积更多能量

enGB: You begin (or continue) the Ritual of the Abyss and store more energy. Storing energy in this way by continuing the ritual will result in a much more powerful effect, and consequences, when you finally unleash the spell later on.
zhCN: 你开始（或继续）深渊仪式并蓄积更多能量。以延续仪式的方式积蓄能量，日后最终释放法术时效果会强大得多，后果也会严重得多。

enGB: At 3rd level, mythic Demons receive the ability to cast mythic {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g}. They can either choose to take these spell levels as part of an existing full divine spellcaster spellbook, or as a standalone spellbook.
zhCN: 3级起，神话恶魔获得施展神话{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}的能力。这些法术等级既可并入已有的完整神术施法者法术书，也可作为独立法术书。

enGB: This creature is a Demon Lord and has a portfolio related to magic, allowing him to cast truly apocalyptic spells, verging on the territory of the divine.
zhCN: 此生物是恶魔领主，其权柄与魔法相关，因而能施展近乎神明领域、真正毁天灭地的法术。

enGB: Magic of the Demon Lord
zhCN: 恶魔领主魔法

enGB: This creature is a Demon Lord and has access to powerful Abyssal magic.
zhCN: 此生物是恶魔领主，掌握强大的深渊魔法。

enGB: Magic of the Demon Lord
zhCN: 恶魔领主魔法

enGB: This is the eye of a Duke of Hell - one of the most powerful existances in the multiverse. Three times per day you can curse the enemy. Since this eye was formed from unholy divine energy, the cursed target suffers a -8 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} with no save possible.
zhCN: 这是一位地狱公爵之眼，乃多元宇宙中最强大的存在之一所遗。每日三次，你可以诅咒敌人。由于此眼由亵渎的神圣能量凝成，被诅咒目标的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}承受–8{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，且无法豁免。

enGB: Even glancing at this strange molten red orb can cause the greatest of mortal heros to shiver and avert their eyes as if being crushed by the weight of hell itself.
zhCN: 哪怕只是瞥一眼这颗奇异的熔红宝珠，最伟大的凡人英雄也会战栗并移开目光，仿佛被地狱本身的重量压住。

enGB: Duke of Hell's Eye
zhCN: 地狱公爵之眼

enGB: A derakni is 14 feet long and weighs 1,200 pounds. These wretched demons arise from the souls of those who, in life, purposefully engineered disasters or aided in their development—particularly souls whose disasters resulted in mass famines or droughts.
zhCN: 毒啮魔身长14英尺，重达1200磅。这些可憎的恶魔由生前蓄意制造灾难或助长灾祸之人的灵魂所化——尤其是那些造成大范围饥荒或干旱者的灵魂。

enGB: Derakni
zhCN: 毒啮魔

enGB: Demon lord Deskari is capable of spewing forth pure abyssal energy in the form of an extremely powerful line breath attack. Deal 52d10 unholy damage in a massive straight line.
zhCN: 恶魔领主德斯卡瑞能喷出纯粹的深渊能量，化作一道极强的直线吐息。在一条巨大的直线上造成52d10点邪秽伤害。

enGB: This {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} instantly delivers 10 points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}. If the target's {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g} succeeds, it instead takes {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}10d10{/g} points of damage.
zhCN: 此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}会立即造成每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}10点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。如果目标在{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}强韧豁免检定{/g}中成功，则改为受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}10d10{/g}点伤害。

enGB: This creature is powered by divine energy and can output it as a destruction spell very easily.
zhCN: 此生物由神圣能量驱动，可轻易将其化为毁灭法术释放。

enGB: Destroyer
zhCN: 毁灭者

enGB: This construct is capable of using true hellfire. Hellfire pierces fire immunities by half and reduces all fire resistance to 0.
zhCN: 此构装体能够使用真狱火。狱火可穿透火焰免疫（减半生效），并把所有火焰抗性降为0。

enGB: True Hellfire Magic
zhCN: 真狱火魔法

enGB: As a ranking member of hell, this Devil's body has been reinforced with infernal vigor and fortitude.
zhCN: 作为地狱中的高位者，此魔鬼的躯体被地狱活力与坚韧所强化。

enGB: Devil Sire - Fortitude
zhCN: 魔鬼始祖·强韧

enGB:
This creature is a Devil Sire - part of the ranked structure of Hell. They usually take orders directly from the Hellish gentry, though are still deemed as somewhat expendable by the higher ups in Hell's rigid power structure.
 However, they still have a measure of Hellish power, and are quite formidible opponents. Specifically, though they are weaker than the truly powerful Devils in Hell, they also find it much easier to break onto the mortal plane (via signing contracts with gullible mortals, usually), and, though still extremely rare, are one of the most powerful form of Devil that can be seen openly walking thereupon.
zhCN:
此生物是魔鬼始祖——地狱等级体系中的一环。它们通常直接听命于地狱贵胄，但在地狱森严的权力结构里，上层仍视其为某种可消耗之物。
不过它们仍握有一份地狱之力，是相当可畏的对手。具体而言，虽弱于地狱中真正强大的魔鬼，它们却远更容易突破到凡界（通常是诱骗轻信的凡人签下契约）；尽管依旧极为罕见，它们却是能公开行走于凡界的最强魔鬼形态之一。

enGB: Devil Sire
zhCN: 魔鬼始祖

enGB: Devil Sires (and similar devilish creatures), have an extraordinarily capable intellect, beyond the reach of most mortal-kind.
zhCN: 魔鬼始祖（及类似魔鬼生物）拥有极为卓越的智力，远非凡人所能企及。

enGB: Devil Sire - Mind
zhCN: 魔鬼始祖·心智

enGB: As a Devil Sire (or equivalent), this creature is capable of weaving the immense penetrating power of Hell into it's spells - they are much more capable at penetrating spell resistance than other creatures, though the raw effectiveness of their spells is usually somewhat lower than their Demonic counterparts.
zhCN: 作为魔鬼始祖（或同类存在），此生物能把地狱那惊人的穿透之力织入法术：它们穿透{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}的本领远胜其他生物，不过法术本身的纯粹威力通常略逊于恶魔对应者。

enGB: Devil Sire - Power
zhCN: 魔鬼始祖·权能

enGB: This creature is a fairly strong Devil - it is very resistant to Unholy, Mythic, and most forms of mortal energy.
zhCN: 此生物是相当强大的魔鬼，高度抵抗邪秽、神话与绝大多数凡俗能量。

enGB: Devil Sire - Resistances
zhCN: 魔鬼始祖·抗性

enGB: Dukes of Hell (and their equivalents), are malevolent beings with bodies formed from a portion of Hell itself. They are in general harder to destroy than most other creatures. True Dukes of Hell (as opposed to their Avatars) also have a divine rank of 2 or greater, as they are directly connected (and control, to a limited extent) to an entire plane of existence.
zhCN: 地狱公爵（及其同类）是以地狱本身的一部分塑成躯骸的恶毒存在，通常比绝大多数生物更难摧毁。真正的地狱公爵（相对于其化身而言）还拥有2级或更高的神性等级，因为它们与一整个位面直接相连，并在有限程度上支配着它。

enGB: Duke of Hell - Body
zhCN: 地狱公爵·躯骸

enGB:
An infernal duke, collectively sometimes called Dukes of Hell, is a male devil who has been elevated above the ranks of the greater devils to become a unique creature. Although their lord, Asmodeus, is the only true deity of Hell, each infernal duke possesses enough power to grant his followers certain divine gifts: they are equivalent to demigods. In the eons of Hell's existence, countless fiends have risen to this status.
 These are immensely powerful creatures. As the magical energy neccessary to summon the actual essence of an Infernal Duke to the mortal plane would be equivalent to the entire output of a world (or more), past appearances of the Infernal Dukes have usually been, in fact, their Avatars. While still being wildly powerful, beyond the kin of even the most powerful of angels, Avatars of the Infernal Dukes can be successfully brought into the world through somewhat more sane rituals, such as the sacrifice of an entire nation of people, or the brutal torture of a legion of angels for a decade or more.
zhCN:
地狱公爵（有时合称为地狱诸公爵）是被擢升于高等魔鬼之上、成为独一存在的雄性魔鬼。尽管其主宰阿斯莫迪乌斯是地狱唯一的真神，每位地狱公爵仍拥有足够的力量赐予追随者某些神性恩赐：他们与半神相当。在地狱存在的漫长岁月里，无数邪魔攀升至此位阶。
这些生物威力绝伦。若要把某位地狱公爵的本体真髓召唤到凡界，所需的魔法能量相当于一整个世界（甚至更多）的全部产出，因此历史上现身的地狱公爵其实大多是他们的化身。即便如此，化身仍强得惊人，远胜最强天使的血脉；相较之下，把化身引入世间所需的仪式稍显理智，例如献祭整整一国之民，或是对一整支天使军团施以长达十年以上的残酷折磨。

enGB: Infernal Duke
zhCN: 地狱公爵

enGB: This creature, as a Duke of Hell, has survived centuries (or even millenia) of intrigue, backstabbing, and similar machinations. As such, it has one of the most intelligent and capable minds in existence.
zhCN: 此生物身为地狱公爵，已在数百年（乃至数千年）的阴谋、背刺与权术倾轧中幸存。因此，它拥有世间最聪慧、最精明的心智之一。

enGB: Duke of Hell - Mind
zhCN: 地狱公爵·心智

enGB: The power of a Duke of Hell, even it's Avatars, is capable of ripping apart the laws of reality at a fundamental level. Their spells are capable of piercing through spell resistance as if were nothing more than a sheet of paper in the face of a ballista bolt. However, their spells lack the raw power of their Demonic counterparts.
zhCN: 地狱公爵的力量——即便是其化身——也足以在最根本的层面撕裂现实法则。它们的法术穿透{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}，如同弩炮之矢穿透一张薄纸。不过，其法术的纯粹威力通常不及恶魔中的对应存在。

enGB: Duke of Hell - Power
zhCN: 地狱公爵·权能

enGB: This creature is a Duke of Hell and is extremely resistant to a wide variety of energies.
zhCN: 此生物是一位地狱公爵，极度抵抗种类繁多的能量。

enGB: Duke Of Hell - Resistances
zhCN: 地狱公爵·抗性

enGB: This +3 longbow deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g}, and additional 2d6 {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}acid damage{/g}, yet its clumsiness and weight impose a -2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} on the wielder's {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}.
zhCN: 这把+3长弓的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}为{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g}点，并且附带2d6点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}酸蚀伤害{/g}，但因为它的简陋和沉重，持用者的{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}承受-2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。

enGB:
Any nonlawful creature within the area of a dictum spell suffers the following ill effects:
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 1, it is staggered.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 5, it is paralyzed and staggered.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 10, it is killed, paralyzed, and staggered.
The effects are cumulative and concurrent. A successful Will save reduces or eliminates these effects. Creatures affected by multiple effects make only one save and apply the result to all of the effects. Creatures whose Hit Dice are equal to or exceed your caster level are unaffected by dictum.
Finally, Chaotic Outsiders are blasted for 4d6 divine damage, regardless of saving or not as they are hit with the full force of pure Law.
zhCN:
在箴铭之语{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围内的非守序生物都会受到以下不良影响：
如果生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}比你的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}低1级，它陷入{g|ConditionStaggered}恍惚{/g}状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低5级，它陷入{g|ConditionParalyzed}麻痹{/g}和恍惚状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低10级，它陷入麻痹和恍惚状态，并且死亡。
这些效果互相累积并且同时生效。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}成功将减少或者抵消这些效果。受到多个效果影响的生物，只需进行一次豁免检定，并将检定结果应用于所有效果。如果生物的生命骰数高于或等于你的施法者等级，它将不受箴铭之语影响。

enGB: Dimension Cleaver
zhCN: 位面裂刃

enGB: Weapons with this enchantment cleave the space between dimensions, doing an additional 4d10 force damage on every hit.
zhCN: 带有此附魔的武器会劈开维度之间的空隙，每次命中额外造成4d10点力场伤害。

enGB: This mythical falcata allows its wearer to deal an additional {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}6d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}slashing damage{/g} against Medium and smaller enemies on hit.
zhCN: 这柄神话反曲刀令挥舞者命中中型及更小体型的敌人时，额外造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}6d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}挥砍伤害{/g}。

enGB:
A thin, green ray springs from your pointing finger.[LONGSTART] You must make a successful ranged {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g} to hit.[LONGEND] Any creature struck by the ray takes {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d10{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} per {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} (to a maximum of 40d10). Any creature reduced to 0 or fewer {g|Encyclopedia:HP}hit points{/g} by this {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} is entirely disintegrated, leaving behind only a trace of fine dust. A disintegrated creature's equipment is unaffected.[LONGSTART] The ray affects objects constructed entirely of force, such as forceful hand or a wall of force, but not magical effects such as a globe of invulnerability or an antimagic field.[LONGEND]
A creature or object that makes a successful {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude save{/g} is partially affected, taking only 5d10 points of damage. If this damage reduces the creature or object to 0 or fewer hit points, it is entirely disintegrated.
Only the first creature or object struck can be affected; that is, the ray affects only one target per casting.
zhCN:
一道绿色的细小射线从你伸出的手指射出。你必须进行远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}以命中目标。被射线击中的生物会受到每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d10{/g}点的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}（最高40d10点）。任何被此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}将{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}降到0或以下的生物会被彻底瓦解，只留下一缕微尘。被瓦解的生物的装备不受影响。射线对完全由力场构成的物品有效，如飞击掌或力墙术，但对御法结界或魔法屏蔽场等魔法效果无效。
{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}强韧豁免{/g}成功的生物或物品仅受部分影响，只会承受5d10点伤害。若此伤害使生物或物品生命值降到0或以下，便会将其彻底瓦解。
只有第一个被击中的生物或物品受影响，换言之，每次施放此射线只会对一个目标有效。

enGB: This creature is powered by arcane energy and can output it as a disitigration ray with great ease.
zhCN: 此生物由奥术能量驱动，可轻易将其化为解离射线释放。

enGB: Disintigrator
zhCN: 解离者

enGB: Divine Artifact
zhCN: 神圣神器

enGB: Divine Artifact
zhCN: 神圣神器

enGB: Divine Artifact
zhCN: 神圣神器

enGB:
This weapon is a Divine Artifact and cannot be destroyed by normal means. In addition, it is able to penetrate certain forms of damage resistance and can disrupt most forms of divine protection. Being a weapon of divine might, it is also capable of hurting gods up to divine rank 6.
Divine Artifacts are not meant to exist on mortal planes of existence, and forces from across the multiverse will attempt to return this object to a godly realm that matches with it's alignment.
zhCN:
此武器是神圣神器，无法以常规手段摧毁。此外，它能穿透某些形式的伤害抗性，并瓦解大多数神性防护。作为神力之器，它也能伤及神格6阶及以下的神祇。
神圣神器本不该存在于凡人位面，多元宇宙各处的力量都会试图把它送回与其阵营相应的神之国度。

enGB:
This armor is a Divine Artifact and cannot be destroyed by normal means. Being an armor forged by godly hands, it is capable of resisting damage and attacks made by dieties up to and including divine rank 6.
Divine Artifacts are not meant to exist on mortal planes of existence, and forces from across the multiverse will attempt to return this object to a godly realm that matches with it's alignment.
zhCN:
这身铠甲是神圣神器，无法以常规手段摧毁。既然由神之手锻成，它能抵御最高至神格6阶（含）的神祇所造成的伤害与攻击。
神圣神器本不该存在于凡人位面，多元宇宙各处的力量都会试图把它送回与其阵营相应的神之国度。

enGB:
This object is a Divine Artifact. Divine Artifacts bend reality and their mere presence on Golarion is a perversion of the natural order of things. Forces across the multiverse will attempt to return this object to a godly realm that matches with it's alignment.
Many Divine Artifacts are so powerful that they have gained a measure of sentience and have a spirit of their own.
zhCN:
此物是神圣神器。神圣神器会扭曲现实，仅仅现身于格拉利昂便是对自然秩序的悖逆。多元宇宙各处的力量都会试图把它送回与其阵营相应的神之国度。
许多神圣神器强大到已生出几分自我意识，拥有属于自己的灵魂。

enGB: Weak Aura of Divinity
zhCN: 微弱神性灵光

enGB: This creature is partially formed of divine energy, and their body is extremely durable.
zhCN: 此生物部分由神性能量凝成，躯体极其坚韧。

enGB: Divine Rank 1 - Body
zhCN: 神性等级1·躯骸

enGB: This creature is a Demi-God (or Demi-God equivalent) and has a small amount of true divinity, known as Quintessence. They will be harder to kill than most other creatures, and they are immune to many effects, including some mortal spells designed to mimick divine salient abilities.

zhCN: 初生龙类强韧

zhCN: 幼龙虽远不及同族成龙强大，仍是令人生畏的巨兽。它的吐息足以熔穿披甲战士的钢甲，利爪锋锐如刃，可与精制品兵器的锋芒相较。

zhCN: 幼龙虽不及长辈睿智、威仪稍逊，仍是极为聪慧的生物。

enGB: Young Dragon's Charm
zhCN: 幼龙之魅

enGB: Magic wielded by younger dragons tends to be similar to the spellcasters of other races, though young dragons benefit from having an innate understanding and control of primordial magic, allowing their spells to hit with an increased DC.
zhCN: 幼龙施展的魔法与其他种族的施法者颇为相似，但幼龙天生便能理解并掌控原初魔法，使其法术拥有更高的{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}。

zhCN: 伪龙类魔法

zhCN: 此生物是成年真龙，躯体极其结实强壮。

zhCN: 龙类强韧

enGB: Dragons that have matured into full-fledged adults display immense pride and confidence in their powers. Once maturing, dragons have access to an extremely powerful breath attack, and by this point, also have access to somewhat less powerful magic generally following from their type. This is in addition, of course, to their gigantic claws and massive body, with muscles and tendons harder than cold-forged steel.
zhCN: 完全长成的成年龙对自身力量怀有极强的自负与信心。成年后，龙拥有威力惊人的吐息攻击，此时也已能施展威力稍逊、通常与其类型相应的魔法。除此之外，它们还有巨爪与庞然身躯，肌肉与筋腱比冷锻钢更为坚硬。

enGB: Mature Dragon
zhCN: 成年龙

zhCN: 这条巨龙已届成年，也积累了在极端危险的世界里存续数百年的经验。它们极聪慧，反应机敏。

enGB: True Dragon's Wit
zhCN: 真龙之智

enGB: The magic wielded by true dragons is very difficult to resist. However, this primordial form of casting is not quite as deadly as the magics of younger races, and is not as capable at piercing spell resistances.
zhCN: 真龙施展的魔法极难抵抗。不过这种原初施法方式在杀伤力上不及年轻种族的魔法，穿透{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}的本领也稍逊一筹。

zhCN: 远古龙类强韧

enGB: Ancient dragons are paragons of their race and have, over the centuries, survived to become formidible creatures with unparalleled strength, defenses and cunning. zhCN: 远古龙是同族中的典范，历经数百年幸存下来，成为力量、防护与狡诈皆无与伦比的可怕存在。远古龙拥有威力惊人的吐息武器、能斩断钢铁的巨爪，以及足以与最强法师和术士比肩的强大魔法——它们几乎无视物理攻击，对大多数元素伤害不以为意，甚至对某些位面伤害也具备防御。

enGB: Ancient Dragon

zhCN: 远古巨龙在凡俗位面的奇观与变迁中度过了极漫长的岁月，是睿智无比的生物。

At 2nd level, and at every level thereafter, an Abyssal Ritualist gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. 自2级起，以及此后每提升1级，深渊仪式师获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在加入该进阶职业之前所属的某一神术施法职业也提升了1级。自1级起、以及此后每级，他以此方式获得已知法术。但除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，他不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。

enGB: Ritual of Eldar Passage
zhCN: 远古通道仪式

enGB:
This is a travel ritual originally used by the Elders of the First World - it has been modified to instead bring parts of the First World across inter-planar distancesto help you destroy your foes. When casting this ritual, make a DC 60 Lore(Nature) check - if you succeed, you have successfully attuned to the First World, and the spell's effect will be greater.
When cast, this spell will attempt to entice one, or multiple, powerful (CR 13-27) Fey creatures to assist you. However, Fey creatures may quickly become bored with their excursion, and at any time, may return to whence they came. On average, however, they will stay for 10 minutes.
zhCN:
这是一道原本由第一世界远古诸灵所用的旅行仪式，如今被改造为跨越位面之距把第一世界的一部分带来，助你摧毁敌人。施展此仪式时进行DC 60的知识（自然）检定——若成功，你已成功与第一世界调谐，法术效果更强。
施法时，此法术会试图引来一头或多头强大的（CR 13–27）精类生物相助。不过精类生物很快就会对这趟出游生厌，随时可能返回来处。平均而言，它们会停留10分钟。

zhCN: 此生物已开始开启通往第一世界的极强传送门，与该位面远古诸主所用的力量相仿——但传送门仍不稳定。

zhCN: 此生物即将完成一道完美稳定、威力极强的通往第一世界的传送门。它很可能很快就完成施法。

enGB:
You execute the ritual and make a DC 60 Lore(Nature) check, then you perform the following actions:
Immediate Casting: A CR 17 (success) or CR 15 (failure) Fey or Magical creature will come through the passage to assist you.
1 Previous Cast: CR 21 or 17
2 Previous Casts: CR 23 or 19
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): CR 25 or 21 
Due to the somewhat chaotic nature of the First World, these creatures will have a chance every round to immediately return back to whence they came (perhaps they think it's funny?). On average, a creature will stay with you for 10 minutes.
zhCN:
你执行仪式并进行DC 60的知识（自然）检定，随后执行以下动作：
即刻施法：一头CR 17（成功）或CR 15（失败）精类或魔法生物将穿过通道前来助你。
此前施法1次：CR 21或17
此前施法2次：CR 23或19
此前施法3次（上限）：CR 25或21
由于第一世界略显混乱的本性，这些生物每轮都有机会立刻返回来处（或许它们觉得这样很好玩？）。平均而言，一头生物会陪伴你10分钟。
