zhCN: 开启远古通道·群体

enGB:
You execute the ritual and make a DC 60 Lore(Nature) check, then you perform the following actions:
Immediate Casting: 1d4 CR 15 (success) or CR 13 (failure) Fey and Magical creatures will come through the passage to assist you.
1 Previous Cast: CR 17 or 15
2 Previous Casts: CR 19 or 16
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): CR 21 or 17 
Due to the somewhat chaotic nature of the First World, these creatures will have a chance every minute to immediately return back to whence they came (perhaps they think it's funny?). On average, creatures will stay with you for 10 minutes.
zhCN:
你执行仪式并进行DC 60的知识（自然）检定，随后执行以下动作：
即刻施法：1d4头CR 15（成功）或CR 13（失败）精类与魔法生物将穿过通道前来助你。
此前施法1次：CR 17或15
此前施法2次：CR 19或16
此前施法3次（上限）：CR 21或17
由于第一世界略显混乱的本性，这些生物每分钟都有机会立刻返回来处（或许它们觉得这样很好玩？）。平均而言，生物们会陪伴你10分钟。

enGB: 3 Rounds
zhCN: 3轮

enGB: Store More Power
zhCN: 蓄积更多能量

enGB: You begin (or continue) the Ritual of Eldar Passage and store more energy. Storing energy in this way by continuing the ritual will result in a much more powerful effect when you finally unleash the spell later on.
zhCN: 你开始（或继续）远古通道仪式并蓄积更多能量。以延续仪式的方式积蓄能量，日后最终释放法术时效果会强大得多。

enGB: At 3rd level, an eldritch font can, as a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, pour more power into her {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} and abilities. She can add 4 to the {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} and 3 to the {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} of a spell, or increase her effective arcanist level by 4 when using an arcanist exploit. She becomes fatigued upon using this ability. If she is already fatigued, she becomes exhausted. If she's already exhausted, she cannot use this ability. This ability does not stack with spending points from her arcane reservoir to increase the spell's caster level or DC (as the arcane reservoir class feature).
zhCN: 3级起，魔源使能够以{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}在{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}和能力中倾注更多能量。她可以将法术的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}和{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级（DC）{/g}提高4点，或者将施展奥能技艺时的有效奥能师等级提高4级。她在使用此能力时陷入{g|ConditionFatigued}疲劳{/g}。如果已处于疲劳状态，则她将陷入{g|ConditionExhausted}力竭{/g}状态。如果她已处于力竭状态，便无法使用此能力。此能力不会与消耗奥能源泉点数来提高法术的施法者等级或难度等级的效果（比如职业特性“奥能源泉”）叠加。

enGB:
You become a small air elemental. You gain a +4 size bonus to your Dexterity, a +2 natural armor bonus, a +2 dodge armor bonus, resist electricity 20, and vulnerability to acid. Your movement speed is increased by 30 feet. You also gain two 1d4 slam attacks and the whirlwind ability.
Whirlwind: An air elemental can transform itself into a whirlwind and back again. The whirlwind is 30 feet wide, and every creature that spends a round in the whirlwind must succeed at a Reflex save or take 1d4 bludgeoning damage. While in whirlwind form, it cannot attack, but it is able to use its abilities.

enGB:
This is a powerful dimensional travel ritual formed from energies similar to those used by Empyreal beings. When casting this ritual, make a DC 50 Lore(Nature) check - if you succeed, you have successfully attuned your spell to the paths of the Empyreal, and the spell's effect will be greater.
When cast, this spell will attempt to entice one, or multiple, powerful (CR 11-23) Fey creatures to assist you. However, Fey creatures may quickly become bored with their excursion, and at any time, may return to whence they came. On average, however, they will stay for 10 minutes.

这是一道强大的位面旅行仪式，由与至高天存在所用相近的能量构成。施展此仪式时进行DC 50的知识（自然）检定——若成功，你已成功把法术调谐到至高天诸径，法术效果更强。
施法时，此法术会试图引来一头或多头强大的（CR 11–23）精类生物相助。不过精类生物很快就会对这趟出游生厌，随时可能返回来处。平均而言，它们会停留10分钟。

enGB: Ritual of Fabled Passage
zhCN: 传说通道仪式

enGB:
This is a complex dimensional travel ritual that tunes into the magical pathways Fey use to enter the Material realm. When casting this ritual, make a DC 38 Lore(Nature) check - if you succeed, the ritual taps into an already existing pathway (instead of making a new one) - the spell's effect will be greater.
When cast, this spell will attempt to entice one, or multiple, (CR 3-11) Fey or magical creatures to assist you. In comparison to their more powerful cousins, the somewhat weaker Fey lured by this spell will be more inclined to stay, and will, on average, assist you for 20 minutes, though they may depart at any time.
zhCN:
这是一道复杂的位面旅行仪式，调谐于精类进入物质界所用的魔法路径。施展此仪式时进行DC 38的知识（自然）检定——若成功，仪式会接入一条既有路径（而非另辟新路），法术效果更强。
施法时，此法术会试图引来一头或多头（CR 3–11）精类或魔法生物相助。与更强大的同族相比，被此法术引来的较弱精类更愿意留下，平均会协助你20分钟，不过它们随时可能离去。

enGB: Fabled Passage - Perfected

enGB: This creature has nearly completed the creation of a perfectly stable Feyspun portal to the First World. It will likely finish executing the spell soon.
zhCN: 此生物即将完成一道完美稳定、通往第一世界的精丝传送门。它很可能很快就完成施法。

enGB: 1 Hour
zhCN: 1小时

enGB: Open Fabled Passage
zhCN: 开启传说通道

enGB:
You execute the ritual and make a DC 38 Lore(Nature) check, then you perform the following actions:
Immediate Casting: A CR 7 (success) or CR 5 (failure) Fey or Magical creature will come through the passage to assist you.
1 Previous Cast: CR 9 or 7
2 Previous Casts: CR 10 or 8
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): CR 11 or 9 
These creatures have difficulty maintaining their strength due to the lack of natural magic nearby, and will have a chance every round to immediately return back to whence they came. However, these weaker Fey find the Material plane more facinating than their more powerful cousins, and will put effort into staying by your side. A creature planeshifted by this spell will stay with you for 20 minutes on average.
zhCN:
你执行仪式并进行DC 38的知识（自然）检定，随后执行以下动作：
即刻施法：一头CR 7（成功）或CR 5（失败）精类或魔法生物将穿过通道前来助你。
此前施法1次：CR 9或7
此前施法2次：CR 10或8
此前施法3次（上限）：CR 11或9
由于附近自然魔法稀薄，这些生物难以维持力量，每轮都有机会立刻返回来处。不过这些较弱精类比更强大的同族更觉物质位面有趣，会努力留在你身边。以此法位面转移而来的生物平均会陪伴你20分钟。

enGB: Gate to the First World
zhCN: 通往第一世界之门

enGB:
You penerate the thin veil between the Material Plane and the First World, inviting a powerful fey to do your bidding. Due to the nearness of the First World and the Material Plane, fey creatures summoned by this spell can be very powerful due to the abundance of energy available. The possible creatures summoned include members of the Wild Hunt, Hamadryads, and, in rare cases, the immensely powerful Vilderavns.
 However, creatures from the First World are fickle and instead of a single save to resist the charm portion of this spell, they get an ongoing chance (1 every 8 rounds on average) to resist the spell and return immediately to their home (they find the material plane incredibly boring). This Will save (vs spell DC as charm spell) to resist, is made at a -8 disadvantage. 
Creatures summoned in this way will attack your enemies to the best of their abilities, though they cannot be directly controlled.
zhCN:
你穿透物质位面与第一世界之间薄薄的帷幕，邀来一头强大的精类听命于你。由于第一世界与物质位面相距极近，被此法术召来的精类可因能量充沛而极其强大。可能响应召唤的包括狂猎成员、树宁芙，极少数情况下还有威力绝伦的维尔德拉文。
不过第一世界的生灵性情无常，它们不是只进行一次豁免来抵抗此法术的魅惑部分，而是持续有机会（平均每8轮一次）抵抗法术并立刻返回家园（它们觉得物质位面无聊透顶）。此意志豁免（按魅惑法术以法术DC对抗）处于-8劣势。
以此法召来的生物会尽力攻击你的敌人，但无法被直接操控。

enGB:
This spell functions as flare, except it affects all creatures in a 10-foot-radius burst from the target point.

enGB: Ritual of Gaia's Passage
zhCN: 盖娅通道仪式

enGB:
This is a magical travel ritual that tunes into the pure natural energy of forests, animals, and similar. When casting this ritual, make a DC 30 Lore(Nature) check - if you succeed, the ritual finds a source of natural power, and the spell's effect will be greater.
When cast, this spell will attempt to entice one, or multiple, (CR 0.5-7) Fey or magical creatures to assist you. In comparison to their more powerful cousins, the weak Fey found by this spell will be more inclined to stay, and will, on average, assist you for 20 minutes, though they may depart at any time.
zhCN:
这是一道魔法旅行仪式，调谐于森林、走兽之类纯粹的自然能量。施展此仪式时进行DC 30的知识（自然）检定——若成功，仪式会找到一处自然力量之源，法术效果更强。
施法时，此法术会试图引来一头或多头（CR 0.5–7）精类或魔法生物相助。与更强大的同族相比，被此法术找到的弱小精类更愿意留下，平均会协助你20分钟，不过它们随时可能离去。

enGB: Open Gaia's Passage
zhCN: 开启盖娅通道

enGB:
You execute the ritual and make a DC 30 Lore(Nature) check, then you perform the following actions:
Immediate Casting: A CR 3 (success) or CR 1 (failure) Fey or Magical creature will come through the passage to assist you.
1 Previous Cast: CR 5 or 3
2 Previous Casts: CR 6 or 4
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): CR 7 or 5 
These creatures have difficulty maintaining their strength due to the lack of natural magic nearby, and will have a chance every round to immediately return back to whence they came. However, these weak Fey find the Material plane more facinating than their more powerful cousins, and will put effort into staying by your side. A creature planeshifted by this spell will stay with you for 20 minutes on average.

enGB:
Known to some as warmonger demons, the gallus are not as enormous as many of the other powerful demons; despite their near-human size, however, they are among the deadliest of demonkind. Standing 8 feet tall and weighing 450 pounds, these creatures have wolf-like (but hairless) horned heads, bat-like wings, and pale flesh.
 They are extremely precise in their attacks, and are usually peerless masters of their unique form of Abyssal combat.
zhCN:
甲戮魔又被一些人称作好战魔，体型不如许多其它强大恶魔那般庞大；尽管身量近乎人类，它们却是恶魔中最致命的一类。甲戮魔身高8英尺、重450磅，生有似狼（但无毛）的带角头颅、蝠状双翼与苍白的皮肉。
它们的攻击极为精准，通常是其独特深渊战技无可匹敌的大师。

enGB: Gate

enGB:
Casting a gate spell has two effects:
First, it will summon a powerful creature from the realm specified, whether they want to be summoned or not.
Second, it will cast a subtle, but extremely powerful charm effect on the creature to make it generally assist the caster during it's stay.
Creatures summoned in this way have a chance of resisting the charm effect (Spell DC vs Will). If they resist the charm, the duration of their stay will be extremely short (3 rounds) as they attempt to sever the magic keeping them on the caster's plane. However, creatures that are summoned by this mighty spell are generally more powerful than similar creatures created by Summon Monster, since their true being is summoned, not just a facsimile.
zhCN:
施展异界之门法术有两个效果：
首先，它会从指定国度召唤一头强大生物，无论对方是否愿意被召唤。
其次，它会对该生物施加隐而不显却极强的魅惑效果，使其在停留期间大体上协助施法者。
以此法召唤的生物有机会抵抗魅惑效果（法术DC对抗意志豁免）。若抵抗成功，其停留时间将极短（3轮），因为它会试图切断把自己困在施法者位面的魔法。不过，被这道强大法术召来的生物通常比召唤怪物法术造出的同类更强，因为召来的是其真身，而非一具仿造体。

enGB: Gibrileths are known as filth demons because their appearance is so vile that even other demons find them appalling—including some hezrous. A gibrileth’s body is composed almost entirely of quivering, globular, acidic tumors, save for its batlike wings and the nest of spindly, atrophied arms growing from the top of its body. It can walk with a clumsy gait, using its long arms, but it prefers to be on the wing.
zhCN: 败瘤魔被称作污秽恶魔，因为其形貌之可憎连其它恶魔都为之作呕——连某些污魔也不例外。除蝠状双翼与从躯体顶端生出的一丛细弱萎缩的手臂外，败瘤魔的身体几乎全由颤动的球状酸性肿瘤构成。它能用长臂笨拙地行走，但更偏爱在空中飞行。

enGB: Ferocious and bestial in form, the glabrezu is in fact a master of trickery and lies. Glabrezu stand 18 feet tall and weigh just over 6,000 pounds. These treacherous demons form from the souls of the treasonous, the false, and the subversive—souls of mortals who, in life, bore false witness or used treachery and deceit to ruin the lives of others. They are extremely difficult to kill, and enjoy watching the slow, drawn out destruction of mortals that fight with them.
zhCN: 迷诱魔外形凶蛮如兽，实则是诡计与谎言的大师。迷诱魔身高18英尺，体重略超6000磅。这些背信的恶魔由叛逆者、伪誓者与颠覆者的灵魂凝成——那些生前作伪证、或以背叛与欺诈毁掉他人生活的凡人。它们极难被杀死，且乐于欣赏与之交战的凡人缓慢而漫长的毁灭。

enGB: Glabrezu

enGB:
Gold golems are extravagant constructs, crafted at great expense at the command of the rich and powerful. They’re most often used to guard palaces and family vaults, but are rarely placed in areas that are hidden away from casual observation. Many of those who expend the funds to create a gold golem aren’t the type to hide the conspicuous display of their wealth from their visitors.
 The wealth required to create a golem like this all but ensures it will also have extremely good defenses against arcane assaults, and it's spell resistance is even higher than similar golems.
zhCN:
金魔像是奢华的构装体，由权贵豪富不惜重金下令打造。它们多用于守卫宫殿与家族宝库，却很少被安置在避开旁人视线的隐秘之处——肯花这笔钱造金魔像的人，多半也不愿向访客掩藏这份招摇的财富。
打造这样一具魔像所需的财富，几乎注定了它对奥术侵袭也具备极强的防护，其法术抗力甚至比同类魔像更高。

zhCN: 金魔像

enGB: Holy Aura
zhCN: 神圣灵光

enGB:
A brilliant divine radiance surrounds the subjects, protecting them from attacks, granting them resistance to spells cast by evil creatures, and causing evil creatures to become blinded when they strike the subjects. This abjuration has four effects.
First, each warded creature gains a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saves.[LONGSTART] Unlike protection from evil, this benefit applies against all attacks, not just against attacks by evil creatures.[LONGEND]
Second, each warded creature gains spell resistance 25 against evil spells and spells cast by evil creatures.
Third, the abjuration protects from all mind-affecting spells and effects, giving heavy resistance.
Finally, if an evil creature succeeds on a melee attack against a creature warded by a holy aura, the offending attacker is blinded (Fortitude save negates, as blindness, but against holy aura's save DC).
zhCN:
耀眼的圣洁光芒帮助受术者防御{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}，提供对{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}邪恶{/g}生物所施放{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}的抵抗能力，并使邪恶生物在击中受术者时{g|ConditionBlind}目盲{/g}。此防护法术具有4种效果。
首先，每个受保护生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}获得+4偏斜{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免{/g}获得+4抗力加值。与{g|SpellsProtectionFromEvil}防护邪恶{/g}不同的是，这些加值对所有攻击都有效，而非仅针对邪恶生物的攻击。
其次，每个受保护生物在受到邪恶法术或邪恶生物所施放的法术影响时，获得25点{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}。
再次，此防护效果还能够阻挡尝试支配或魅惑受术者的效果。
最后，如果邪恶生物的{g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttack}近战攻击{/g}成功击中了受保护生物，攻击者将目盲（通过强韧豁免可免除该效果，效果如同{g|SpellsBlindness}目盲术{/g}，但使用神圣灵光的豁免{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}）。

enGB: At 20th level, a paladin becomes a conduit for the power of her god, able to moderately warp the fabric of reality itself with her will to destroy evil. Her {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} increases by 10/- and whenever she channels positive energy or uses lay on hands to {g|Encyclopedia:Healing}heal{/g} a creature, she heals the maximum possible amount.
zhCN: 20级时，圣武士成为其神祇力量的导管，能以毁灭邪恶的意志适度扭曲现实本身的结构。她的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}提高10/-；每当她引导正能量或使用圣手{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}生物时，总是治疗最大可能数值。

enGB:
You draw down holy power to smite your enemies. Only evil and neutral creatures are harmed by the spell; good creatures are unaffected.
The spell deals 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8) to each evil creature in the area (or 1d6 points of damage per caster level, maximum 10d6, plus an additional 2d10 divine damage, to an evil outsider) and causes it to become blinded for 1 round. A successful Will saving throw reduces damage to half and negates the blinded effect.
The spell deals only half damage to creatures who are neither good nor evil, and they are not blinded. Such a creature can reduce that damage by half (down to one-quarter of the roll) with a successful Will save.
zhCN:
你释放出神圣能量重创敌人。只有{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}邪恶和中立{/g}阵营的生物会受此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}；善良阵营的生物则不受影响。
此法术可对邪恶阵营生物造成每两个{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点伤害（最高5d8点；对邪恶异界生物可造成每施法者等级1d6点伤害，最高10d6点）并令其{g|ConditionBlind}目盲{/g}1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。通过成功的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免检定{/g}可使伤害减半并且免受目盲效果。
此法术对并非善良也非邪恶阵营的生物只造成一半伤害，也不会令其陷入目盲状态。这些生物还可以通过成功的意志豁免检定，将伤害再次减半（降至原本的四分之一）。

enGB:
Any nongood creature within the area of a holy word spell suffers the following ill effects:
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 1, it is blinded.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 5, it is paralyzed and blinded.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 10, it is killed, paralyzed, and blinded.
[LONGSTART]The effects are cumulative and concurrent. A successful Will save reduces or eliminates these effects. Creatures affected by multiple effects make only one save and apply the result to all of the effects.[LONGEND] Creatures whose Hit Dice are equal to or exceed your caster level are unaffected by holy word.
Finally, Evil Outsiders are also blasted by 6d6 fire and divine damage (split) as their form rebels against it's own nature.
zhCN:
在颂圣之语{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围内的非善良生物都会受到以下不良影响：
如果生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}比你的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}低1级，它陷入{g|ConditionBlind}目盲{/g}状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低5级，它陷入{g|ConditionParalyzed}麻痹{/g}和目盲状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低10级，它陷入麻痹和目盲状态，并且死亡。
这些效果互相累积并且同时生效。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}成功将减少或者抵消这些效果。受到多个效果影响的生物，只需进行一次豁免检定，并将检定结果应用于所有效果。如果生物的生命骰数等于或高于你的施法者等级，它将不受颂圣之语影响。

enGB: Your gestures and droning incantation fascinate nearby living creatures, causing them to stop and stare blankly at you in a dazed condition. Roll 8d4 to see how many total HD of creatures you affect.
zhCN: 你的手势与喃喃咒语迷魂了附近的活物，他们停止动作，目光空洞，呆滞地看向你，陷入{g|ConditionDaze}眩晕{/g}状态。掷{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}8d4{/g}决定你可以影响多少个{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰{/g}的生物。

enGB: Great magical hailstones pound down upon casting this spell, dealing 3d6 points of bludgeoning damage and 2d6 points of cold damage to every creature in the area. This damage only occurs once, when the spell is cast. For the remaining duration of the spell, heavy snow and sleet rains down in the area. Creatures inside this area take a –4 penalty on Perception skill checks and the entire area is treated as difficult terrain. The snow and sleet also make it much more difficult to dodge attacks, and all creatures in the area take a -2 penalty to their AC. At the end of the duration, the snow and hail disappear, leaving no aftereffects (other than the damage dealt).
zhCN: 施法时巨大的魔法冰雹倾泻而下，对{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围内所有生物造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}3d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}钝击伤害{/g}与2d6点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}寒冷伤害{/g}。伤害只在法术施放时发生一次。余下的法术持续时间内，法术范围内降下暴雪和冰雨。法术范围内的生物在{g|Encyclopedia:Perception}察觉{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Skills}技能{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}上受到–4{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，整个区域被视作困难地形。法术失效时，积雪与冰雹消失，除了造成的伤害之外不留下任何后续影响。

enGB: An incubus in his true form is always muscular and attractive, with long hair and intense eyes. His skin can be of any color, but is always smooth and silky. When not using his wings for flight, an incubus can fold them to drape across its shoulders like a cloak—many decorate both the inside and outside of their wings with tattoos, ink, or self-inflicted scars. Incubi stand between 6 and 6-1/2 feet tall and typically weigh 200 pounds.
zhCN: 淫梦魔以真身示人时总是肌肉强健、容貌俊美，长发披垂，目光灼人。肤色可呈任意颜色，却始终光滑如丝。不用于飞行时，淫梦魔会把双翼收拢披在肩上宛如斗篷——许多个体会在翼的内外两面纹上刺青、墨绘或自残留下的疤痕。淫梦魔身高在6至6又1/2英尺之间，通常重200磅。

enGB:
At 2nd level, and at every level thereafter, an Abyssal Ritualist gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. At 1st level, and every level thereafter, he gains spells known in this way. He does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known, and an increased effective level of spellcasting.
If a character had more than one divine spellcasting class before becoming an Abyssal Ritualist, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.
zhCN:
自2级起，以及此后每提升1级，深渊仪式师获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在加入该进阶职业之前所属的某一神术施法职业也提升了1级。自1级起、以及此后每级，他以此方式获得已知法术。但除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，他不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
若角色在成为深渊仪式师之前拥有多个神术施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定每日法术数量。

enGB:
This spell transforms your body into living iron, which grants you several powerful resistances and abilities. You gain damage reduction 30/adamantine. You are immune to blindness, critical hits, ability score damage, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and all spells or attacks that affect your physiology or respiration, because you have no physiology or respiration while this spell is in effect. You have acid and fire resistance 30.
You gain a +6 enhancement bonus to your Strength score, but you take a -6 penalty to Dexterity as well (to a minimum Dexterity score of 1), and your speed is reduced to half normal. You have an arcane spell failure chance of 15% and a -6 armor check penalty, just as if you were clad in full plate armor.
Your unarmed attack deals damage equal to a club sized for you (1d4 for Small characters or 1d6 for Medium characters), and you are considered armed when making unarmed attacks.
zhCN:
此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}会令你获得钢铁之躯，从而得到几项强大的抗性和能力。你将获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}30/精金。免疫{g|ConditionBlind}目盲{/g}、{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}、{g|Encyclopedia:AbilityDamage}属性伤害{/g}、疾病、溺水、电击、毒素、{g|ConditionStunned}震慑{/g}，并且由于你在此法术生效期间不具有生理机能或呼吸系统，你对所有影响生理机能或呼吸系统的法术或{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}也免疫。你具有30点酸蚀{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}抗性{/g}和火焰抗性。
你的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}属性值获得+6增强{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，但同时{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷属性{/g}值会承受–6{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}（敏捷属性值最低减少至1点），你的{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}移动速度{/g}降低为正常的一半。你就像身着全身甲一样，需要承受15%的{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Fail_Chance}奥术失败率{/g}以及–6的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Check_Penalty}防具检定减值{/g}。
你的{g|Encyclopedia:UnarmedAttack}徒手攻击{/g}会和与你体型相符的木棒造成同等{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}（{g|Encyclopedia:Size}小型{/g}角色造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g}点伤害，中型角色造成1d6点伤害），你在进行徒手攻击时视为使用武器。

enGB:
An iron golem has a humanoid body made from iron. It can be sculpted into any shape its creator desires, but it almost always displays armor of some sort, from simple and utilitarian to ceremonial and ornate. Its features are much smoother than those of a stone golem. Iron golems sometimes carry a weapon in one hand, though they rarely use these, relying instead on their slam attacks.
 These golems are quite vulnerable to electricity, though also highly resistant to magic.
zhCN:
铁魔像以铁铸成类人躯体，可塑成创造者想要的任何形状，但几乎总会带有某种铠甲造型，从简朴实用到隆重华丽不等。其五官比石魔像平滑得多。铁魔像有时单手持握武器，却极少使用，更依赖挥拳猛击。
这类魔像对电击相当脆弱，但对魔法的抗性极高。

zhCN: 铁魔像

The target takes 1d10 points of sonic damage per level (maximum 20d10) and is stunned for 1 round; a successful Fortitude save reduces the damage by half and negates the stun.

enGB:

Note that this damage bonus does not stack with other on-charge damage bonuses such as Powerful Charge.
zhCN:

注意：此伤害加值不与「强力冲锋」等其他冲锋伤害加值叠加。

zhCN: 此生物的躯体部分由宇宙意志凝成，将难以摧毁。

enGB: Body of Law
zhCN: 律令之躯

enGB:
This creature is made up of a large amount of Axiomatic energy. Axiomatic beings such as this are difficult to destroy, and have been created to enforce and further the goals of Law in the fight against the total entropy of the universe.
 As beings of Law and balance, these creatures have few weaknesses, though they generally do not get involved with the goings-on of mortal creatures, and thus do not usually have specific defenses against energy sources that are natural in origin. Mortalkind was introduced into the planes as a force of innovation and change, and so, these ultimate beings of of Law consider even major disruptions and changes on the mortal plane to be 'within expected tolerances'.
zhCN:
此生物由大量律令能量构成。此类律令存在难以摧毁，被造出来正是为了在对抗宇宙彻底熵化的斗争中维系并推进律令的目标。
作为律令与均衡的化身，这些生物几乎没有弱点；不过它们通常不介入凡人生物的纷争，因而一般也不具备针对天然能量来源的专门防护。凡人被引入诸位面，本就是作为革新与变化之力，因此这些律令的终极存在甚至把凡界上的重大动荡与变故视作“预期容差之内”。

enGB:
Lilitus are subversive and hidden horrors, demons who work subtly in their constant quest to destroy and devastate. Whereas most demons prefer to rend and destroy, the lilitu is more akin to the succubus—she prefers to do her work in humanoid form to infect society with sin from within.
Lilitus are more likely than other demons to devote their work to a specific demon lord, yet they do not generally view such devotion as true servitude. It’s simply convenient to have a specific demigod in mind when seeking to corrupt a mortal’s faith and to convince such fallen souls to shift their own allegiance from a prior deity to the lilitu’s chosen demon lord.
zhCN:
利图魔是潜伏暗处的颠覆性恐怖，为不断破坏与毁灭而暗中行事。多数恶魔偏爱撕碎与摧毁，利图魔却更接近魅魔——她喜欢以类人形态活动，从内部把罪孽注入社会。
利图魔比其它恶魔更可能把行动献给某位特定的恶魔领主，但她们通常并不把这视作真正的臣服：在腐化凡人信仰、诱使堕落的灵魂把忠诚从原先神祇转向自己选定的恶魔领主时，心里有个明确的半神可以依托，只是颇为便利。

enGB:
You embrace the madness that lurks deep in your heart, and can unleash it to drive your foes insane or to sacrifice certain abilities to hone others.
Vision of Madness: You can give a creature a vision of madness as a melee {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g}. Choose one of the following: {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g}, or {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill checks{/g}. The target receives a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to the chosen {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}rolls{/g} equal to 1 + 1/12 your level in the class that gave you access to this domain (minimum +1) and a {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to the other two types of rolls equal to 1 + 1/12 your level in the class that gave you access to this domain (minimum –1). Aura of Madness: At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of madness for a number of rounds per day equal to your level in the class that gave you access to this domain. Enemies within this aura are affected by confusion unless they make a Will save with a {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} equal to 10 + 1/2 your level in the class that gave you access to this domain + your Wisdom modifier. The confusion effect ends immediately when the creature leaves the area or the aura expires. Creatures that succeed on their saving throw are immune to this aura for 24 hours.
Domain {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Spells{/g}: cause fear, cacophonous call, rage, confusion, feeblemind, phantasmal killer, insanity, frightful aspect, weird.

enGB:
The leaders of Abyssal hordes and queens of Abyssal nations, the dreaded mariliths serve demon lords as governesses, advisors, and even lovers, yet their brilliance as tacticians makes them most sought after as generals and commanders of armies. The most powerful mariliths serve no one, and instead command ravenous fiendish legions.
A marilith is 6 to 9 feet tall and measures 20 feet from head to tail tip. It weighs 4,000 pounds. Only the most arrogant and proud evil souls, typically those of cruel kings, sadistic generals, and exceptionally violent warlords, can trigger the manifestation of a marilith.

可怖的六臂蛇魔是深渊大军的首领与深渊国度的女王，她们为恶魔领主充当女总管、谋士乃至情人，但真正令各方争相招揽的，是她们作为战术家的卓绝才具——统领军队的将军与指挥官。最强大的六臂蛇魔不侍奉任何人，反而统率着贪婪的邪魔军团。
六臂蛇魔身高6至9英尺，从头到尾尖长20英尺，重4000磅。唯有最傲慢自负的邪恶灵魂——通常是残暴君王、虐人将领与格外凶悍的军阀——才能促成六臂蛇魔的显化。

You become a Large shambling mound. You gain a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +6 size bonus to your Constitution, a -2 penalty to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, resist fire 20, and resist electricity 20. Your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet. You also have two 2d6 slam attacks, the constricting vines ability, and the poison ability.
Constricting Vines: A shambling mound's vines coil around any creature it hits with a slam attack. The shambling mound attempts a grapple maneuver check against its target, and on a successful check its vines deal 2d6+5 damage and the foe is grappled.
Grappled characters cannot move, and take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and a -4 penalty to Dexterity. Grappled characters attempt to escape every round by making a successful combat maneuver, Strength, Athletics, or Mobility check. The DC of this check is the shambling mound's CMD.
Each round, creatures grappled by a shambling mound suffer 4d6+Strength modifier × 2 damage.
A shambling mound receives a +4 bonus on grapple maneuver checks.
Poison:
Slam; Save: Fortitude
Frequency: 1/round for 2 rounds
Effect: 1d2 Strength and 1d2 Dexterity damage
Cure: 1 save
The save DC is Constitution-based.

紧勒藤蔓：蔓生怪以挥击命中生物后，藤蔓会将其缠住。蔓生怪对该目标进行一次{g|FeatureGrab}擒抱{/g}战技检定，检定成功则藤蔓造成2d6+5点伤害，并使敌人陷入擒抱。
被擒抱的角色无法移动，所有{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}承受–2减值，敏捷承受–4减值。被擒抱的角色每轮可尝试通过成功的战技、力量、运动或灵巧检定挣脱，检定{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}等于蔓生怪的{g|Encyclopedia:CMD}战技防御{/g}。

enGB: Ritual of Mighty Soulcrafting
zhCN: 强力灵魂塑炼仪式

enGB:
This powerful Necromatic ritual allows the caster to cut off tiny fragments of their soul in order to create powerful undead legions - the investment of soul energy allows creatures created with this spell to persist for 24 hours. The main source of power is from the Negative Plane, and if access to this plane is somehow cut off, the ritual will fail. The caster can choose to create a small cadre (1d4+1 per power tier) of undead, or a minor army (1d8 per tier). However, when cast, the shock and loss of one's soul immediately causes the caster to be inflicted with Soulburn, taking direct damage to most of their statistics.
This ritual is one of the most powerful a Necromancer can use to create large numbers of Undead.
zhCN:
这道强大的亡灵仪式让施法者切下自身灵魂的细小碎片，以造出强大的亡者军团——投入灵魂能量使此法术造出的生物能存续24小时。主要力量来源是负能量位面，若与该位面的联系被切断，仪式便会失败。施法者可选择造出一小队亡者（每个威力层级1d4+1），或一支小型军团（每层级1d8）。不过施法之时，灵魂骤然受创流失会立刻使施法者陷入灵魂灼烧，大部分属性直接受损。
这是死灵师能用来大量制造不死生物的最强仪式之一。

enGB: Mighty Soulcrafting

enGB:
You execute the ritual and perform the following actions:
Immediate Casting: 1d4 CR 11 creatures are created from portions of your soul - you take Soulburn (2 Mental and 1 Physical stat damage)
1 Previous Cast: 2d4 CR 12 and you take Soulburn
2 Previous Casts: 3d4 CR 13 and Strong Soulburn (4 and 2)
3 Previous Casts (Maximum): 4d4 CR 14 and Major Soulburn (6 and 4)
Undead creatures created in this way will serve you for 24 hours, and will assist you, though you cannot directly control them. After this time, your soul will naturally begin healing (though magic can also repair this damage).
zhCN:
你执行仪式并施行以下动作：
即刻施法：以你灵魂的碎片造出1d4头CR 11生物——你陷入灵魂灼烧（心智属性受损2点、身体属性受损1点）。
此前施法1次：2d4头CR 12生物，你陷入灵魂灼烧。

自2级起，以及此后每提升1级，深渊仪式师获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在加入该进阶职业之前所属的某一神术施法职业也提升了1级。自1级起、以及此后每级，他以此方式获得已知法术。但除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，他不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
若角色在成为深渊仪式师之前拥有多个神术施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定每日法术数量。

This functions as stoneskin {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}, using your oracle level as the {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}. At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.
zhCN: 每日限一次，你的皮肤的外观和硬度都变得犹如钢铁，获得20/精金的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}。此效果类似{g|SpellsStoneskin}石肤{/g}，以你的先知等级作为{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}。达到15级后，你每天可使用两次此能力。你必须至少达到11级才能选择这项启示。

enGB: Once per day, your skin hardens and takes on the appearance of iron, granting you {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} 20/adamantine in addition to DR 3/-. This functions as stoneskin {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}, using your oracle level as the {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g}. At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.
zhCN: 每日限一次，你的皮肤的外观和硬度都变得犹如钢铁，获得20/精金的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}。此效果类似{g|SpellsStoneskin}石肤{/g}，以你的先知等级作为{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}。达到15级后，你每天可使用两次此能力。你必须至少达到11级才能选择这项启示。

enGB:
You channel lawful power to smite enemies. The power takes the form of a three-dimensional grid of energy. Only chaotic and neutral (not lawful) creatures are harmed by the spell.
The spell deals 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8) to chaotic creatures (or 1d6 points of damage per caster level, maximum 10d6, plus an additional 2d10 divine damage, to chaotic outsiders) and causes them to be dazed for 1 round. A successful Will save reduces the damage to half and negates the daze effect.
The spell deals only half damage to creatures who are neither chaotic nor lawful, and they are not dazed. They can reduce the damage in half again (down to one-quarter of the roll) with a successful Will save.
zhCN:
你释放出守序能量重创敌人。能量会呈现为三维的能量网格形态。只有{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}混乱和中立{/g}阵营（也就是非守序阵营）的生物会受此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。
此法术可对混乱阵营生物造成每两个{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点伤害（最高5d8点；对混乱异界生物可造成每施法者等级1d6点伤害，最高10d6点）并令其{g|ConditionDaze}眩晕{/g}1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。通过成功的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免检定{/g}可使伤害减半并且免受眩晕效果。
此法术对并非混乱也非守序阵营的生物只造成一半伤害，也不会令其陷入眩晕状态。这些生物还可以通过成功的意志豁免检定，将伤害再次减半（降至原本的四分之一）。

enGB:
Oreads are humans whose ancestry includes the touch of an elemental being of earth somewhere along the line, often that of a shaitan genie. Stoic and contemplative, oreads are a {g|Encyclopedia:Race}race{/g} not easily moved, yet almost unstoppable when spurred to action. They remain a mystery to most of the world thanks to their reclusive nature, but those who seek them out in their secluded mountain hideaways find oreads to be quiet, dependable, and protective of their friends.
Oreads have a +2 racial {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} and a -2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Charisma{/g}. They can use the stone fist {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} once per day. Due to their durable body and innate connection to the earth, Oreads also gain physical resistance 2/- as well as 5 resistance to electricity energy damage.
zhCN:
土巨灵裔是某代祖先接触了大地元素（通常是土巨灵）的人类。土巨灵裔是一个沉默寡言的内敛{g|Encyclopedia:Race}种族{/g}，但当受到激励而行动起来时，几乎谁也无法阻挡他们。由于天性偏好隐居，世上大多数人都不了解他们。不过在土巨灵裔藏身的山间找到他们的人会发现，土巨灵裔安静而可靠，而且会挺身而出保护朋友。
土巨灵裔的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知属性{/g}获得+2种族{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}魅力属性{/g}获得–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。他们每天可施放一次法术“{g|SpellsStoneFist}石拳{/g}”。

enGB:
With scintillating personalities to match their captivating appearances, gemsoul oreads command attention — and prefer it that way. Gemsouls tend to have large egos and are flashy in their relationships. They gravitate towards artistic pursuits, most frequently of a performative nature, though they also have a strong tradition of symmetric poetry. Gemsouls prefer to make their homes in flamboyant societies or places where they can make meaningful personal contributions, as well as in nations that appreciate cultivated beauty. Gemsouls typically have dazzling, faceted skin, along with a cluster of crystalline formations instead of hair and pupil-less eyes of vivid colors. Some favor tattoos in complex, branching geometric shapes, and they can frequently be seen wearing silks or brightly dyed linen to contrast their complexions.
Gemsoul oreads have a +2 racial {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Strength{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Charisma{/g} and a -2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g}. They can use the color spray {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} once per day. Finally, their gemstone laiden bodies are capable of capturing and deflecting most types of energy damage, and they gain 5 additional resistance to cold, fire and electricity energy damage.
zhCN:
凭借与迷人外表相称的风趣个性，宝石魂裔吸引着众人的注意力，并且乐在其中。宝石魂裔往往自命不凡，在与人相处时非常招摇。他们喜好艺术追求，其中有表演性质的最受推崇，不过他们也有创作结构工整的诗歌的重要传统。宝石魂裔倾向于在光鲜华丽的社区或能做出有意义的个人贡献的地方安家，也喜欢懂得欣赏优雅之美的国家。宝石魂裔通常有耀眼的棱角分明的皮肤，一簇水晶丛代替了头发，没有瞳孔的眼睛色彩鲜艳。有些人喜欢复杂的几何形状纹身，他们还经常穿丝绸或染上鲜艳色彩的亚麻布，用来衬托他们的肤色。
宝石魂裔的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}魅力属性{/g}获得+2种族{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知属性{/g}获得–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。他们每天可施放一次法术“{g|SpellsColorSpray}七彩喷射{/g}”。

enGB:
Stolid and indomitable, ironsoul oreads undertake great works, both physical and conceptual, with unwavering determination. Possessed of patience and a sense of self-refinement through struggle, ironsouls reflect their ancestry in their continuous and determined efforts towards self-improvement. Ironsouls are most at home in areas that reflect that same sense of directed and intentional growth, and they operate best within existing formal structures. Ironsouls wear their elemental heritage on their skin, with most having some amount of metallic sheen. Their skin tone varies, with colors ranging from gold and silver to copper-green and dull, oxide gray.
Ironsoul oreads have a +2 racial {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Constitution{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} and a -2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g}. They can use the lead blades {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} once per day. Their incredibly durable body is also capable of preventing all but the most grevious of injuries, and they gain Damage Reduction 3/- to all physical damage.
zhCN:
冷漠而刚强的铁魂裔以不可动摇的决心从事伟大的工作，包括实体上与概念上的。铁魂裔拥有充足耐心和通过奋斗自我完善的精神，在提升自己的道路上，他们坚定的不懈努力反映出了祖先的品质。铁魂裔最适应那些在定向与主动成长上有共识的地区，而他们在现存的正规组织中也最为自在。铁魂裔的皮肤大多带有一些金属光泽，从而展现出其元素血统。他们的肤色各不相同，有金色、银色、铜绿色、暗淡的氧化灰色，不一而足。
铁魂裔的{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知属性{/g}获得+2种族{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷属性{/g}获得–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。他们每天可施放一次法术“{g|SpellsLeadBlades}重压之刃{/g}”。

enGB: This creature is built purely to channel the power of the Abyss into it's attacks - it's body has suffered greatly to achieve this, however.
zhCN: 此生物纯粹为把深渊之力导入攻击而生——不过为此，它的躯体付出了极大代价。

enGB: The Deadly Abyss
zhCN: 致命深渊

enGB: These demons were created to haunt mortal dreams and watch their nightmares, as well as to hunt lone uinuja azatas. They are extremely specialized in their ability to strike nimble targets, and their spears are capable of channeling raw Abyssal energy directly into the targets they strike. They are extremely deadly and accurate killers.
zhCN: 这些恶魔被造出来是为了纠缠凡人的梦境、窥视他们的梦魇，以及猎杀落单的乌因努贾灵使。它们在击中灵巧目标方面极为专精，长矛能把原始深渊能量直接灌入被刺中的目标。它们是极其致命且精准的杀手。

enGB: Painajai
zhCN: 徘魇魔

enGB: This +5 evil outsider bane handaxe has its {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical{/g} threat range increased. In addition, whenever the wielder of this handaxe lands a critical hit, the enemy is denied its {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dexterity{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g} for 3 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g}.
zhCN: 这把+5{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}邪恶{/g}{g|EnhancementBane}异界生物破敌{/g}手斧的{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击威胁范围{/g}扩大到18–20。此外，每当持用者造成重击，被重击敌人失去{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}上的{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，持续3{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。

enGB: This +5 padded armor grants its wearer {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} 20/- against {g|Encyclopedia:RangedAttack}ranged attacks{/g}.
zhCN: 这件+5厚布甲为穿戴者提供对{g|Encyclopedia:RangedAttack}远程攻击{/g}的20/-{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}。

enGB: This +5 padded armor grants its wearer {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} 20/- against {g|Encyclopedia:RangedAttack}ranged attacks{/g}.
zhCN: 这件+5厚布甲为穿戴者提供对{g|Encyclopedia:RangedAttack}远程攻击{/g}的20/-{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}。

enGB: Metamagic (Perfect Extend Spell)
zhCN: 超魔（完美法术延时）

enGB:
You have mastered the ability to extend spells and can make your spells last ten times as long.
Benefit: A perfectly extended spell lasts ten times as long as normal. A spell with a duration of concentration, instantaneous, or permanent is not affected by this feat.
Level Increase: +1 (A perfect extended spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.)
Restrictions: Spells with a base duration of 2 hours or more cannot be extended.
Note: Favorite Metamagic - Extend will also reduce the level cost of Perfect Extend
zhCN:
你已掌握延长时间的法门，能让法术持续时间延长至十倍。
好处：完美延时的法术持续时间为通常的十倍。持续时间为专注、即时或永久的法术不受此专长影响。
法术位提升：+1（完美延时的法术占用比其实际环级高一环的法术位。）
限制：基础持续时间达2小时或更长的法术无法被延时。
注：偏好超魔·法术延时同样会降低完美法术延时的环级代价。

enGB: Perfect Gate
zhCN: 完美之门

enGB:
Casting a Perfect Gate spell has two effects:
First, it will summon a powerful creature from the realm specified, whether they want to be summoned or not.
Second, it will cast a subtle, but extremely powerful charm effect on the creature to make it generally assist the caster during it's stay.
Creatures summoned in this way have a chance of resisting the charm effect (Spell DC vs Will). If they resist the charm, the duration of their stay will be extremely short (3 rounds) as they attempt to sever the magic keeping them on the caster's plane. However, creatures that are summoned by this mighty spell are generally more powerful than similar creatures created by Summon Monster, since their true being is summoned, not just a facsimile.
zhCN:
施展完美之门法术有两个效果：
首先，它会从指定国度召唤一头强大生物，无论对方是否愿意被召唤。
其次，它会对该生物施加隐而不显却极强的魅惑效果，使其在停留期间大体上协助施法者。
以此法召唤的生物有机会抵抗魅惑效果（法术DC对抗意志豁免）。若抵抗成功，其停留时间将极短（3轮），因为它会试图切断把自己困在施法者位面的魔法。不过，被这道强大法术召来的生物通常比召唤怪物法术造出的同类更强，因为召来的是其真身，而非一具仿造体。

enGB: This +5 Major Artifact grants its wielder a +2 inherent {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}, all {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throws{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill checks{/g}.
zhCN: 这把+5长剑为持用者的{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}、所有{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}、{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}和{g|Encyclopedia:Skills}技能检定{/g}提供+2天赋{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}。

enGB: You weaken the target's defenses against poison. The target gains a –6 penalty on saves against poison. Attempts to cure the poisoned target take a –4 penalty.
zhCN: 你弱化目标对毒素的防御能力。目标在对抗毒素进行{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}时受到–6{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}。尝试{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}目标身上的毒素时，检定受到–4减值。

enGB:
You implant within the minds of your targets the illusion that their skin is rotting away, large rents are appearing all over their bodies, and their internal organs are spilling out into a putrid half-liquid mass at their feet. Those who fail to disbelieve phantasmal putrefaction immediately take 1d8 points of Wisdom damage. This damage occurs only once.
Each round after that, an affected target receives another Will save to disbelieve the effect, and targets that fail must succeed at a Fortitude save or faint, falling asleep as per sleep (except that it isn't a magical sleep effect). Waking up doesn't end the spell for a target; it must continue to attempt Will saves to disbelieve and Fortitude saves to avoid fainting each round until the spell ends or the target successfully disbelieves.
zhCN:
你为目标的思想植入幻象，它会认为它的皮肤正在腐烂，全身都是可怖的裂痕，体内器官向外溢出，化成一团腐烂的半液状物掉到它脚上。生物若无法识破腐烂幻象，便会受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:AbilityDamage}伤害{/g}。该{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}只会造成一次。
之后的每一{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}，受影响的目标都可以得到另一次{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}的机会来识破这个效果，如果豁免失败，则必须成功进行一次强韧豁免检定，否则就会昏厥，如受{g|SpellsSleep}睡眠术{/g}影响般入睡（区别在于这并不属于魔法睡眠效应）。目标醒来后{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}并不会结束，每一轮它都必须继续尝试意志豁免来识破这个效果，以及进行强韧豁免检定来避免昏厥，直到法术结束或者目标成功识破此效果。

enGB: Planar Beacon
zhCN: 位面信标

enGB:
This spell establishes a direct planar bridge to the home plane of your god. Creatures nearby the newly opened portal are instinctively aware of the nature of your need and the power of creature(s) that may answer your call is determined by a Wisdom check modified by your caster level.
The energy and skill required to enact this planar teleportation is not insignificant, and you will suffer soul exhaustion based on a Dexterity check representing how precisely you make the neccessary ritual motions involved in this spell (if you are good or neutral aligned) or a Constitution save if you are evil (DC reduced by 1/2 your caster level).
With this spell, you can seek to call 1d3+1 creatures as a cohort, or a single elite. Note that creatures summoned in this fashion will be more powerful than if they were created with a Summon Monster spell, but only if you cast it at full, or almost full, power.
zhCN:
此法术在你神祇的所属位面之间架起一道直接位面之桥。新开启的传送门附近的生物会本能地察觉你所需何事，响应召唤的生物之力由一次受施法者等级调整的感知检定决定。
完成此位面传送所需的能量与技艺不容小觑，你会因灵魂耗竭而受损：若你为善良或中立阵营，依一次敏捷检定（代表你完成此法术所需仪式动作的精准程度）判定；若为邪恶阵营，则依体质豁免判定（DC降低施法者等级的一半）。
借助此法术，你可寻求召唤1d3+1生物作为一队同伴，或单独召唤一名精英。请注意，以此法召来的生物会比召唤怪物法术造出的更强，但前提是你以全力或接近全力施法。

enGB: Summon Elite
zhCN: 召唤精英

enGB:
You attempt to summon an elite from your god's home plane. The power of this summoning is determined by rolling a Wisdom check. The DC of the Wisdom check is reduced by half your caster level. This spell is very difficult to cast, so you must make a CON save (if evil) or a DEX save to avoid penalties.
DC 28 - DC 11 Demon or Celestial
DC 24-27 - DC 10
Roll 23 or less: DC 8
A Dexterity/Constitution check is then made with a DC of 20 or 16 (reduced by 1/2 caster level) based on the power of creature answering. Failing the DC 20 check will cause you to take a -6 penalty to all mental ability scores and failing the DC 16 check will give you a -4 penalty.
Summoned creatures will attack your enemies to the best of their abilities, though they cannot be directly controlled.
zhCN:
你试图从神祇的所属位面召唤一名精英。召唤之力由一次感知检定决定，该检定的DC降低施法者等级的一半。此法术极难施展，因此你必须进行体质豁免（若邪恶）或敏捷豁免以避免减值。
DC 28——CR 11恶魔或天界生物
DC 24–27——CR 10
掷出23或以下：CR 8
随后依响应生物之力，进行一次敏捷／体质检定，DC为20或16（降低施法者等级的一半）。未通过DC 20检定会使你所有心智属性受到-6减值，未通过DC 16检定则受到-4减值。
被召生物会尽力攻击你的敌人，但无法被直接操控。

enGB: True Planar Beacon
zhCN: 真位面信标

enGB:
This spell establishes a direct planar bridge to the home plane of your god. Creatures nearby the newly opened portal are instinctively aware of the nature of your need and the power of creature(s) that may answer your call is determined by a Wisdom check modified by your caster level.
The energy required to create this planar teleportation is not insignificant, and you will suffer soul exhaustion based on a Dexterity check representing how precisely you make the neccessary ritual motions involved in this spell if you are good or neutral aligned, or a Constitution save if you are evil, with a DC reduced by 1/2 of your caster level.
With this spell, you can seek to call 1d4+1 creatures as a cohort, or a single champion. Note that creatures summoned in this fashion will be more powerful than if they were created with a Summon Monster spell, but only if you are capable of casting it at full, or almost full, power.
zhCN:
此法术在你神祇的所属位面之间架起一道直接位面之桥。新开启的传送门附近的生物会本能地察觉你所需何事，响应召唤的生物之力由一次受施法者等级调整的感知检定决定。
完成此位面传送所需的能量与技艺不容小觑，你会因灵魂耗竭而受损：若你为善良或中立阵营，依一次敏捷检定（代表你完成此法术所需仪式动作的精准程度）判定；若为邪恶阵营，则依体质豁免判定（DC降低施法者等级的一半）。
借助此法术，你可寻求召唤1d4+1生物作为一队同伴，或单独召唤一名勇士。请注意，以此法召来的生物会比召唤怪物法术造出的更强，但前提是你以全力或接近全力施法。

enGB: Summon Champion
zhCN: 召唤勇士

enGB:
You attempt to summon a champion from your god's home plane. The power of this summoning is determined by rolling a Wisdom check. The DC of the Wisdom check is reduced by half your caster level. This spell is very difficult to cast, so you must make a CON save (if evil) or a DEX save to avoid penalties.
DC 38 - CR 17 Demon or Angel
DC 34-37 - CR 16

enGB: Ritual of Planar Binding
zhCN: 位面束缚仪式

enGB:
This is a powerful binding ritual capable of enslaving powerful outsiders to your will. This ritual creates an inter-dimensional vortex that temporarily punches through space to a plane of your choosing. An additional scrying component of the spell then searches for a suitable target creature (CR 5-21 based on ritual power and plane targeted).
 As opposed to most other planar summoning spells, this spell is capable of drawing in unwilling participants - after casting this ritual, the target creature makes a Will save against your spell DC at a -5 disadvantage. If they fail, the creature is fully bound and will serve you for 1 hour. If they succeed, the creature will likely seek retribution against you for attempting to (temporarily) enslave it.
Abyssal creatures are very likely to attempt to destroy the caster once the binding weakens. Celestials and Azata, on the other hand, will usually blast the caster with holy fire while proceeding to planeshift back to whence they came (they have more important things to do).
Binding creatures from the Abyss is generally easier than other planes, as, for the most part, they enjoy the chance to cause havok and destruction and so the power of a Infernal binding is slightly higher than a celestial one (though more dangerous).
This spell uses the powers of Law to bind creatures, and effects that improve the power of Law spells will also improve this one.
zhCN:
这是一道强大的束缚仪式，能够把强大的异界生物奴役于你的意志之下。仪式会创造一道跨维度漩涡，暂时击穿空间通往你所选的位面。法术中另含探知部分，会搜寻合适的目标生物（依仪式威力与目标位面，CR 5–21）。
 与多数其它位面召唤法术不同，此法术能强行拉来不情愿的参与者——仪式施毕后，目标以-5劣势对你的法术DC进行意志豁免。若失败，生物被完全束缚，为你效力1小时。若成功，它很可能会因你试图（暂时）奴役它而向你寻仇。
深渊生物在束缚减弱后极可能试图杀死施法者。天界生物与灵使则通常一边以圣火轰击施法者，一边准备位面转移返回来处（它们还有更要紧的事）。
从深渊束缚生物通常比从其它位面容易，因为它们大多乐得有机会制造混乱与破坏，因此地狱束缚的威力略高于天界束缚（尽管也更危险）。
此法术借律令之力束缚生物，任何强化律令法术威力的效果同样会强化此法术。

这是一道束缚仪式，能够把异界生物奴役于你的意志之下。仪式会创造一道跨维度传送门，在你所选位面之间暂时拉出一段过渡空间。法术中另含探知部分，会搜寻合适的目标生物（依仪式威力与目标位面，CR 5–16）。
 与多数其它位面召唤法术不同，此法术能强行拉来不情愿的参与者——仪式施毕后，目标以-4劣势对你的法术DC进行意志豁免。若失败，生物被完全束缚，为你效力1小时。若成功，它很可能会因你试图（暂时）奴役它而向你寻仇。
深渊生物在束缚减弱后极可能试图杀死施法者。天界生物与灵使则通常一边以圣火轰击施法者，一边准备位面转移返回来处（它们还有更要紧的事）。
从深渊束缚生物通常比从其它位面容易，因为它们大多乐得有机会制造混乱与破坏，因此地狱束缚的威力略高于天界束缚（尽管也更危险）。
此法术借律令之力束缚生物，任何强化律令法术威力的效果同样会强化此法术。

enGB:
This is a ritual, requiring the power of a demigod, capable of binding some of the most powerful of outsiders to your will. This ritual creates an inter-dimensional vortex that temporarily punches through space to a plane of your choosing. A true-scrying component then searches for a suitable target creature (CR 19-31 based on ritual power and plane targeted).
 As opposed to most other planar summoning spells, this spell is capable of drawing in unwilling participants - after casting this ritual, the target creature makes a Will save against your spell DC at a -5 disadvantage. If they fail, the creature is fully bound and will serve you for 1 hour. If they succeed, the creature will likely seek retribution against you for attempting to (temporarily) enslave it.
Abyssal creatures are very likely to attempt to destroy the caster once the binding weakens. Celestials and Azata, on the other hand, will usually blast the caster with holy fire while proceeding to planeshift back to whence they came (they have more important things to do).
Binding creatures from the Abyss is generally easier than other planes, as, for the most part, they enjoy the chance to cause havok and destruction and so the power of an Infernal binding is slightly higher than a celestial one (though more dangerous).
This spell uses the powers of Law to bind creatures, and effects that improve the power of Law spells will also improve this one.

深渊生物在束缚减弱后极可能试图杀死施法者。天界生物与灵使则通常一边以圣火轰击施法者，一边准备位面转移返回来处（它们还有更要紧的事）。
从深渊束缚生物通常比从其它位面容易，因为它们大多乐得有机会制造混乱与破坏，因此地狱束缚的威力略高于天界束缚（尽管也更危险）。

enGB:
You find solace in the green, can grow defensive thorns, and can communicate with plants.
Enlarge: As a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g} you can enlarge yourself for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}, as if you were the target of the enlarge person {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}, but with additional defensive stats including DR 4/- and +6 CON. You can use this power a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.
Bramble Armor: At 6th level, you can cause a host of wooden thorns to burst from your skin as a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g}. While bramble armor is in effect, any foe striking you with a melee weapon without {g|Encyclopedia:Reach}reach{/g} takes {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}piercing damage{/g} + 2 points per level you possess in the class that gave you access to this domain. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to your level in the class that gave you access to this domain. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

你在绿色自然中得到放松，可长出防御荆棘，并可与植物进行沟通。
变巨：作为{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}，你可使自身增大，持续1轮，如同成为{g|SpellsEnlargePerson}变巨术{/g}的法术目标。每天可使用次数为{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值+3。
荆棘护甲：达到6级时，作为{g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}自由动作{/g}，你可使自身长满木刺荆棘。在荆棘护甲效果持续期间，任何使用非{g|Encyclopedia:Reach}长触及{/g}近战武器攻击你的敌人都将受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}穿刺伤害{/g}，赋予你此领域的职业等级每提升2级，可额外造成2点伤害。每天可使用{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮数{/g}等于赋予你此领域的职业等级。生效轮次无需连续。

enGB: Constructed of an immense amount of true-forged platinum, this golem glows softly even in the absence of light. It is an extremely agile and deadly war machine that, while being unbelievably expensive, is also just as capable in tearing apart outsiders - specifically, the demons of the abyss. Originally created by the hosts of heaven to help defend against demonic incursions on neutral planes of existence, they can theoretically be created to serve any entity - though the truly epic feats required to build them ensure these beautiful engines of destruction are only seen in the most exotic of places.
zhCN: 这具魔像以海量真炼白金铸成，纵然无光也隐隐生辉。它是一台极为灵敏而致命的战争机器，造价高得难以置信，撕碎异界生物——尤其是深渊恶魔——的本事同样惊人。最初由天界大军造出，用于在中立位面抵御恶魔入侵；理论上它可被造出来侍奉任何存在，但铸造所需的史诗级壮举，注定了这些美丽的毁灭机关只会出现在最奇异之地。

enGB: Platinum Golem
zhCN: 白金魔像

enGB:
Platinum golems are similar in many ways to their greater cousins, the legendary Mithril golems, but with much more of a focus on deterring threats from the Abyss. These golems can be seen walking astride legions of angels whenever great calamity or evil strikes the planes.
 Rarely, though, they have been used by the lords of demonkind themselves as a way to protect against would-be backstabbers.
zhCN:
白金魔像在许多方面与它们更强大的近亲——传奇的秘银魔像——相仿，但更侧重于威慑来自深渊的威胁。每当诸位面遭遇大灾或邪恶侵袭，都能见到这些魔像伴随天使军团并肩行进。
不过，偶尔也会有恶魔领主反过来用它们来防备潜在的背刺者。

enGB: Platinum Golem Resistances
zhCN: 白金魔像抗性

enGB: A blue-white ray of freezing air and ice springs from your hand. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. The ray deals 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 25d6) and 1d4 points of Dexterity drain as well as 1d6 points of Constitution drain.
zhCN: 你在手上唤出蓝白色的冻风和冰泉射线。你需要成功进行远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}检定，才能让射线对目标造成伤害。射线可造成每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}寒冷伤害{/g}（最大伤害值为25d6点），同时造成1d4点{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}流失。

enGB:
When a creature with this special ability charges, it is able to add two additional base weapon damage dice rolls to it's charge attack, as well as dealing additional bonus damage equal to one and a half times the primary damage attribute of their attack (Usually STR or DEX).
Note that this damage bonus does not stack with other on-charge damage bonuses such as Powerful Charge.
zhCN:
拥有此特殊能力的生物冲锋时，可在冲锋攻击中额外加上两颗基础武器伤害骰，并额外造成等同于其攻击主伤害属性（通常为力量或敏捷）1.5倍的伤害加值。
注意：此伤害加值不与「强力冲锋」等其他冲锋伤害加值叠加。

enGB:
At 3rd level, the brown-fur transmuter learns to harness the power of her magic to empower her transmutations. Whenever the brown-fur transmuter casts a transmutation {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} using one of her arcanist spell slots, she can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as a {g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}free action{/g} to bolster the spell. If the spell grants a {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} to an {g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}ability score{/g}, the bonus then increases by 2. The brown-fur transmuter cannot expend more than 1 point from her arcane reservoir in this way.
 By turning inwards and specializing his magic to such an extent, the brown-fur transmuter's ability to cast all other magic is reduced. They gain a -1 malus to DC as well as a -2 malus to the caster level of all spells cast - in addition, all summoned creatures are summoned with a -4 malus to STR, DEX and CON, as the brown-fur transmuter finds it harder to support the magical energies required of keeping summoned beings on this plane.
zhCN:
3级起，棕毛变化师学会了驾驭魔法的力量来增强变化能力。当棕毛变化师用奥能师{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}位施放一个变化系法术时，她能够以{g|Encyclopedia:Free_Action}自由动作{/g}从奥能量泉中支付1点能量来加强该法术。若该法术为某项{g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}属性值{/g}提供{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，则该加值提高2点。棕毛变化师以此方式一次最多只能支付1点奥能量泉。
由于向内求索、把魔法专精到如此地步，棕毛变化师施展其他一切魔法的能力有所下降：所有法术的{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}承受–1不利、施法者等级承受–2不利；此外，所有召唤生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}、{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}体质{/g}均承受–4不利，因为棕毛变化师更难维持将召唤物留在此位面所需的魔法能量。

enGB: This creature has honed it's mind into a weapon, easily capable of dominating the weak-willed.
zhCN: 此生物把心智磨砺成了武器，能轻易支配意志薄弱者。

enGB: Powerful Will
zhCN: 强大意志

enGB: This creature's will is powerful enough to dominate all but the strongest.

enGB: Deadly Will
zhCN: 致命意志

enGB:
Tapping into a sliver of true divinity, you utter a single word of primordial power that causes a creature to become blinded for 1d4 rounds, whether the creature can hear the word or not. Due to the divine nature of this spell, there is no save, and it not affected by spell resistance or immunities of any kind. 
Creatures with 2500 HP or more than 30 Hit Dice are completely immune to this spell.
zhCN:
借一丝真正的神性，你吐出一个原初之力凝成的单词，使一个生物目盲1d4轮，无论它是否听见这个词。由于此法术的神圣本质，它没有豁免，也不受法术抗力或任何免疫影响。
生命值2500以上或生命骰超过30的生物完全免疫此法术。

enGB: You utter a single divine word of power that attempts to kill one creature of your choice, whether the creature can hear the word or not. The immense power of this word used in it's true form is far too much to be contained in a single spell of this level, and a target is allowed both a will save as well as spell resistance to avoid death. If it fails, it will die if it has less then 1500 HP. Otherwise, it will take 1500 Divine damage. Even if the target successfully saves, the raw divine power of this word will still injure it, dealing 200 divine damage.
zhCN: 你吐出一个神圣真言，试图杀死一个由你选定的生物，无论它是否听见这个词。以此环级法术根本无法容纳此真言以完整形态释放的庞然之力，因此目标可进行意志豁免并依法术抗力避免死亡。若豁免失败且生命值低于1500，它将死亡；否则受到1500点神性伤害。即便目标豁免成功，这真言的纯粹神力仍会令其受创，造成200点神性伤害。

enGB:
You utter a single divine word of power that instantly causes one creature of your choice to become stunned for 1 round, whether the creature can hear the word or not. The power of this word is too great for you to fully pronounce correctly, and spell resistance does apply against it (though there is still no save possible). 
Creatures with more than 2500 HP, or 30 or more hit dice are completely immune to this spell.
zhCN:
你吐出一个神圣真言，立刻使一个由你选定的生物震慑1轮，无论它是否听见这个词。此真言之力太强，你无法完整无误地念出，因此法术抗力对其生效（但仍无法进行豁免）。
生命值超过2500或生命骰达到30及以上的生物完全免疫此法术。

zhCN: 此生物是进化后的幻蛇，是纯粹混乱所化的极强大真性存在。它的躯体毫无秩序可言，“器官”与其它看似要害的部位会随机忽隐忽现。极难对此类生物造成重击，它们也能从看似致命的创伤中极快恢复。

enGB:
Red dragons are covetous, evil creatures, interested only in their own well-being, vanity and the extension of their treasure hoards.They are supremely confident of their own abilities and are prone to making snap decisions without any forethought.
The largest and most powerful of the chromatic dragons, red dragons are also the most fearsome and cruel.These dragons delight in ruin, death and destruction and are peerless masters in the use of primordial fire.

红龙贪婪而邪恶，只关心自身的安逸、虚荣与宝库的扩张。它们对自身能力极度自信，往往不假思索便仓促决断。

enGB:
A twisting pattern of coruscating colors weaves through the air, affecting creatures within. The spell affects an unlimited number of HD of creatures in it's area of effect. Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first, and among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the spell's point of origin are affected first. HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted. The spell affects each subject according to its HD.
6 or less: Unconscious for 1d4 rounds, then stunned for the same amount of rounds, and then confused for the same amount of rounds. (Treat an unconscious result as stunned for nonliving creatures.)
7 to 12: Stunned for 1d4 rounds, then confused for the same amount of rounds.
13 or more: Confused for 1d4 rounds.
Sightless creatures are not affected by scintillating pattern.

6或更低：{g|Encyclopedia:Injury_Death}昏迷{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d4{/g}轮，然后{g|ConditionStunned}震慑{/g}相同的{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮数{/g}，然后{g|ConditionConfusion}困惑{/g}相同的轮数。（对于非活物，将昏迷按震慑判定）
7到12：震慑1d4轮，然后困惑相同的轮数。
13或更高：困惑1d4轮。
无视觉的生物不受迷幻图纹影响。

enGB:
At 2nd level, and at every level thereafter, an Abyssal Ritualist gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in a divine spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. At 1st level, and every level thereafter, he gains spells known in this way. 自2级起，以及此后每提升1级，深渊仪式师获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在加入该进阶职业之前所属的某一神术施法职业也提升了1级。自1级起、以及此后每级，他以此方式获得已知法术。但除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，他不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。

You become a Large shambling mound. enGB:
This Necromatic ritual allows the caster to bind small fragments of their soul to Negative Plane energy to create undead legions. The investment of soul energy allows creatures created with this spell to persist for 24 hours. If access to this plane is somehow cut off, the ritual will fail. However, when cast, the shock and loss of one's soul immediately causes the caster to be inflicted with Soulburn, taking direct damage to most of their statistics.

enGB:
The enigmatic sphinxes are closely related, yet diverse in appearance, intellect, and personality. All combine a lion’s body, a falcon’s wings, and a head of some other species. Sphinxes of all breeds are known in stories and legends as guardians of great treasures, secrets, and sacred places, and there’s much truth to these claims, though each of the races guards such things for its own reasons-whether altruism, greed, entertainment, or fear of a more powerful master.
Sphinxes are usually powerful spellcasters and generally prefer to stay out of combat. Some sphinxes may even be capable of casting minor divine words of power.
zhCN:
神秘的人面狮彼此血缘相近，却在外形、智力与性情上各不相同。它们都兼具狮身、隼翼与某种其它物种的头颅。各类人面狮在故事与传说中都是重宝、秘密与圣地的守护者，此说大体不虚——只是各族守护这些事物的缘由各异：或出于利他，或出于贪婪，或只为消遣，或出于对更强主人的畏惧。
人面狮通常是强大的施法者，且一般更愿避开战斗。有些人面狮甚至能施展低阶的神圣真言。

enGB: A stone golem has a humanoid body made from stone, frequently stylized to suit its creator. enGB: Ritual of Supreme Soulcrafting
zhCN: 至高灵魂塑炼仪式

enGB:
This epic Necromatic ritual allows the caster to cut off tiny fragments of their semi-divine soul in order to create powerful undead legions - the investment of soul energy allows creatures created with this spell to persist for 24 hours. The main source of power is from the Negative Plane, and if access to this plane is somehow cut off, the ritual will fail. The caster can choose to create a small cadre (1d4+1 per power tier) of undead, or a minor army (1d8 per tier). However, when cast, the shock and loss of a portion of one's soul immediately causes the caster to be inflicted with Soulburn, taking direct damage to most of their statistics.
This ritual is one of the most powerful a Necromancer can use to create large numbers of Undead.
zhCN:
这道史诗级亡灵仪式让施法者切下自身半神灵魂的细小碎片，以造出强大的亡者军团——投入灵魂能量使此法术造出的生物能存续24小时。主要力量来源是负能量位面，若与该位面的联系被切断，仪式便会失败。施法者可选择造出一小队亡者（每个威力层级1d4+1），或一支小型军团（每层级1d8）。不过施法之时，灵魂缺失一部分的冲击会立刻使施法者陷入灵魂灼烧，大部分属性直接受损。
这是死灵师能用来大量制造不死生物的最强仪式之一。

enGB:

Immediate Casting: 1d4 CR 14 creatures are created from portions of your soul - you take Soulburn (2 Mental and 1 Physical stat damage)
1 Previous Cast: 2d4 CR 15 and you take Soulburn
