效果：健壮提供的{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}翻倍。此外，当生命值低于0点时，你获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免（DR）{/g}60/传奇。

enGB:
At 20th level, the brown-fur transmuter learns to fully master the power of transmutation. Whenever she casts a transmutation {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}, it is treated as it were affected by the Extend Spell {g|Encyclopedia:Feat}feat{/g} without altering the {g|Encyclopedia:Casting_Time}casting time{/g} or slot used. Whenever she uses her powerful change ability, the {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} increases by 4 instead of 2. Her share transmutation ability can now target a willing creature within close range.
 This perfection of their ability to cast trasmutation energies comes at the cost of their other magical abilities decreasing somewhat, and they gain an additional malus of -1 to DC and -2 to caster level to all spells they cast.
zhCN:
20级时，棕毛变化师得以完全掌握变化的力量。她施展的每个变化系{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}都视为受到{g|FeatureExtendSpell}法术延时{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Feat}专长{/g}影响，却不改变{g|Encyclopedia:Casting_Time}施法时间{/g}或所用法术位。每当她使用强效变化能力时，{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}由+2提高为+4。她的「共享变化」能力现在可以指定近距内一个自愿的生物。
这份对变化能量的极致掌握以其他魔法能力的些许衰退为代价：她施展的所有法术额外承受{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}–1、施法者等级–2的不利。

enGB:
You are a master of illusions and deceptions. This mastery manifests itself in a slight shadow-double of yourself fading in and out of your body, giving you a +1 dodge bonus to AC at all times. In addition, {g|Encyclopedia:Trickery}Trickery{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}Stealth{/g} are class {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skills{/g}.
Copycat: You can create an illusory double of yourself as a {g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}move action{/g}. This double functions as a single mirror image and lasts for a number of {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}rounds{/g} equal to your level in the class that gave you access to this domain, or until the illusory duplicate is dispelled or destroyed. You can have no more than one copycat at a time. This ability does not stack with the mirror image {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.
Master's Illusion: At 8th level, you can make yourself and any number of allies within 30 feet invisible for 1 round per level in the class that gave you access to this domain. The rounds do not need to be consecutive.
zhCN:
你是幻术与障眼法的大师。这份造诣化作一道朦胧的影子分身，在你身上明灭不定，令你始终获得+1闪避{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}加值。此外，{g|Encyclopedia:Trickery}巧手{/g}与{g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}隐匿{/g}成为本职{g|Encyclopedia:Skills}技能{/g}。
复制：你可以花费一个{g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}移动动作{/g}创造自身的幻影分身。此分身相当于一次{g|SpellsMirrorImage}镜像术{/g}效果，持续{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮数{/g}等于赋予你该领域的职业等级，或直到幻影被解除、被摧毁为止。同一时间最多只能存在一个复制分身。此能力不与镜像术{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}叠加。每日可用次数等于3＋你的{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值。
大师幻术：8级起，你可使自己与30英尺内任意数量的盟友隐形，持续轮数等于赋予你该领域的职业等级。这些轮数不必连续。

enGB:
Any character can break free from entangling effects by succeeding on {g|Encyclopedia:Athletics}Athletics check{/g}. But if you are {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}strong{/g} enough – there is no actual difference between being entangled and suffering from any other debilitating condition. Every {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g} you attempt an Athletics {g|Encyclopedia:Check}check{/g} to remove one negative condition affecting you. The {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} of this check is equal to the effect's original {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}save{/g} DC + 15.
 In addition, you gain a +3 dodge bonus to your AC, as you cartwheel into and out of the fray.
zhCN: 每个角色都可以通过成功的{g|Encyclopedia:Athletics}运动{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}来摆脱{g|ConditionEntangled}纠缠{/g}效应。但只要你足够强壮，那么对你而言，被纠缠和承受其他使人虚弱的效应之间并没有什么本质区别。每{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}你可以尝试运动检定以移除一个影响你的负面状态。此检定的{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级（DC）{/g}等于该效果原本的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免{/g}难度等级+15。

enGB:
Now, at last, you can call yourself really {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}strong{/g}. The most athletic athlete in the world! And, as such, your {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}base attack bonus{/g} can't be low — not lower than your ranks in {g|Encyclopedia:Athletics}Athletics{/g}. And if your base {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} is equal to your {g|Encyclopedia:Character_Level}character level{/g}, it becomes not less than your ranks in Athletics plus 5.
 Finally, due to your strong athletics, you are able to pirouette and gracefully dance away from harms way - somehow, this translates into you becoming incorporeal, permanently.
zhCN:
如今你终于可以自称真正{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力大无穷{/g}了——世上最强健的运动员！既然如此，你的{g|Encyclopedia:BAB}基础攻击加值{/g}自然不会低：不低于你的{g|Encyclopedia:Athletics}运动{/g}阶数。而若你的基础{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}等于你的{g|Encyclopedia:Character_Level}人物等级{/g}，则它不低于运动阶数＋5。
最后，凭借高超的运动能力，你能旋身轻舞、从容避开伤害——不知何故，这让你永久获得了{g|ConditionIncorporeal}虚体{/g}特性。

enGB: At 3rd level, characters harnessing the power of Fate receive the ability to cast mythic {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g}. They can either choose to take these spell levels as part of an existing full arcane spellcaster spellbook, or as a standalone spellbook.
zhCN: 3级起，驾驭命运之力的角色获得施展神话{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}的能力。这些法术等级既可并入已有的完整奥术施法者法术书，也可作为独立法术书。

enGB:
You can now understand how to use magical items even better. Every item with an enhancement {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonus{/g} that you identify has this enhancement bonus increased by 1.
 Your understanding of Arcana also allows you to unlock greater potential in your spells, and you gain a +1 DC to *all* spells you cast.
zhCN:
如今你更懂得如何运用魔法物品。经你鉴别的每一件带有增强{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}的物品，其增强加值都会提高1点。
你对{g|Encyclopedia:Knowledge_Arcana}神秘知识{/g}的领悟还能激发法术更大潜能，你施展的*所有*法术{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}+1。

enGB:
You can reveal hidden effects that can be used by wearers of magical equipment. Every item you identify gets an additional random minor effect.
 In addition, you understand the magical weave so well that you manage to catch strands of it with your weapons (or bare hands). Whenever you hit something in combat, you will deal an additional 1d4 damage, of a random damage type, for every base rank in Arcana you have.
zhCN:
你能揭示魔法装备佩戴者可动用的隐藏效果。你鉴定的每一件物品都会额外获得一个随机的次级效果。
此外，你对魔网的理解如此透彻，甚至能以武器（或赤手）勾住它的丝缕。战斗中每次命中，你都会依所拥有的神秘学基础阶数，每层额外造成1d4点随机伤害类型的伤害。

enGB: You can reveal item properties that aren't even there and couldn't possibly be there. Every item you identify gets an additional random major effect. You now also understand matters of the arcane so well that you simply ignore most spell resistance when casting your spells (+20 spell penetration bonus).
zhCN: 你甚至能揭示根本不存在、也不可能存在物品属性。经你鉴别的每件物品都会额外获得一个随机高级效果。你对奥秘的理解已如此透彻，施法时几乎无视绝大多数{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}（法术穿透+20加值）。

enGB:
You now know that whole world is just a game. But that is ultimately in your favor, because you are good at games, and at changing rules in your favor. You and members of your party can now ignore requirements of {g|Encyclopedia:Feat}feats{/g} when leveling up.
 In addition, your superior knowledge of the world gives you a +2 attack bonus to attacks, as well as increasing your movement speed by 5ft/round, since you know the terrain so well.
zhCN:
如今你明白整个世界不过是一场游戏。而这终究对你有利，因为你既擅长游戏，也擅长把规则改成对自己有利。你与队伍成员升级时可以无视{g|Encyclopedia:Feat}专长{/g}的前置要求。
此外，你对世界的超凡认知令{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}获得+2加值；由于对地形了如指掌，{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}移动速度{/g}每轮提高5英尺。

enGB:
You now know so much about the world that you understand that everything in this world is decided by dice. And you are good at dice. You have some very special dice that you will use from now on. Every time a member of your party would {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}roll{/g} a 1 on a d20 roll the result of the roll instead becomes 20.
 You also recognize how fun it is to roll natural 20s, and by speaking with the DM, now, whenever you roll a 20 on an attack roll, a random very helpful buff will be applied to you for two rounds.
(The power of this helpful buff is generally similar to a level 7-9 spell)
zhCN:
如今你对世界的了解已如此之深，以至于明白世间一切皆由骰子决定。而你恰好擅长掷骰——从现在起，你会使用几枚非常特别的骰子。每当队伍成员在d20检定中{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}掷出{/g}1，该结果改为20。
你还发现掷出天然20多么有趣，于是与主持人打过招呼：现在每当你掷出天然20的攻击检定，都会随机获得一个极为有益的增益，持续两轮。
（此有益增益的强度大致相当于7至9环法术。）

enGB:
You now know that whole world is just a game. But that is ultimately in your favor, because you are good at games, and at changing rules in your favor. You and members of your party can now ignore requirements of {g|Encyclopedia:Feat}feats{/g} when leveling up. 
You also notice that you seem to be partially protected by 'plot armor', and gain a +8 insight bonus to AC.
zhCN:
如今你明白整个世界不过是一场游戏。而这终究对你有利，因为你既擅长游戏，也擅长把规则改成对自己有利。你与队伍成员升级时可以无视{g|Encyclopedia:Feat}专长{/g}的前置要求。
你还发现自己似乎受到「剧情护甲」的部分庇佑，{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}获得+8洞察加值。

enGB:
Even in the Worldwound you can find yourself a {g|Encyclopedia:Healing}healthy{/g} meal and some useful items. Every time you {g|Encyclopedia:Rest}rest{/g} you search the surrounding area, finding a random potion or a random scroll and enough food to cook a common meal that will give some benefits to all your companions.
 In addition, while looking around for healthy meals and fantastic items, your body has become much more resistant to being constantly exposed to extreme weather. You gain 20 resistance to all non-planar energy types.
zhCN:
即便在{g|Worldwound}世界之伤{/g}，你也能替自己找一顿{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}滋补{/g}餐食和几件有用之物。每次{g|Encyclopedia:Rest}休息{/g}时，你都会搜寻周围区域，找到一瓶随机药水或一卷随机卷轴，以及足够烹制一顿普通餐食的食材，为全体同伴带来一些增益。
此外，在四处寻找滋补餐食与奇珍的过程中，你的身体对长期暴露于极端天气变得更为耐受。你获得对所有非位面能量类型20点抗性。

enGB:
You know nature so well that you know that it is natural to find gold and valuables in the wild. Every time you hunt you get some gold, potions, scrolls and other valuables.
 In addition, your infrequent jaunts into extra-planar space while finding these valuables 'in the wild' have also made you *even more* resistant to non-planar energies (+30 additional resistance) as well as now being resistant to planar energies also (+20 resistance).
zhCN:
你对自然了如指掌，乃至深知在荒野中寻得黄金与珍宝本是理所应当。每次狩猎你都会获得一些金币、药水、卷轴与其他贵重物品。
此外，为了在「荒野」中寻得这些珍宝而偶尔往返于异位面，使你对非位面能量的抗性*更上一层楼*（额外+30抗性），如今对位面能量也具备了抗性（+20抗性）。

enGB:
You know nature so well that you know that it is perfectly natural to find powerful magical items in the wild. Maybe they do grow on the trees after all? You return from your hunts with random magical items. These hunts through the Abyss and the Worldwound have helped your body just say 'no' to unholy and negative energies - you gain immunity to both of them.
 In addition, nature has now become your best chum, and gives you back massages and words of support when you are feeling blue. You gain a +6 morale bonus to all saves.
zhCN:
你对自然了如指掌，深知在荒野里找到强大魔法物品再自然不过——说不定它们真是树上长出来的？你每次外出搜寻归来都会带回随机的魔法物品。这些穿越深渊与世界之伤的搜寻也让你的身体学会对邪秽与负能量说“不”：你免疫这两种能量。
此外，自然如今成了你最要好的伙伴，会在你心情低落时替你揉肩、说些打气的话。你所有豁免获得+6士气加值。

enGB:
You learned how to {g|Encyclopedia:Healing}heal{/g} not only the body, but the soul as well. Your Treat Affliction removes not only poisons and diseases, but any negative conditions affecting the target. 
Your knowledge of gods and the divine has also allowed you to 'borrow' a small measure of divinity from your patron god(s) and/or the universe itself - you gain a +2 divine bonus to your AC as well as damage reduction 5/-.
zhCN:
你学会了{g|Encyclopedia:Healing}治疗{/g}的不只是躯体，还有灵魂。你的治疗伤病不仅能去除毒素与疾病，还能移除目标身上任何负面状态。
你对诸神与神性的了解，也让你得以从守护神祇和／或宇宙本身“借”来一丝神性：你的AC获得+2神性加值，并获得伤害减免5/-。

enGB: You now know enough about religion to start your own. You can select two additional domains. In addition, by founding a religion, you in effect become a minor quasi-diety, though the gods don't seem to mind for some odd reason. As a quasi-diety, you gain 100 additional HP, an additional damage reduction 10/-, a divine AC bonus of +4, +10 resistance to all forms of energy except divine energy and a permanent spell resistance of 42.
zhCN: 如今你对宗教的了解足以自立一门。你可以额外选择两个领域。此外，开创宗教实际上令你成为一位低阶准神祇——不知何故，诸神似乎并不在意。作为准神祇，你获得{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}上限+100、额外的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}10/-、{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}+4神圣加值、对除神圣能量外所有能量类型10点抗性，以及永久的{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}42。

enGB: You now know enough about religion to start your own. You can select two additional domains. In addition, by founding a religion, you in effect become a minor quasi-diety, though the gods don't seem to mind for some odd reason. As a quasi-diety, you gain 100 additional HP, an additional damage reduction 10/-, a divine AC bonus of +4, +10 resistance to all forms of energy except divine energy and a permanent spell resistance of 42.
zhCN: 如今你对宗教的了解足以自立一门。你可以额外选择两个领域。此外，开创宗教实际上令你成为一位低阶准神祇——不知何故，诸神似乎并不在意。作为准神祇，你获得{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}上限+100、额外的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}10/-、{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}+4神圣加值、对除神圣能量外所有能量类型10点抗性，以及永久的{g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Resistance}法术抗力{/g}42。

enGB:
Nothing can escape your notice. You automatically detect creatures who attempt to use {g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}Stealth{/g}. You also notice more about yourself and your companions, allowing both them and you from now on to take {g|Encyclopedia:Feat}feats{/g} from a special trickster list.
 However with great perception, comes great responsibility, and sometimes, the Trickster may see *too* much, causing the universe itself to reverse-prank the Trickster. Whenever a critical strike is made, whether confirmed or not, the Trickster rolls a 1d6 - on a 1, he may be blinded, confused, proned, or a variety of these conditions for 1 or 2 rounds, depending on how the universe feels on that specific day.
zhCN:
没有什么能逃过你的察觉。你自动发现任何试图使用{g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}隐匿{/g}的生物。你对自己与同伴也有了更多了解，从今往后你和队友都可以从特殊的诡术师列表中选取{g|Encyclopedia:Feat}专长{/g}。
不过洞察越强，责任越大，诡术师有时会看得*太多*，引得宇宙本身反过来捉弄他。每当出现重击（无论是否确认），诡术师便投一次1d6；若掷出1，他可能会目眩、困惑、倒地或同时陷入其中数种状态，持续1至2轮，全看宇宙当日的心情。

enGB:
At last, you notice the most important thing — problems within yourself. And to negate those problems, you learn to quickly find ways to use other mythic tricks.
You can now use up to two wandering rank one mythic tricks, that you can change every day.
 In addition, by examining yourself in great detail, somehow you can now also cause ultra-omega critical hits. When you roll a natural 20 on your critical confirmation roll, the critical will be immediately upgraded to an ultra-omega critical hit, causing 999 mythic damage to your target in addition to the normal critical damage.
zhCN:
你终于注意到了最要紧的事——问题出在自己身上。为了消除这些问题，你学会了迅速另寻其他神话诡计的门路。
现在你最多可使用两个可每日更换的一阶游荡神话诡计。
此外，通过极其细致地审视自身，你不知何故还能打出「终极·欧米伽重击」：当你在重击确认检定中掷出天然20时，该重击立即升级为终极·欧米伽重击，在常规重击伤害之外额外对目标造成999点神话伤害。

enGB:
You are so good at demoralizing your enemies that they lose the will to fight completely. Enemies affected by your demoralize ability must succeed at a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Will saving throw{/g} with a {g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} of 10 + your ranks in {g|Encyclopedia:Persuasion}Persuasion{/g}, or become paralyzed and completely {g|Encyclopedia:Helpless}helpless{/g}. They may make another saving throw against this condition every {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.
 In addition, while fighting with enemies, you throw rude comments at them, causing them to fumble their attacks and have problems concentrating. Gain a +4 bonus to dodge AC as well as a +2 to-hit attack bonus.
zhCN:
你极擅长挫敌士气，乃至能令其彻底丧失战意。受你挫伤士气能力影响的敌人必须通过{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}为10＋你{g|Encyclopedia:Persuasion}游说{/g}阶数的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}，否则将陷入{g|ConditionParalyzed}麻痹{/g}并完全{g|Encyclopedia:Helpless}无助{/g}。他们每{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}可以再次进行豁免以摆脱此状态。
此外，与敌人交战时你不断出言讥讽，令其攻击失手、难以专注。你获得+4闪避{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御等级{/g}加值与+2{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}加值。

enGB:
You can easily slip into shadow at any time. You can enter {g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}stealth{/g} during combat as a {g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}move action{/g}. This stealth is not broken by a single enemy detecting you — instead it acts similar to the invisibility {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}, giving you total {g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}concealment{/g} against all creatures that did not succeed on a {g|Encyclopedia:Perception}Perception check{/g} against you.
 In addition, shadows become your friend, and stick to you even during combat. Attackers attempting to hit you will receive a 15% miss chance penalty.
zhCN:
你可以随时轻易潜入阴影。在战斗中，你能够以{g|Encyclopedia:Move_Action}移动动作{/g}进入{g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}隐匿{/g}。被单个敌人发现并不会打破隐匿，而是类似于{g|SpellsInvisibility}隐形术{/g}法术效果：对所有未通过对你{g|Encyclopedia:Perception}察觉{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}的生物，你都具有完全{g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}隐蔽{/g}。
此外，阴影成了你的朋友，即便在战斗中也会附着于你。试图命中你的攻击者将承受15%的失手几率。

enGB: You exceed at {g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}stealth{/g}, fading from sight with your every move. Your stealth in combat now works more akin to greater invisibility {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} effect. Shadows have also now become your best friend, and actively work to help you in combat. Attackers receive a 30% miss chance to all attacks.
zhCN: 你在{g|Encyclopedia:Stealth}隐匿{/g}上出类拔萃，每一步都从视线中淡去。你在战斗中的隐匿如今更接近高等隐形术{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}的效果。阴影也成了你最好的伙伴，主动在战斗中相助。所有攻击方的攻击都有30%失手几率。

enGB:
Magical effects do not differ much from magical traps, and can be disabled just like any device. You can, as a {g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}standard action{/g}, attempt a {g|Encyclopedia:Trickery}Trickery check{/g} to dispel any effects on target or on the ground. Treat this as the dispel magic {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g}, only with a {g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}caster level{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}check{/g} replaced by a Trickery {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skill check{/g} with a -10 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.
 Being tricky is also helpful in combat, and any enemy attempting to attack you with a melee weapon will immediately suffer from entanglement (-2 attack bonus and -4 dexterity) as you bamboozle them in plain sight.
zhCN:
魔法效果与魔法陷阱差别不大，可以像装置一样被解除。你能够以{g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}标准动作{/g}尝试{g|Encyclopedia:Trickery}巧手{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}，解除目标或地面上的任何效果。类似{g|SpellsDispelMagic}解除魔法{/g}法术，只是以承受–10{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}的巧手{g|Encyclopedia:Skills}技能{/g}检定代替{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}检定。
机巧在战斗中同样有用：任何以近战武器攻击你的敌人都会立刻陷入纠缠（攻击加值–2、敏捷–4），因为你当着他们的面把他们耍得团团转。

enGB: Living creatures are also just complex devices and can also be easily disabled. You can try to disable them, forcing them to make a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude saving throw{/g} ({g|Encyclopedia:DC}DC{/g} 20 + your ranks in {g|Encyclopedia:Trickery}Trickery{/g}). If the target fails it, it dies.
zhCN: 活物也只是些复杂的装置，也能够被轻易解除。你可以尝试解除他们，迫使他们进行{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}强韧豁免检定{/g}（{g|Encyclopedia:DC}难度等级{/g}为20+你的{g|Encyclopedia:Trickery}巧手{/g}技能点数）。若目标失败，则会死亡。

enGB:
When fate gives you a challenge — you respond with a special die.
For one {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}, the target ally always {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}rolls{/g} 20 on all d20 rolls.
This is incredibly powerful magic, and taps into the literal power of a diety for one round... behind their back of course.
zhCN:
命运给你出难题——你就掏出一枚特制的骰子。
在1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}内，目标盟友的所有d20{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}掷骰{/g}结果一律视为20。
这是极其强大的魔法，等于在一轮之内盗用了某位神祇的实权……当然是背着人家。

enGB: Umbral Dragon

enGB:
You create a bolt of dark energy and use it to make a ranged touch attack that ignores concealment (but not total concealment).
If you hit, the target takes 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d6) and falls prone for 1d4 rounds as they are hit by primordial shadow energy. Half of this damage is cold damage and half of it is negative energy. The bolt's shadow expands and covers the target, rendering them blind for the duration of the spell. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage, prevents the creature from falling prone, and negates the blind condition.

你生成一道黑暗能量闪电，用它进行远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}，并无视{g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}隐蔽{/g}（但对完全隐蔽无效）。

enGB: Undead Resistances and Immunities

enGB:
This creature is undead and their body is completely immune to Poison, Disease, Sickened, Fatigue, Exhaustion, Nausea and bleed. They are also immune to ability damage, but still take a small amount of damage to their health when resisting such effects. Their mind is also hardened, and they are completely immune to Fear, Emotion, Fright and Sleep. In addition, they are highly resistant to Mind Affecting spells (+8 save throw).
Finally, all Undead have an innate resistance (+8 save) to Death spells, as these spells must reconfigure themselves to perform a more complicated Final Death on such an entity.
zhCN:
此生物是不死生物，其躯体完全免疫毒素、疾病、恶心、疲乏、力竭、反胃与流血。它们也免疫属性伤害，但在抵抗此类效果时仍会受到少量生命值损伤。其心智亦被淬硬，完全免疫恐惧、情绪、惊恐与睡眠。此外，它们对影响心智的法术有高度抗性（豁免检定+8）。
最后，所有不死生物对死亡法术都有天生抗性（豁免+8），因为这类法术必须重新调整自身，才能对此类存在施行更为复杂的“终末之死”。

enGB: Undeath to Death destroys undead creatures. The spell slays 1d6 HD worth of undead creatures per caster level (maximum 20d6). Those who are closest to the burst's point of origin are affected first. All creatures with 20 or less HD are slain outright, while creatures with more than 20 HD take 100 damage instead. HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted.
zhCN: {g|SpellsUndeathToDeath}净化亡者{/g}能消灭亡者。此法术可杀死每{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}生命骰的亡者（最高20d6）。越靠近爆发源头的生物越先受影响。生命骰不超过20的生物被立即杀死，生命骰超过20的生物改为受到100点伤害。不足以影响一个生物的多余生命骰数浪费掉。

enGB: This creature is made of the pure stuff of the Abyss and slowly decays anything nearby. Enemies within 5ft of this creature will take 2d6 Unholy damage per round.
zhCN: 此生物由深渊的纯粹本质构成，会缓慢侵蚀附近的一切。5英尺内的敌人每轮受到2d6点邪秽伤害。

enGB: Aura of Abyssal Decay
zhCN: 深渊腐朽灵光

enGB:
You call up unholy power to smite your enemies. The power takes the form of a cold, cloying miasma of greasy darkness. Only good and neutral (not evil) creatures are harmed by the spell.
The spell deals 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels (maximum 5d8) to a good creature (or 1d6 per caster level, maximum 10d6, plus an additional 2d10 divine damage, to a good outsider) and causes it to be sickened for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will save reduces damage to half and negates the sickened effect. The effects cannot be negated by remove disease or heal, but remove curse is effective.
The spell deals only half damage to creatures who are neither evil nor good, and they are not sickened. Such a creature can reduce the damage by half again (down to one-quarter) with a successful Will save.
zhCN:
你召唤污邪能量重创敌人。能量会呈现为一摊油腻的黑暗物质，散发着冰冷恶臭的气息。只有{g|Encyclopedia:Alignment}善良和中立{/g}阵营（也就是非邪恶阵营）的生物会受此{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。
此法术可对善良阵营生物造成每两个{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点伤害（最高5d8点；对善良异界生物可造成每施法者等级1d6点伤害，最高10d6点）并令其{g|ConditionSickened}恶心{/g}1d4{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。通过成功的{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免检定{/g}可使伤害减半并且免受恶心效果。该效果无法被{g|SpellsRemoveDisease}移除疾病{/g}或{g|SpellsHeal}医疗术{/g}解除，但可以通过{g|SpellsRemoveCurse}移除诅咒{/g}抵消。
此法术对并非善良也非邪恶阵营的生物只造成一半伤害，也不会令其陷入恶心状态。这些生物还可以通过成功的意志豁免检定，将伤害再次减半（降至原本的四分之一）。

enGB: Vampire Gentry
zhCN: 吸血鬼乡绅

enGB: This vampire is old and powerful enough to have joined the Vampire Gentry. Having become a full-fledged member of vampire high society,  this vampire is exceedingly powerful, cunning and charismatic. Vampire gentry make up the middle-class of vampire society and are treated with respect - especially among their juniors. Whilst still being weak to silver, fire and sunlight, members of the vampire gentry usually have begun to develop powerful arcane or divine sources of power, allowing them to take their time in combat and avoid rash decisions.
zhCN: 这名吸血鬼年岁与实力都足以跻身吸血鬼乡绅之列。作为吸血鬼上流社会的正式成员，它异常强大、狡黠而富有魅力。吸血鬼乡绅构成吸血鬼社会的中层，备受敬重——尤其在后辈面前。虽然依旧惧怕白银、火焰与阳光，乡绅成员通常已开始修成强大的奥术或神术力量源泉，使其在战斗中从容不迫、避免鲁莽决断。

enGB:
**Racial Class**
As opposed to traditional classes, you can only have a single racial class at any one time. Racial classes allow your character to take on the role of powerful creatures and entities that rely more on abilities and raw stats than the skills, magic and bonuses that normal classes provide.
The titular and most common breed of vampire - the moroi. Like all vampires, Moroi descend from an ancient vampiric race, the strigoi, after entering the Material Plane from the Shadow Plane in the ancient past. They are powerful creatures that are extremely difficult to kill, and can regenerate from even fatal wounds. However, they also have severe weaknesses to offset this power.
Vampires are also imbued with an intrinsic control of magic, and may continue the spell progression of a previous arcane class you have taken (2/3 spell progression), or use their own stand-alone spellbook.

**WARNING: If you want Vampire levels to advance your other arcane class's spellbook progression, you MUST choose that class before taking a level in vampire. Once you take the vampire class without merging into a pre-existing class's spellbook, you will be using the Vampire stand-alone spellbook for all proceeding levels.
zhCN:
**种族职业**
与传统职业不同，你在同一时间只能拥有一个种族职业。种族职业让你的角色得以扮演那些更依赖能力与基础属性、而非普通职业所提供的技能、魔法与加值的强大生物或存在。
题中最常见的一支吸血鬼便是莫罗伊。与所有吸血鬼一样，莫罗伊源自远古的吸血鬼种族斯特里戈伊——他们在久远之前自阴影位面进入物质位面。他们是极难杀死的强大生物，即便致命创伤也能再生。不过，为平衡这份力量，他们也有严重的弱点。
吸血鬼还被赋予对魔法的内在掌控，可延续你此前所选某一奥术职业的法术进度（2/3施法进度），或使用自身独立的法术书。

**警告：若你希望吸血鬼等级推进其它奥术职业的法术书进度，必须在提升吸血鬼等级之前先选择该职业。一旦在未并入既有法术书的情况下取得吸血鬼职业，此后所有等级都将使用吸血鬼独立法术书。

enGB: Vampire
zhCN: 吸血鬼

enGB: Accursed Witch
zhCN: 受诅巫师

enGB:
At 1st level, and every two out of three levels thereafter (2/3 caster), a Moroi vampire gains new spells per day as if he had gained a level in an arcane spontaneous spellcasting class (full caster classes only) he belonged to before becoming a vampire. If the vampire had no such spellcasting class before becoming a vampire, he may cast vampire spells instead, though his spell progression will not be as fast as a full caster (2/3 spell progression).
 When progressing a full caster's class, the vampire does not, however, gain any other benefit the class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known, and an increased effective level of spellcasting.
 If a character had more than one spontaneous spellcasting class before becoming a vampire, he must choose to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining his spells.

**WARNING: If you want Vampire levels to advance your other arcane class's spellbook progression, you MUST choose that class before taking a level in vampire. Once you take the vampire class without merging into a pre-existing class's spellbook, you will be using the Vampire stand-alone spellbook for all proceeding levels.
zhCN:
自1级起，此后每三级中有两级（2/3施法者）莫罗伊吸血鬼获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在成为吸血鬼之前所属的某一奥术自发施法职业（仅限完整施法者职业）提升了1级。若吸血鬼在成为吸血鬼之前没有此类施法职业，则可改为施展吸血鬼法术，但其法术进展速度不及完整施法者（2/3法术进展）。
 在推进完整施法者职业时，除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，吸血鬼不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
 若角色在成为吸血鬼之前拥有多个自发施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定其法术。

**警告：若希望吸血鬼等级能推进你其它奥术职业的法术书进展，你必须在提升吸血鬼等级之前先选定该职业。一旦在未并入既有职业法术书的情况下提升了吸血鬼等级，此后所有等级都将使用吸血鬼独立法术书。

enGB: Ancient Body
zhCN: 远古之躯

enGB:
Upon reaching a certain, immense, level of power, a Moroi Vampire begins to become more intelligent, and a more powerful caster as they enter the realm of ancient vampires.
At 14th, 17th and 20th levels, a Moroi Vampire gains +1 to ALL body and mental statistics. In addition, they gain 1 effective caster level for all spells cast. These bonuses stack with themselves and all other non-racial bonuses.
zhCN:
当力量达到某个极高的层次，莫罗伊吸血鬼迈入远古吸血鬼之列，会变得更为聪慧，施法也更强。
在14、17和20级时，莫罗伊吸血鬼的所有身体与心智属性各+1。此外，其施展的所有法术获得1点有效施法者等级。这些加值可彼此叠加，也可与所有非种族加值叠加。

enGB: Blood Kiss
zhCN: 血之吻

enGB:
All vampires are able to drink the blood of other living creatures as sustenance. In combat, this 'blood kiss' can also be used. As opposed to the slow, long ritual of the true blood kiss (used to create new vampire spawn). Drinking a creature's blood in combat inflicts two negative levels on the target, and gives the vampire 5d10 temporary hit points. 
This effect lasts for 10 minutes.
zhCN:
所有吸血鬼都能以吸食其它活物的血液为生。战斗中也可使用这种“血之吻”。与用于制造新吸血鬼子嗣的缓慢冗长的真正血之吻不同，战斗中吸食生物血液会使目标承受两个负向等级，并给予吸血鬼5d10点临时生命值。
此效果持续10分钟。

enGB: Moroi Vampires, as vampires, are extremely resistant to damage not caused by silvered weapons. They gain DR 5/Silver(2/-) at 4th, DR 10(5/-) at 9th, 20(15/-) at 14th and 30(25/-) at 19th levels.
zhCN: 莫罗伊吸血鬼作为吸血鬼，对非镀银武器造成的伤害有极强抗性。4级时获得DR 5/银（2/-），9级时DR 10（5/-），14级时20（15/-），19级时30（25/-）。

enGB:
At 1st level, and every two out of three levels thereafter (2/3 caster), a Moroi vampire gains new spells per day as if he had gained a level in an arcane spontaneous spellcasting class (full caster classes only) he belonged to before becoming a vampire. If the vampire had no such spellcasting class before becoming a vampire, he may cast vampire spells instead, though his spell progression will not be as fast as a full caster (2/3 spell progression).
 When progressing a full caster's class, the vampire does not, however, gain any other benefit the class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known, and an increased effective level of spellcasting.
 If a character had more than one spontaneous spellcasting class before becoming a vampire, he must choose to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining his spells.

**WARNING: If you want Vampire levels to advance your other arcane class's spellbook progression, you MUST choose that class before taking a level in vampire. Once you take the vampire class without merging into a pre-existing class's spellbook, you will be using the Vampire stand-alone spellbook for all proceeding levels.
zhCN:
自1级起，此后每三级中有两级（2/3施法者）莫罗伊吸血鬼获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在成为吸血鬼之前所属的某一奥术自发施法职业（仅限完整施法者职业）提升了1级。若吸血鬼在成为吸血鬼之前没有此类施法职业，则可改为施展吸血鬼法术，但其法术进展速度不及完整施法者（2/3法术进展）。
 在推进完整施法者职业时，除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，吸血鬼不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
 若角色在成为吸血鬼之前拥有多个自发施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定其法术。

**警告：若希望吸血鬼等级能推进你其它奥术职业的法术书进展，你必须在提升吸血鬼等级之前先选定该职业。一旦在未并入既有职业法术书的情况下提升了吸血鬼等级，此后所有等级都将使用吸血鬼独立法术书。

enGB: Mistform
zhCN: 雾形体

enGB: Moroi vampires, once becoming mature, are able to transform into a supernatural mist at will. This mist form is very difficult to {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} with normal means, though the vampire cannot cast {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} or attack with their weapons while in it. The prudent vampire, then, will usually turn into mist when attempting to escape, as this form is extremely adept at evasion and defense.
zhCN: 莫罗伊吸血鬼一旦成熟，便可随意化为超自然迷雾。此雾形态极难以常规手段{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}，不过吸血鬼在形态中无法施展{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}或以武器攻击。因此谨慎的吸血鬼通常在试图脱身时化为迷雾，此形态极擅闪避与防护。

enGB: Mistform
zhCN: 雾形体

enGB: At-will, a moroi vampire can turn into supernatural mist for one minute. While in this form, the vampire is unable to use their weapons, cast spells, or use items. However, their movement {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}speed{/g} is increased by 20 feet, they become {g|Encyclopedia:Incorporeal_Touch_Attack}incorporeal{/g},  gain DR 30/magic, and gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC as well as +5 to stealth.
zhCN: 莫罗伊吸血鬼可随意化为超自然迷雾，持续1分钟。在此形态下，吸血鬼无法使用武器、施法或使用物品。不过，其移动{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}速度{/g}提高20英尺，变为{g|Encyclopedia:Incorporeal_Touch_Attack}虚体{/g}，获得DR 30/魔法，AC获得+4环境加值，隐匿+5。

enGB: Supernatural Body
zhCN: 超自然之躯

enGB:
As a Moroi Vampire grows in power, they become much more agile, strong, and difficult to kill.
At 3rd, 6th, 9th, 12th and 15th levels, a Moroi Vampire gains +2 DEX, +1 STR, and +1 CON. These bonuses stack with themselves and all other non-racial bonuses.
zhCN:
随着莫罗伊吸血鬼力量增长，它会变得更为敏捷、强壮且难以杀死。
在3、6、9、12和15级时，莫罗伊吸血鬼获得+2敏捷、+1力量与+1体质。这些加值可彼此叠加，也可与所有非种族加值叠加。

enGB: Supernatural Healing
zhCN: 超自然回复

enGB:
As a Moroi Vampire becomes recognized as a neophyte (usually between 10-30 years of age), it begins developing the powerful regeneration that mature vampires are known for, though much weaker in effect.
At 4th level, a Moroi Vampire gains a +5 regeneration (fast healing) effect, and is able to recover from most wounds.
zhCN:
当莫罗伊吸血鬼被视作初成者时（通常在10至30岁之间），它开始发展出成熟吸血鬼所著称的强力再生，只是效果弱得多。
4级时，莫罗伊吸血鬼获得+5再生（快速回复）效果，并能从多数创伤中恢复。

enGB: Supernatural Healing
zhCN: 超自然回复

enGB:
An ancient Moroi Vampire has a form of regeneration so powerful as to make them nigh invulnerable to most forms of attack.
At 18th level, a Moroi Vampire's regeneration increases to 20.
zhCN:
远古莫罗伊吸血鬼拥有几近使其在多数攻击面前无懈可击的强力再生。
18级时，莫罗伊吸血鬼的再生提升至20。

enGB: Supernatural Healing
zhCN: 超自然回复

enGB:
A mature Moroi Vampire has now gained an extremely powerful form of regeneration, making it capable of surviving wounds that would kill other creatures. 
At 11th level, a Moroi Vampire's regeneration increases to 10.
zhCN:
成熟的莫罗伊吸血鬼已获得极为强大的再生能力，足以在会杀死其它生物的创伤下存活。
11级时，莫罗伊吸血鬼的再生提升至10。

enGB: Vampiric Undeath
zhCN: 吸血鬼不死之身

enGB:
Vampires are undead and their body is completely immune to Poison, Disease, Sickened, Fatigue, Exhaustion, Nausea and bleed. They are also immune to ability damage, but still take a small amount of damage to their health when resisting such effects. Their mind is also hardened, and they are completely immune to Fear, Emotion, Fright and Sleep. In addition, they are highly resistant to Mind Affecting spells (+8 save throw).
Finally, all Undead have an innate resistance (+8 save) to Death spells, as these spells must reconfigure themselves to perform a more complicated Final Death on such an entity.
zhCN:
吸血鬼是不死生物，其躯体完全免疫毒素、疾病、恶心、疲乏、力竭、反胃与流血。它们也免疫属性伤害，但在抵抗此类效果时仍会受到少量生命值损伤。其心智亦被淬硬，完全免疫恐惧、情绪、惊恐与睡眠。此外，它们对影响心智的法术有高度抗性（豁免检定+8）。
最后，所有不死生物对死亡法术都有天生抗性（豁免+8），因为这类法术必须重新调整自身，才能对此类存在施行更为复杂的“终末之死”。

Once you take the vampire class without merging into a pre-existing class's spellbook, you will be using the Vampire stand-alone spellbook for all proceeding levels.
zhCN:
自1级起，此后每三级中有两级（2/3施法者）莫罗伊吸血鬼获得的每日法术数量，等同于他在成为吸血鬼之前所属的某一奥术自发施法职业（仅限完整施法者职业）提升了1级。若吸血鬼在成为吸血鬼之前没有此类施法职业，则可改为施展吸血鬼法术，但其法术进展速度不及完整施法者（2/3法术进展）。
 在推进完整施法者职业时，除了额外的每日法术、已知法术和施法者有效等级的提升之外，吸血鬼不会获得该职业的任何其它好处。
 若角色在成为吸血鬼之前拥有多个自发施法职业，则必须选定将新等级加到哪一个职业上，以此决定其法术。

**警告：若希望吸血鬼等级能推进你其它奥术职业的法术书进展，你必须在提升吸血鬼等级之前先选定该职业。一旦在未并入既有职业法术书的情况下提升了吸血鬼等级，此后所有等级都将使用吸血鬼独立法术书。

enGB: Unlettered Arcanist
zhCN: 弃卷奥能师

enGB: Vampiric Vulnerabilities
zhCN: 吸血鬼弱点

enGB: Vampires are extremely vulnerable to Holy, Divine, Radiant and Fire damage. In addition, they are vulnerable to piercing damage, as their traditional weakness to wooden stakes being driven through their heart extends to other piercing weapons hitting critical parts of their body as well.
zhCN: 吸血鬼对神圣、神性、光辉与火焰伤害极为脆弱。此外，它们也易受穿刺伤害——木桩刺心这一传统弱点，同样延伸到其它穿刺武器命中其身体要害的情形。

enGB: This +6 artifact greataxe has an improved {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical{/g} range, and deals an additional 10 vorpal {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} on every hit.
zhCN: 这把+6神器巨斧拥有更宽的{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}范围，且每次命中额外造成10点斩首{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}。

enGB:
Vavakias are immense demons of great power. Saurian in shape, appetite, and destructive power, they are most often encountered on the Material Plane, though not as demons conjured by spellcasters to serve, but rather as violent invaders come to the world through tears in reality or portals to the deeper rifts. On the Material Plane, a single vavakia is a formidable presence, for the strange demon is driven to feed on living souls and spread destruction — roles at which it excels.
Though Vavakia have features that seem to resemble dragonkind, they are in truth but mockeries of the great draconic races. A distillation of the destructive power of dragonkind, distorted and remade by the Abyss.
zhCN:
威加魔是力量强大的庞然恶魔。其形貌、食欲与破坏力都似蜥蜴巨兽，最常出现在物质位面；但并非被施法者召唤来供驱使的恶魔，而是借现实的裂隙或通往更深深渊的传送门侵入世界的暴虐入侵者。在物质位面，一头威加魔便是可畏的存在，因为这奇异的恶魔受驱于吞食生者灵魂与散播毁灭——而它在这两件事上极为出色。
尽管威加魔有些特征看似龙类，实则不过是对伟大龙族的拙劣戏仿：那是龙族破坏之力经深渊扭曲重塑后的凝练。

enGB: Vavakia
zhCN: 威加魔

enGB: This creature prefers to attack with vital strike and will be very good at doing high damage strikes.
zhCN: 此生物偏爱以要害打击进攻，极擅长打出高伤害的重击。

enGB: Master Focused Striker
zhCN: 大师要害打击者

enGB: This creature prefers to attack with vital strike and will be very good at doing high damage strikes.
zhCN: 此生物偏爱以要害打击进攻，极擅长打出高伤害的重击。

enGB: Expert Focused Striker
zhCN: 精擅要害打击者

enGB: Chunks of hot volcanic rock and clumps of ash pound down when this spell is cast, dealing 3d8 points of bludgeoning damage and 2d8 points of fire damage to every creature in the area. This damage only occurs once, when the spell is cast. For the remaining duration of the spell, heavy ash rains down in the area. Creatures inside this area take a –4 penalty on Perception skill checks and the entire area is treated as difficult terrain. At the end of the duration, the rock and ash disappear, leaving no aftereffects (other than the damage dealt).
zhCN: 施法时，炽热的火山岩块与大量火山灰倾泻而下，对{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围内所有生物造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}3d8{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}钝击伤害{/g}与2d8点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}火焰伤害{/g}。伤害只在法术施放时发生一次。余下的法术持续时间内，法术范围内降下大量火山灰。法术范围内的生物在{g|Encyclopedia:Perception}察觉{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Skills}技能{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}上受到–4{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，整个区域视作困难地形。法术失效时，岩块与火山灰消失，除了造成的伤害之外不留下任何后续影响。

enGB: Profane champions of the Abyss, vrocks embody all the rage, hatred, and violence of that despicable realm. As ravenous and grotesquely opportunistic as the scavengers they resemble, vrocks delight in bloodshed, relishing the sounds and sensations of ripping the still-pulsing entrails from a living husk.
zhCN: 妄乱魔是深渊的亵渎勇士，凝聚了那可鄙领域全部的暴怒、憎恨与暴力。它们像所肖似的食腐兽一样贪得无厌、极善投机，以流血为乐，沉迷于从活物躯壳中扯出仍在搏动的内脏时的声响与触感。

enGB: Vrock
zhCN: 妄乱魔

enGB: Vrolikai's Dagger of Undead Annihilation
zhCN: 食魂厉魔的亡者湮灭匕首

enGB:
A vrolikai is 14 feet tall but weighs only 500 pounds. They are unsurpassed masters of necromatic and negative energies, and take sadistic pleasure in the complete annihilation of undead beings. Liches are especially succulent targets to them, as they delight in ending the previously mortal creature's delusions of immortality.
Unlike other demons, vrolikai do not form from sinful souls — they instead manifest from nabasu demons that return to the Abyss after growing to maturity on the Material Plane. Not all nabasus survive this transformation, but those who do become powerful indeed.
zhCN:
食魂厉魔身高14英尺，体重却只有500磅。它们是亡灵法术与负能量无可匹敌的大师，以彻底湮灭不死生物为虐乐。巫妖对它们而言尤为美味，因为它们乐于终结这些昔日凡物对不朽的妄想。
与其它恶魔不同，食魂厉魔并非由罪孽灵魂凝成——它们是由在物质位面长大成熟后返回深渊的食魂魔显化而成。并非所有食魂魔都能熬过这场蜕变，但成功者确实强大无比。

enGB: Vrolikai
zhCN: 食魂厉魔

enGB: Vrolikai demons hold complete dominance over negative energy and are able to actually bend aspects of the negative plane to their will. They have 150 resistance to negative energy as well as negative energy immunity.
zhCN: 食魂厉魔完全支配负能量，甚至能随心扭曲负能量位面的某些层面。它们拥有150点负能量抗性，并免疫负能量。

enGB: Absolute Negative Energy Immunity
zhCN: 绝对负能量免疫

enGB: Vrolikai's Undead Annihilator
zhCN: 食魂厉魔的亡者湮灭者

enGB: Annihilator of Undead
zhCN: 亡者湮灭者

enGB: This creature, being heavily reliant on Abyssal energies to sustain it's power, is experiencing massive interferance from a nearby divine wardstone. Most of it's abilities will be somewhat weaker than normal.
zhCN: 此生物极度依赖深渊能量维持力量，正受到附近神圣守护石的强烈干涉。它的绝大多数能力都会比平时略弱。

enGB: Immense Wardstone Interference
zhCN: 极强守护石干涉

enGB: At 20th level, the warpriest can channel an aspect of war, growing in power and martial ability. Once per day as a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, a warpriest can treat his level as his {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}base attack bonus{/g}, gains {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}DR{/g} 20/—, and can move at his full {g|Encyclopedia:Speed}speed{/g} regardless of the armor he is wearing or his encumbrance. In addition, the blessings he calls upon don't count against his daily limit during this time. This ability lasts for 1 minute.
zhCN: 达到20级后，战斗祭司可以让自己成为战争的化身，提升力量与战斗技术。每天一次，花费一个{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}，战斗祭司可以将自己的等级视为{g|Encyclopedia:BAB}基础攻击加值{/g}，获得{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Reduction}伤害减免{/g}20/—，并且能够不考虑所穿盔甲和负重以{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}全速{/g}移动。此外，在这段时间内，他唤来的祝福不计入每日限制次数。这个能力持续1分钟。

enGB: As a {g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}standard action{/g}, you can fire an icicle from your finger, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g}. The icicle deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g} + 5 points for every level you possess in the class that gave you access to this domain.[LONGSTART] You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.[LONGEND]
zhCN: 作为{g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}标准动作{/g}，你能够以远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}的方式，对30英尺内的任意敌人发射一枚冰锥。此冰锥将造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}寒冷伤害{/g}，赋予你此领域的职业等级每提升2级，可额外造成5点伤害。每天可使用次数为{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值+3。

enGB:
You can manipulate water and mist and ice, conjure creatures of water, and resist cold.
Icicle: As a {g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}standard action{/g}, you can fire an icicle from your finger, targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g}. The icicle deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}cold damage{/g} + 5 points for every level you possess in the class that gave you access to this domain. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.
Cold Resistance: At 6th level, you gain resist cold 10. This resistance increases to 20 at 12th level. At 20th level, you gain immunity to cold.
Domain {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Spells{/g}: ray of sickening, acid arrow, stinking cloud, freedom of movement, ice storm, cone of cold, elemental body IV (water), horrid wilting, tsunami.
zhCN:
你可操纵流水、迷雾以及寒冰，召唤水系生物，并可抵抗寒冷。
冰锥：作为{g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}标准动作{/g}，你能够以远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}的方式，对30英尺内的任意敌人发射一枚冰锥。此冰锥将造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}寒冷伤害{/g}，赋予你此领域的职业等级每提升2级，可额外造成5点伤害。每天可使用次数为{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值+3。
寒冷抗性：达到6级时，你将获得10点寒冷{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}抗性{/g}。此抗性在12级时将增加为20。达到20级时，你将获得寒冷{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Immunity}免疫{/g}。
领域{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}：{g|SpellsRayOfSickening}恶心射线{/g}，{g|SpellsScorchingRay}灼热射线（寒冷）{/g}，{g|SpellsStinkingCloud}臭云术{/g}，{g|SpellsFreedomOfMovement}行动自如{/g}，{g|SpellsIceStorm}冰风暴{/g}，{g|SpellsConeOfCold}寒冰锥{/g}，{g|SpellsElementalBodyIVWater}元素之躯IV（水）{/g}，{g|SpellsHorridWilting}凋死术{/g}，{g|SpellsTsunami}津波{/g}。

enGB: As a {g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}standard action{/g}, you can create a storm burst targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g}. The storm burst deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} + 4 points for every level you possess in the class that gave you access to this domain. In addition, the target is buffeted by winds and rain, causing it to take a –2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.[LONGSTART] You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.[LONGEND]
zhCN: 作为{g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}标准动作{/g}，你能够以远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}的方式，对30英尺内的任意敌人施以暴风的冲击。暴风冲击将造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}，赋予你此领域的职业等级每提升2级，可额外造成4点伤害。此外，该目标将持续受到风雨的影响，{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}受到–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，效果持续1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。每天可使用次数为{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值+3。

enGB:
With power over storm and sky, you can call down the wrath of the gods upon the world below.
Storm Burst: As a {g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}standard action{/g}, you can create a storm burst targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged {g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}touch attack{/g}. The storm burst deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} + 8 points for every two levels you possess in the class that gave you access to this domain. In addition, the target is buffeted by winds and rain, causing it to take a –2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} on {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} for 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} modifier.
Lightning Lord: At 8th level, as a {g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}swift action{/g}, you can call down a bolt of lightning. You can call down a bolt of lightning a number of times per day equal to your level in the class that gave you access to this domain. This ability otherwise functions as call lightning.
zhCN:
利用暴风与天空的力量，你可召唤诸神之怒降临人世。
暴风冲击：作为{g|Encyclopedia:Standard_Actions}标准动作{/g}，你能够以远程{g|Encyclopedia:TouchAttack}接触攻击{/g}的方式，对30英尺内的任意敌人施以暴风的冲击。暴风冲击将造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}，赋予你此领域的职业等级每提升2级，可额外造成8点伤害。此外，该目标将持续受到风雨的影响，{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击检定{/g}受到–2{g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}减值{/g}，效果持续1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}。每天可使用次数为{g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}感知{/g}调整值+3。
闪电领主：8级时，作为{g|Encyclopedia:Swift_Action}迅捷动作{/g}，你可召唤一道闪电箭。每天可使用次数等于赋予你此领域的职业等级。除此以外，此能力的效果类似于{g|SpellsCallLightning}召雷{/g}。

enGB: This extra-planar dart deals sonic {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} instead of {g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}piercing damage{/g}. On a {g|Encyclopedia:Critical}critical hit{/g}, it deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}sonic damage{/g} per two caster levels of the wielder to all enemies in 15 feet area.
zhCN: 这支+4{g|EnhancementThundering}雷鸣{/g}飞镖造成{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Damage}音波伤害{/g}而非{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}穿刺伤害{/g}。造成{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}后，它会对15英尺范围内所有敌人造成每两个持用者的{g|Encyclopedia:Character_Level}角色等级{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g}点音波伤害。

enGB: White dragons are beings of cold and the arctic tundra. They are extremely resistant to cold, and resistant to most primal energies, though younger ones like this have not yet fully formed their protections.
zhCN: 白龙是寒冰与极地冻原的造物。它们极度抗寒，也能抵抗多数原初能量；不过像这样的幼龙尚未完全长成自身的防护。

enGB: Juvenile White Dragon Resistances
zhCN: 幼年白龙抗性

enGB:
You become a Large air elemental. You gain a +2 size bonus to your Strength, a +6 size bonus to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, a +6 dodge armor bonus, resist electricity 20, and vulnerability to acid. You also gain three 1d8 slam attacks and the whirlwind ability. You are immune to critical hits and sneak attacks while in elemental form. Your movement speed is increased by 30 feet.
Whirlwind: An air elemental can transform itself into a whirlwind and back again. The whirlwind is 20 feet wide, and every creature that spends a round in the whirlwind must succeed at a Reflex save or take 1d8 bludgeoning damage. While in whirlwind form, it cannot attack, but it is able to use its abilities.

你变身为大型风元素。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Strength}力量{/g}获得+2{g|Encyclopedia:Size}体型{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}加值{/g}，{g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}敏捷{/g}获得+6体型加值，获得+4天生{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}防御加值{/g}、20点电击{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Resistance}抗性{/g}、以及酸蚀{g|Encyclopedia:Energy_Vulnerability}易伤{/g}。你还将获得2次可造成{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d8{/g}点伤害的挥击攻击和旋风能力。处于元素形态时，你对{g|Encyclopedia:Critical}重击{/g}和偷袭免疫。你的{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}移动速度{/g}提高30英尺。
旋风：风元素可以变身为旋风以及由旋风变回原状。旋风宽度为20英尺，所有在旋风内待过1{g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}轮{/g}的生物必须进行{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}反射豁免{/g}，失败则受到1d8点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}钝击伤害{/g}。处于旋风形态时，它无法进行攻击，但可以使用能力。

Burn: A fire elemental deals 1d6 fire damage in addition to damage dealt on a successful hit in melee. Those affected by the burn ability must also succeed at a Reflex save or catch fire, taking 1d6 damage each round for an additional 1d4 rounds. Creatures that hit a burning creature with natural weapons or unarmed attacks take fire damage as though hit by the burning creature and must succeed at a Reflex save to avoid catching fire.

You become a huge air elemental. You gain a +4 size bonus to your Strength and Constitution, a +6 size bonus to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, a +6 dodge armor bonus, resist electricity 20, and vulnerability to acid. You also gain three 2d6 slam attacks and the whirlwind ability. You are immune to critical hits and sneak attacks while in elemental form and gain DR 5/—. Your movement speed is increased by 30 feet.
Whirlwind: An air elemental can transform itself into a whirlwind and back again. The whirlwind is 20 feet wide, and every creature that spends a round in the whirlwind must succeed at a Reflex save or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. While in whirlwind form, the elemental cannot attack, but it is able to use its abilities.

enGB:
You become a Large shambling mound. You gain a +6 size bonus to your Strength, a +6 size bonus to your Constitution, a -2 penalty to your Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus, resist fire 20, and resist electricity 20. Your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet. You also have two 2d6 slam attacks, the constricting vines ability, and the poison ability.
Constricting Vines: A shambling mound's vines coil around any creature it hits with a slam attack. The shambling mound attempts a grapple maneuver check against its target, and on a successful check its vines deal 2d6+5 damage and the foe is grappled.
Grappled characters cannot move, and take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and a -4 penalty to Dexterity. Grappled characters attempt to escape every round by making a successful combat maneuver, Strength, Athletics, or Mobility check. The DC of this check is the shambling mound's CMD.
Each round, creatures grappled by a shambling mound suffer 4d6+Strength modifier × 2 damage.
A shambling mound receives a +4 bonus on grapple maneuver checks.
Poison:
Slam; Save: Fortitude
Frequency: 1/round for 2 rounds
Effect: 1d2 Strength and 1d2 Dexterity damage
Cure: 1 save
The save DC is Constitution-based.

enGB:
You surround yourself with a buffeting shroud of supernatural, tornado-force winds. These winds grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with perfect maneuverability and help protect you from physical attacks, giving you DR 5/-. Neither your armor nor your load affects this fly speed. The winds shield you from any other wind effects, and form a shell of breathable air around you, allowing you to fly and breathe underwater or in outer space.
You have total concealment against ranged attacks. Gases and most gaseous breath weapons cannot pass though the winds.
In addition, when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can shape your winds so they lash out at that creature as an immediate action. The creature must make a Fortitude Saving Throw or take 5d8 points of bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone (if on the ground). On a failed save, Huge flying creatures are checked and Large-sized or smaller flying creatures are blown away instead of knocked prone.
On a successful save, the damage is halved and the creature is not knocked prone (or checked or blown away).
zhCN:
你用一道激烈的超自然龙卷风围绕自己。旋风会为你提供60英尺飞行{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}速度{/g}，且具有完美机动性。你的防具和负载都不会影响到此飞行速度。旋风能为你阻挡其他风力效应，并在你身边产生可呼吸的空气层，使你能够在水下或外太空飞行和呼吸。
你对{g|Encyclopedia:RangedAttack}远程攻击{/g}具有完全{g|Encyclopedia:Concealment}隐蔽{/g}。气体和大多数毒气喷吐攻击都穿不过这道旋风。
此外，当生物以{g|Encyclopedia:MeleeAttack}近战攻击{/g}命中你时，你能够以即时{g|Encyclopedia:CA_Types}动作{/g}控制旋风来反击该生物。该生物必须进行{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}强韧豁免检定{/g}，失败将受到{g|Encyclopedia:Dice}5d8{/g}点{g|Encyclopedia:Damage_Type}钝击伤害{/g}并{g|ConditionProne}俯卧{/g}（若位于地面）。豁免失败时，作为俯卧的替代，{g|Encyclopedia:Size}超大型{/g}飞行生物会被阻挡，大型或更小的飞行生物被吹飞。
豁免成功时，该{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}减半，生物也不会俯卧（或被阻挡和吹飞）。

enGB: After decades of grueling study and magical experimentation, the wizard has achieved a mastery over magic attained by scant few mortals. They receive a +1 bonus to the DC of ALL spell schools.
zhCN: 经过数十年艰苦研习与魔法实验，这名法师掌握了极少数凡人才能企及的魔法造诣。其所有魔法学派法术的DC+1。

enGB: A wood golem is carved from rare woods, assembled into a roughly humanoid body with articulated limbs. Their creators usually leave their bodies almost unfinished, with individual pieces of lumber and unworked wood apparent and obvious as part of their construction. A wood golem stands 6-1/2 feet tall and weighs 400 pounds. These golems are not particularly tough or durable, and have a significant vulnerability to fire damage. However, wood is an excellent medium for the carving of runes, and their general resistance to spells is excellent.
zhCN: 木魔像以珍稀木材雕成，拼接为带有活动关节的类人躯体。创造者通常让其躯体近乎未完工，刻意留出明显的原木与未加工木料作为构造的一部分。木魔像高6又1/2英尺，重400磅。这类魔像并不特别坚固耐久，且对火焰伤害有显著弱点。不过木材极宜雕刻符文，其整体的法术抗性也极为出色。

enGB: Wood Golem
zhCN: 木魔像

enGB: Similar to other golems that use natural materials in their construction, wood golems are very resistant to most forms of natural energy. Fire being a quite obvious exception.
zhCN: 与其他以天然材料构筑的魔像相似，木魔像对绝大多数自然能量都有很高抗性——火焰显然是个例外。

enGB:
Any nonchaotic creature within the area of a word of chaos spell suffers the following ill effects:
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 1, it is stunned
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 5, it is confused and stunned.
If the creature's HD is up to your caster level – 10, it is killed, confused, and stunned.
[LONGSTART]The effects are cumulative and concurrent. A successful Will save reduces or eliminates these effects. Creatures affected by multiple effects make only one save and apply the result to all of the effects.[LONGEND] Creatures whose Hit Dice are equal to or exceed your caster level are unaffected by word of chaos.
Finally, Lawful Outsiders succumb to 4d6 divine damage regardless of if they save or not.
zhCN:
在混沌之语{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}范围内的非混乱生物都会受到以下不良影响：
如果生物的{g|Encyclopedia:Hit_Dice}生命骰数{/g}比你的{g|Encyclopedia:Caster_Level}施法者等级{/g}低1级，它陷入{g|ConditionStunned}震慑{/g}状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低5级，它陷入{g|ConditionConfusion}困惑{/g}和震慑状态。
如果生物的生命骰数比你的施法者等级低10级，它陷入困惑和震慑状态，并且死亡。
这些效果互相累积并且同时生效。{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}意志豁免{/g}成功将减少或者抵消这些效果。受到多个效果影响的生物，只需进行一次豁免检定，并将检定结果应用于所有效果。如果生物的生命骰数等于或高于你的施法者等级，它将不受混沌之语影响。
